title: 💚 This App Helped Me Find Myself Again
text:
I honestly don’t know where I’d be today without Reframe.

I joined Reframe in October 2024 because I knew I needed to change my relationship with alcohol. Like many people, I didn’t get it right the first time. But one thing I never did was give up. Reframe never gave up on me either.

What I found was so much more than an alcohol-free app. I found education, compassion, accountability, and a community that truly understands.

The coaches, the daily meetings, the science-based approach, and the incredible community kept cheering me on until I was finally strong enough to cheer myself on. That belief, support, and encouragement made all the difference.

Reframe has helped me change the way I think—not just about alcohol, but about myself. I’ve learned that cravings pass, emotions aren’t emergencies, and self-care isn’t selfish. I’ve learned to pause, breathe, and respond instead of react. Those lessons have changed every part of my life.

Today, I’m approaching five months alcohol-free, and for the first time in a very long time, I feel proud of myself. I’m more present with my family, more patient with myself, and more grateful than I ever imagined I could be. Recovery hasn’t made my life perfect, but it has made me capable of handling life’s challenges without reaching for a drink.

One of the greatest gifts has been the friendships I’ve made along the way. Encouraging others in the community has become just as meaningful as receiving encouragement myself. It’s amazing how people you’ve never met can help change your life.

If you’re wondering whether Reframe is worth trying, my answer is an emphatic yes. It isn’t magic, and it still takes commitment, but you don’t have to do it alone. Every small step matters, and every day you keep showing up is a victory.

Joining Reframe is one of the best decisions I’ve ever made. It didn’t just help me stop drinking—it helped me start finding myself again.

Today, I don’t just wake up grateful to be alcohol-free. I wake up grateful to be fully present for my life. That’s a gift Reframe helped me discover, and one I’ll never take for granted.

title: The Best Investment I Made in My Sobriety
text:
I started using Reframe about three years ago when I began my journey to quit drinking. While I did have a few relapses along the way, each one became shorter and less severe because I always came back to the app and the tools it provides. Over time, Reframe has helped me educate myself so much that staying sober has become much easier. Instead of relying only on willpower, I now understand what happens in my brain, why cravings appear, and what causes addiction to grow.

What makes Reframe special is that it’s not just another sobriety tracker. The app is fun, interactive, and engaging. The daily challenges keep you motivated, you can choose your own path, and the daily lessons are grounded in real science while also including inspiring motivational quotes that genuinely keep you engaged. It teaches you practical strategies that help rewire your thinking and build lasting habits.

The community is also incredibly supportive, and knowing that help is always there whenever an unexpected trigger comes up makes a huge difference.

I’ve spent much more money on other recovery programs that weren’t nearly as helpful. I highly recommend it to anyone who is sober, sober curious, or simply wants to better understand their drinking habits.

title: Take the 30 Day challenge
text: The Reframe App is the real deal if you want to cutback your alcohol consumption or stop drinking altogether.  You have a choice to pursue either path but don’t have to commit to either as long as you keep working on the daily tasks which take 10-15 minutes each day.  You get access to online Zoom meetings with people who are also working to reduce their alcohol consumption. Your participation in these meetings is not required; you can choose to speak or not speak, it’s up to you. There is a wealth of information each day, readings, videos, journaling, forum discussions, and meetings.  One on one coaching with a real coach is available for an extra fee but the meetings are so interactive I have not chosen to have a one on one coach.  I started off setting realistic goals to significantly reduce my alcohol consumption but within a few days was convinced by the information that Reframe provided regarding the health risks of drinking, that I should try going the alcohol free path for 30 days.  What an amazing difference I’ve felt in my mental and physical health in the last 38 days.  The 30 day free trial (actually costs $4.99) gives you access to all the benefits of the app that you need to move forward with less (or no) alcohol in your life.  The app gives you ample advance notice that 30 days is approaching if you don’t want to proceed with the annual subscription of $99.99.  There is minimal risk to trying this app but a big potential gain to your life and health.  I can’t say enough good things about the app, it’s ease of use, the Reframe support team, the connection with real people and the great information that you receive. Give it a try for 30 days, you won’t regret it.

title: Couldn’t stop drinking
text:
I was drinking a bottle of wine at night. My unwind glass after work, my make dinner glass, my with dinner glass and then my cleanup glass. A bottle of wine a night for years. I ended up very fragile. I got sick all the time. I was on depression medication. I thought it was just aging. I ended up in the hospital and I couldn’t walk or talk. The wine interacted with medicine. I didn’t have a stroke. The interaction of chemicals in my brain caused me to lose my mobility, and my communication.

Then Reframe entered my life. My counselor suggested it for years. But my thinking was, what can an app do for me? What a stupid idea.

That stupid idea of downloading the Reframe app has given me a year and a half of sobriety. I can walk, I can talk, I can dance, I do Zumba, I do yoga, and I can almost stand on my head in the middle of the room. I’m 67 years old. I got a second chance thanks to Reframe.

The thing I like best about Reframe is that it’s not judgmental in any way. It’s factual. They have compassionate counselors that lead meetings all times of the day and night you don’t have to start over if you have a relapse you just get back up and keep going.

I recommend Reframe to anybody who has somebody who needs to hear about how you can make that is fun, engaging, always there for you, and life-changing!

title: It works when nothing else has
text:
I’ve only been sober a week now. Used to have at least a bottle of wine each night- often 2 as of late- after an injury which left me on temp disability for almost a year now. I’m on the road to recovery finally with PT, Better Me and Reframe apps. The last two being so helpful for a base and go to for support. 
The biggest difference I feel with Reframe is the real factual descriptions of what happening daily to your mind chemically. The long and short term damages with long term use and benefits of recovery. 

I’ve always considered myself a social drinker. Denial to the fullest! I’m breaking up with my love affair with wine which is a 42 year love affair- though I knew I had become addicted, AA didn’t work for me. The shame, humiliation of the meetings and seeing people I’d see at meetings while at work (retail), they’d come up and ask oh are you going to the meetings anymore- I don’t see you, how are you- still sober? At my job! I couldn’t do it. But I tried on my own and that was futile- I’d end up going to the store eventually and buy wine. 

Low and behold I fell upon some notifications on Insta about this app. I truly went through detox, have ENJOYED learning about the physics of alcohol use and how it gets your brain into thinking the way it does. -What a manipulative jerk!😆- it’s amazing how much pressure I feel lifted. I put so much self doubt and pressure on myself- negative, self loathing- that I just didn’t see how to stop. When I started the program I went in fully- though I still don’t show my name or face in meetings- I’m attending when I can and listen to podcasts, and follow the schedules. I’m in Heaven, feel much more aware and still learning- forever! Thank you!!!

title: Life Changing!!
text: I have been a member of Reframe since Dec. 2021. This app has changed my life. While my journey has not been linear, Reframe has always offered the tools and options to help me in a non-judgmental, compassionate way. Everyone in the community is extremely supportive, and the Reframe administrative team has been exceptional at making sure this sense of acceptance and safety remains true at all times. I believe the biggest strength is that it is a science-based approach to what addiction really is. And you have a choice of paths- you can choose to be alcohol free or to mindfully moderat/cut back. This gives you the agency that so many of us need to actually affect change. And there is SOOO much to the app. The daily tasks include a robust set of short, information filled readings, followed by a thoughtful journal prompt that helps build your knowledge as you move through the process of changing your relationship with alcohol. It is filled with a plethora of other tools to provide support. The forum allows you to share your thoughts and experiences which are then supported by others. The multiple daily zoom meetings are incredibly powerful. There are tools to use when you have a craving, goal trackers, book and podcast recommendations, and the opportunity for personal coaching. There are monthly challenges that allow you to join with a small group of others to cheer and support one another. But I would say the most  powerful/impactful thing about Reframe is that you have an entire toolbox and community of real supportive, compassionate friends in your pocket at all times. Some might balk at the cost, but if you truly calculate how much you spend on alcohol in a single month, Reframe is a bargain-- and will SAVE you money as you also improve both your physical health! They say the opposite of addiction is connection, and Reframe is THAT connection.

title: Becoming an “Intentional” Drinker
text:
“Dry January” seems like an easy and socially-popular way to reset after the holidays. I was certainly up for it. But what I loved about Reframe was that it presented the opportunity to really evaluate and consider my relationship with alcohol: how it affected me; how it benefitted/harmed me; and when/why I would be willing to make the trade-off. 

I didn’t go into this thinking “I will now stop drinking forever.” But Reframe taught me to approach drinking with intention—why am I doing this? What do I really want out of this moment? Is a glass of wine really just a glass of wine, or do I really want a friend, a nap, a compliment, or a snack?   

I enjoyed the mix of articles, video chats, journal entries etc. Give it a try—you will learn something about alcohol and something about yourself.

title: Able to do what I couldn’t with Other Programs!   Costs less than what I was spending on booze!
text: I joined the app on 1/4/26 and I cannot express enough how ecstatic I am to have found Reframe.  1st, it s NOT like other programs, NOT AA!  NOT Deprivation!  Reframe helps me better understand the neuroscience behind why I drink, what alcohol does to my body and practical ways to either cut back or eliminate alcohol from my life (I’m currently on the Cut Back track).  In just 17 days, I’ve reduced my alcohol intake by 44%, I’ve had 2 Alcohol Free days each week —- something I never thought possible, and I truly see the opportunities ahead of me by improving my relationship with alcohol.  The app has so many tools and a variety of Zoom meetings every day, along with a very supportive community in both meetings and via the chat groups.  There is something very comforting in hearing other people’s stories and understanding “I’m not alone”.  And best of all, you can just be a “fly on the wall”, have your camera off, or choose to have your camera on and share if you feel moved to do so.  I’ve learned something from every “coach” and for once in my life, feel that I truly can be in control of my choices!  With a low or no cost 30 days to try it out, what do you have to lose?

I have a therapist that’s helped me through so much, but this was a private matter that Reframe helped me more than therapy was able to. I am now in a much better place with my drinking and therefore having a better relationship with myself and my friends/family. I feel better knowing reframe is there if I ever find myself wanting that support again. Get the app, do the challenges, do the work and you’ll thank yourself ❤️

title: The best investment you will ever make
text: I don’t even know where to begin to explain the many ways this app’s content has helped me change my relationship with alcohol and get to a better headspace. Over the years I’ve been through periods of frequent alcohol use, including drinking almost every day to unwind after working 80hr weeks for the last couple years. Since I’m finally done with education/training I don’t have nearly as much stress anymore, and I came to the realization with the help of the app that alcohol doesn’t serve me anymore and my alcohol use was a part of my identity that I didn’t want or need anymore. It’s only been a little over two months but I’ve made a lot of progress and am in the middle of a 30 days sober challenge when I can’t remember the last time I went two weeks straight without drinking. On top of that I went from drinking about 85-95% days of the week to only about 40%, and the quantity is a lot less as well. I have a lot of this journey ahead of me but I know with this app and all the hard work the developers and content contributors put in I can get there. The biggest help of this app is shedding light on why I drink in the first place and building better coping mechanisms and ways of thinking to get through life’s challenges without alcohol. There’s no better gift you can give yourself than becoming the happiest, healthiest, and best version of yourself and this app can help you do that for yourself when you put in the work.
author: J3NN\^/

title: Reframe saves my life!
text: Sounds extreme but it is true. i’m been questioning my relationship with alcohol for many years. I’ve tried many different ways to quit or cut back one lucky day Instagram’s algorithm pushed the Reframe app onto my feed. Reframe offered away to not quit completely, but cut back. This was tempting as I was in 100% sure that I wanted completely. However, I definitely needed to cut back in order to improve my health and my life. It was gonna teach me all about drinking and what it does to my body. It was going to offer me tasks to do every day to keep me accountable. It also has distractions built into the app that will help me when I have cravings… These are all things I learned about it or neon and well worth trying out. What I didn’t know was that the app was gonna bring me a community of people that would help support me through my sobriety journey. has a chat feature built-in that’s available 24 seven where I can connect with people ask questions and get support. There are also daily zoom meetings, where people come to listen connect and share about their sobriety journey. Those meetings have become my livelihood. There are coaches in those meetings that help moderate offer feedback and support.  A few short weeks into my cut back journey with alcohol. I decided to switch to quit completely. I’m close to 500 days sober. I have a new lease on life and I have this app to thank for it and his amazing  coaches and community.
author: Soni-Jez

title: Super helpful and doesn’t take long out of your day.
text: I’ve been using this app for a month now and already noticed better sleep and mood quality within the first two weeks. It isn’t magic. It takes work but the short daily articles and journaling and friendly non-judgmental reminders help tremendously. Whether you’re cutting back or quitting drinking, it is a great tool to give a shot. Do the month trial for $5 if you’re hesitant like I was. It helps so much with approaching your habit from a different perspective. There’s so much mental work that goes into changing habits and this reminds you that you can always switch your approach and always evolve and better yourself with healthy alternatives and healthy mindset. The accountability is a huge factor. Checking in with every drink you might have really sets the tone with a mind and body connection. There is no blindly grabbing a drink and not thinking about it. It makes you evaluate if you really want or need that drink. Seeing how much money and empty calories you save on a daily basis really puts things into perspective. The little tips and insights help a lot and I’ve even used them to help loved ones going thorough hard times of their own. It isn’t about just drinking. It’s about learning healthy behaviors and unlearning old habits and that’s something everyone can take advantage of; not just people looking to quit or cut back on drinking.
author: The Rhage

title: Life-changing
text:
This app has been incredibly helpful & I’m so glad I found it. I read one of those books a year or two ago to help me stop drinking, and I expected the app to be something like that. The book was helpful and I learned a lot but I think this app did more for me in just a few days, and now I have learned so so much more. I went from 1-2 glasses of wine every single day, for most of the last 8+ years, to 0. And that’s after trying and failing multiple times to stop within the last few years.  I have had a couple drinks here and there but haven’t had a real craving for weeks. It’s worth every penny & I recommend it to anyone who listens!

My only complaint is that if you don’t log in every single day and do the readings and exercises, it just skips ahead to the next day and so you miss out unless you go back. I can go back, but it’s really confusing and hard to keep track of all the days that I have missed, and in the meantime they just keep piling up. I wouldn’t care except the readings are so good and they do sometimes build on each other so who knows how much great stuff I’ve missed. I realize it would be a challenge to change that functionality but I doubt I’m the only one. I would be curious how many people are missing out. This is definitely not a reason not to download the app (download it!). Just a huge opportunity to make it better.
author: Sari H...

title: New beginnings
text:
I was stuck in a rut of daily drinking. I wanted to quit, but I couldn’t seem to put two sober days together in a row. I honestly felt like I would just try to get by that way, but my health was going downhill. Part of me really didn’t want to quit drinking.
I heard about the Reframe app on social media and looked into it briefly and then kind of forgot about it. Then one weekend I saw it again on the social media and started looking into it. It was hard for me to read it out loud to my wife, but I was interested in it so I continued.
I decided to sign up for 30 days and see what would happen. Out of the 30 days I only drank on 10 of those days.
Right now, I am participating in sober October and very excited about it.  In a little over 30 days I have slept better at night, got rid of anxiety, lowered my blood pressure, lowered my cholesterol, and lost weight. I also have a better relationship with my wife and doing better at work because I’m sleeping better at night. I feel more focused and not feeling like I’m in a fog.
I am happily surprised that I enjoy being sober and prefer being sober because I just feel so great now. I am going to continue with the Reframe app as I signed up for a year now. It is a great resource and if you’re on the fence about trying it out I say, just try it out. It’s working for me and that’s the truth.
author: ukeboy19

title: Game Changer
text: Over the years, since questioning my relationship with alcohol, I have done online sessions, schools, apps,etc to help me navigate my drinking. I have not wanted to fully quit but I have wanted to cut back. All things I had signed up for had some good stuff in it, but the reframe app has been by far the most amazing, helpful tool (for me) by far. I am absolutely obsessed with doing the daily tasks and learning things about my drinking I have never known or connected with (the science part of it). My favorite part of the app is that I can pop on any day of the week to the 30 min zoom calls for encouragement, support and ability to share my triumphs and downfalls with others who get it. There is zero shame and just so much love as we all navigate this together. The zoom leaders are absolutely awesome and so well spoken, educated on this subject and totally down to earth and relatable. I saw the app show up in my Instagram sponsored ads and kept seeing it but sat on it for quite some time. I finally decided to download it and can’t believe all that is available through it. I honestly can’t say enough about it. I’ve been doing it every day for 2 weeks straight. It’s become something I really look forward to and enjoy. Thank you sooooo much to the developers for creating this! You have been a godsend! 🙏🏻
author: Amy_444

title: A++ this app change my whole mindset
text:
I love this app so much I feel like it gave me the power back. never really thought I had a problem. do you know how when you go to a doctor and they ask you to fill out a form? How many drinks did you have this week and you make up a number you say like five? in reality, it really was like 2 to 3 drinks a night for me. and then on the football Sunday, they could end up being 10 drinks throughout the day, but who really counts. anyway, I actually set a goal because I didn’t want to stop drinking but I wanted to actually stick to a number and be accountable so I said a goal of eight drinks a week. The reason I said that gold because I wanted to give myself some grace if I wanted to have a drink, and I thought that was obtainable.

All the resources that this app provides gave me tools I didn’t know I needed. I have averaged no more than 11 drinks per month over the last hundred days. and I have a drink when I really want to have one, but not because of some of the triggered reasons that I used to have. It really is or has given me the power back. PS everything in my life is better, including my relationship with my family, which I thought was already fantastic but it’s even better thank you so much for creating this app. It’s super awesome.
author: Cgook

title: Good app but has limitations
text: I started out loving this app and it definitely is cool and has upsides. However, I'm using it for cutting back, not going totally dry. So the app asked me to set a weekly limit, which I did. It even suggested a higher weekly limit than I originally set...ok... Anyway you can't use a weekly limit the way I envisioned, because you have to assign drinks to certain days of the week, like I'll have 2 drinks on Wednesday. If you don't feel like drinking on Wednesday and instead have those 2 drinks later in the week on Saturday, the app says you have failed, even if you were below your weekly limit (which I have been consistently). I wrote to the help desk on this and apparently that can't be changed. It's annoying because I loved the "game" of how the app works, and I prefer to leave my week open ended rather than plan exactly what day I might drink. But that takes away the "game" for me, bc the app essentially tells me I'm a failure any time I drink on a different-than-planned day. It's also a challenge to move around in the app on different days for any activity other than tracking drinks. What do I mean? Each day has reading associated with it, and if you don't do the reading for a day ora couple days, the app offers to reassign you too the earlier days but then you can't read a few days worth at a time and move forward back to the real date. With the cost of the app fairly high, I'm disappointed in these details and not sure I'll renew. I do love the theme of the app and the idea of what they created, but it's got some limitations that I wish were worked out.
author: travel 3777

title: Truly a life changing app!
text: If you are living with a potentially harmful behavior, in this app, alcohol, and you want to change your relationship with that behavior, this app is for you! Each day you’ll encounter brief, thoughtful and meaningful tasks or activities: you’ll learn from the daily reading, be inspired by the motivation, act on what you’ve learned through brief, focused activities (short journaling, a self-assessment, a guided meditation, etc). Finally you’ll log your drinks each day. There are two “tracks” in the app: complete abstinence from alcohol, or “cut back” from alcohol. Each uses a roadmap to show you the path and your progress. When you’re seeking more connectivity with other “Refamers” check out the forum with multiple topics and groups. Check out the live ZOOM meetings (several a day) to be encouraged and supported as you explore your healthier new life. The numbers don’t lie. If you engage the app, honestly account for your drinks (you’re only lying to yourself if you don’t report the drinks as consumed) you WILL see improvement. Your life with change. Your body will heal. Your mind will grow. Weather you want to stop drinking altogether or want to cut back how much you do, you’ll find the support, tools and structure to do it. Do it! It’s worth every penny and more.
author: B727FA

title: If I could give this app & community 1,000 stars, I would.
text: I cannot say enough about how this app—including my fellow “Reframers”, the tools, resources AND the amazing coaches—has changed my experience of & with alcohol. In the past I have tried to cut back on my own, to no avail. I wanted to be healthier. I wanted to not spend so much $ on Prosecco. I wanted to wake up refreshed, or at least not exhausted. There were lots of whole-hearted or half-hearted attempts that went by the wayside. I never thought I could/would actually want to be sober. 24x365? Absolutely nope. Epiphanies happen. …Finding this app & community has changed everything. I now have a community and set of tools right in my hand, 24hrs a day, where I can lean in for support, or encourage others, and along the way learn the science behind my “relationship” with alcohol. Btw - I got divorced. Immediately. And I haven’t gone back. It’s an ex- I never want to succumb to again. This is a safe place to explore cutting back or quitting. Or just learning. Everything I have needed is here. And crazily enough, exactly when I needed it. Every day brings new tools & knowledge. Right when I seem to need that tool or wisdom. Uncanny. I am grateful beyond measure. I know that there is no one-size-fits-all, but for me, this is the perfect fit.
author: K2_64

title: Changed my life
text: I decided to try this app on the recommendation of a friend and after having seen ads for it. It has been a life changer! It’s not magic, you still have to put in the work but I have been using it daily for 5 minutes and it’s now a part of my routine. I paid for the full version and it easily paid back in savings from reducing alcohol in the first couple weeks. 100% worth it. My “A” goal was to greatly reduce my drinking as it had gotten to be an every day thing. At the very least I was hoping to cut my drinking back some. I decided to try to quit for a week and then two, then a month, and then had the audacious goal of making it one year. I just crossed that number and I’m now at day 376 of no alcohol. After a year it was an incredible sense of relief and freedom. I always tell people I didn’t quit drinking, I just drink as much as I want. And right now I don’t want to drink. Maybe I’ll drink occasionally again someday, maybe not. But I am absolutely loving my new life. The app is great because you can choose the quit or cutback tracks (I chose cutback) and there is a big social community where you can interact with people who are dealing with the same kinds of struggles as you. You are not alone! Check it out. Thank you Reframe!
author: patrickj35

title: Great App but Don’t Purchase the Coaching!
text: The app is fantastic for those recovering or on the journey to cut back and or to be alcohol free. Decent price at $40 annually. Great tools such as forums, multiple zoom check in sessions with coaches for those who need accountability, daily readings using scientific methods and analytics, podcasts, video libraries, courses, meditations, and much more. The biggest drawback is signing up for personalized coaching sessions which is $249 a month for 3 sessions. The coaches are certified coaches, no problem there. What isn’t clear when signing up is how the sessions work, there’s not enough terms explained. Such as you must use the sessions within the time frame you are charged or you loose them, they don’t carry over. What can be hard is that life can get in the way of scheduling those sessions especially during the holidays. I ran into this problem with my own schedule AND with the coach and her own schedule. Reframe also didn’t notify me via email to put the invite on my Google calendar so the coach had to notify Reframe to fix our schedules and that had happened to me and her other clients that week. Instead of charging a set # of sessions with in a month, you should be able to pay as you go for each session as it is in the real world when you schedule face to face therapy sessions. I was not happy that I lost out on my 3 unused sessions to Reframe.
author: ladymharris

title: It works!
text:
I’m writing to express profound gratitude as I celebrate my 100th day of being alcohol free - the version of me I’ve always wanted to become, thank you! I'm deeply grateful for the impact your app has had on my life. Your program has been the resource I needed to transform my relationship with alcohol. The daily accountability check-ins were so effective combined with the gentle encouragement and science / psychologically based short daily readings. Also I greatly benefitted from the Reframe community posts where I both gave and received support. The new ways of thinking about things that you provided helped me rediscover myself. The app helped me develop ‘the why I want to quit drinking' and reminded me of that each time I logged in. From there I was able to achieve my goal: I want to cut back on drinking so that I learn to create the high feeling without alcohol to be more productive in my side hustle. I made an AI short that honors the journey to becoming alcohol-free using your wave metaphor for riding out cravings that I found so helpful. (NoonTide@BookQuotes Remix) Thank you for creating such a powerful resource for those of us seeking a better way forward. Your work has undoubtedly changed countless lives, including mine.

With heartfelt gratitude, Rachel
author: 8Chairs

title: Motivation and Support
text:
Reframe has taken me from shame and desperation to an enthusiastic, informative and incredibly supportive, nonjudgmental and interactive exploration of my relationship with alcohol. Along with goals and trackers, there are options for personalized support groups and forums. Of special interest to me are the personalized group options. In three months I have shifted from sober curious to moderation and am now forty four days alcohol free. The decision just makes sense.

Especially fun and helpful is the option to connect with others in similar circumstances, even if their goals differ from mine. I joined both the Working Musicians and Sober in a Mountain Town (who even knew that was a thing?) groups. There are also daily virtual support groups I initially dropped in on without pressure to participate, or even turn on the microphone or video. I have gone from fly-on-the-wall to entering the chat thread. The accessibility allows me to carry my posse with me, on my phone, in the face of the seemingly perpetual free-alcohol and alcohol-heavy social scene presented by my work and relationships. 

Finally, I have not, for one second regretted the investment I have made in myself. The cost for an entire year of basic involvement, which is the level I am presently on, is less than ten drinks (before a tip!) or an hour of counseling where I live. I am managing my relationship better and am moving from shame to pride in my decisions and accomplishments. I hope this review reeks of gratitude. Reframe won’t claim credit for success, but they can take full credit for encouraging me and providing me with resources and space to restore it in my life. Check it out and decide for yourself.
author: Love the Mountins

title: Reframe content & the app is amazing!
text:
I was so doubtful when I downloaded this and really didn’t think I would benefit from it. But their first statement upfront is that if you don’t believe it can work, it won’t work for you. It’s a mindset. And I can tell you from buying the one year subscription 7 days ago, I already got my money’s worth. I was just trying to reduce my drinking and I haven’t had a drink in seven days. It’s because they teach so much about the impact on your brain and your organs in your body. It’s not about willpower or self-control. It’s about deciding to prioritize your health and well-being, your motivation and your ability to do more during the day. There’s no doomsday scare tactics, no shame, no judgment.

All of the content is so well put together and it varies every day and it’s customized to your personal goals. And they ask all of the right questions and give inspiration and challenges each morning.

I really find myself motivated by the community. Normally, I avoid forums and communities related to health care skin care because it’s a lot of the repeat. But this group is so inspiring and real, non-judgmental and in the fire with you. Thank you so much!
author: travelingfiend

title: Helpful tool, a great start for the sober curious
text: I’ve been a heavy drinker for close to a decade, and have made dozens of attempts to stop drinking. For me it took hitting rock bottom. Pancreatitis, so much pain, and finally surrendering to rehab. If you’re reading this: please don’t do this alone! There are so many of us just like you out there!!! That being said, I know it’s scary and I avoided it for years…and in the meantime my small efforts were supported by reframe. It’s a wonderful online community with daily virtual meetings and so many tools to help keep you on track. I’ve used it on and off for years and when I feel lonely/angry/tired (whatever negative emotion), I know I can hop in and sit with others or do some light reading to help me reset. My only complaint is you will run into members who tend to overshare/take time away from others chance to share, but the moderators do a nice job of making sure everyone gets a chance to speak who would like to. <3 If you’re miserable and every day is melting together and you want to end the toxic cycle, please please please ask for help. You can detox at your local ER and AA groups are everywhere! Sponsors are everywhere! Support and community is so crucial. Sending hugs stranger, you have the power to change your life.
author: Colie9706

title: App sent by Angels
text: Eight days ago I was hopeless and thinking of ways to end my life! I recently walked away from a career making a very healthy six figure salary. I just felt my brain was so fried I could no longer be a leader, a good husband or father. I had downloaded the Reframe app four days prior. I don’t even remember where I found it? However, I followed it everyday and although the information was spot on I was still having an occasional drink just about all four of those days. I was still in a very bad place. The suicidal thoughts became stronger and stronger until I completely broke down in front of my wife crying, shaking and telling her I no longer wanted to live anymore! We talked for over an hour while I was completely exhausted she watched me fall asleep, keeping her eyes on me all night long. I woke up the next day and said to myself I’m going to take this app reframe more seriously. Although the last eight days didn’t come with its struggles I have remained alcohol free consistently following Reframe. I am finally starting to understand how it is really helping me! I know I have a L O N G way to go but I’m now feeling some hope for my future! THANK YOU DEVELOPERS OF REFRAME!!!!❤️
author: Scorpion1117

title: Worked for a stubborn doctor
text: By my very nature, I tend to be a “go it alone”kinda guy. At 47 years old, that has worked great in some areas and been disastrous in others. I’m successful and well educated, and so I assumed I would be able to control alcohol on my own. I’m a doc. I know all the negative effects it has on my health. I have a family and I see the effects it has on them. I know how I feel after I’ve been drinking. That argh!!! I did it again feeling. This app has been a true life safer! I downloaded it at a low point when I was desperate for something. Anything. I’ve prayed till I was in tears that I could get my act together, and while I thought that would come by God giving me a miraculous desire to not want to drink, he didn’t. What he did give me was an iPhone. And an App Store. And an app named Reframe. Turns out that In my case, God wanted to use an app to help me do the work of getting my life under control. Turns out, God does work in ways that are not always of our understanding. I’ll be praying that someone might read this and that you will find it helpful in your journey. You got this!!! LETS GO!!!!
author: DenverbroncosPmac

title: One Pretty Big Gripe
text:
I have already left this comment to them within the app and I received a response that my concern (detailed below) is due to privacy issues. Not sure I understand that “why” as I have private information stored across many apps  

If you are super involved in this app you will notice that there are many spaces to enter your thoughts on topics in Daily Tasks, take a lot of time to consider prompts in Challenges in the discover section and do some thoughtful, comprehensive journaling. I like these mindful opportunities but and incredibly disappointed that the information and app use is not parallel between an iPhone and an iPad. Not only does the information entered between the two devices not match up, neither do my current statistics on dates. So, if you download, decide first if it’s easier for you to type on your phone or tablet. If I’d known, I would have started this journey on my iPad. Journaling your stream of consciousness “for 5 minutes” on your phone is not very productive. You may ask, “so what’s the big deal having two different sets of information stored on two different devices?”  When you put this much work into your well-being and want to review your progress at the end of the day, it’s simply not convenient to chill with two different devices. 

Other than that, I’m really pleased with this app: the Daily Tasks, the challenges, the courses, access to daily Zoom meetings, the forum (happy the developers added the functionality of responding to comments using the @), the toolkit options and so much more. I have tried going alone and traditional closed-door meetings which did not work, but this app has had a huge impact for helping reset my thinking on the negative affects of alcohol. For that, I’m very grateful.
author: Halz3000

title: Want anonymous help? Here is your lifeline.
text: I am on day 9 with the app and my wife asked me last night if I was using it and if it was at all helpful. I informed her without hesitation that it was the best money I have ever spent and the fact that I recall the conversation is indicative that it works. I love it and even chat with others, which I do nowhere else on any other app platform to include social media. It gives one struggling with addiction help and hope through science and information, and gives you an anonymous battle buddy struggling with the same issues 24/7 on the chat (which is more like a helpline for those in a dark place and accolades/reinforcement center for those winning the battle). I am a 51 year old male, career law enforcement officer with a closet full of PTSD from witnessing human tragedy over the last 27 years, and have tears of thankfulness streaming down my face as I write this humbling review. I hope the developers see this and they understand that they probably have saved my life. I love you guys, and I am completely sober while saying so! Seriously, thank you for the second chance at life.
author: Kurdogg

title: Snarky Customer Service
text:
I sent my trial cancel request on day 7 of the free 7 day trial.  However, they already processed the charge for annual renewal of nearly $130.  When I contacted them for help processing a refund as the annual renewal fee was more than I could pay at that time, they couldn’t find my subscription.   Then central Texas had the ice storm which delayed me from following up with them for a week or two.   When I did, I forgot where we last left it.  However, they reminded me they’ve already helped me and sent screenshots to prove it.    Each email from them after that was to continue to tell me they already told me how to request a refund through the apple App Store with more screenshots to prove it.  

For a company whose goal is to help people overcome their bad alcohol habits which is something I wholeheartedly support and view as a higher calling, they really don’t display the ability to serve others (aka customer service).   Not once did they open the door for me to change my mind or come back at a later time, or offer to switch my renewal to the lower monthly fee.  Not sure how this app has received so many higher ratings.  

My hope is that they read this, and take it to heart so that they improve their customer service before it puts off others from what may be a very valuable service.
author: Gen X’er

title: Surprisingly effective
text: My work has been especially stressful over the last year and I’ve developed a modest 1-2 glass of wine per night habit. It bothered me that I felt like I couldn’t not drink every day, even when I told myself I wouldn’t. And it had started as just a glass of wine, but was gradually becoming 2 glasses every time. So I also started feeling like crap in the morning and I felt like it really was affecting my mood. The app came across my Instagram and I gave it a shot without much expectation. Pretty much immediately, I was able to cut back. The exercises and especially the articles shed light on what was happening physiologically and somehow it made it easier to abstain. I still drink, but I try not to drink at home. I’ve backtracked a couple times but now that I have some sense of control over it, I don’t want to lose it. And the nature of what alcohol does to our brains makes it difficult to consciously control once the habit is formed. I don’t need the calories, I don’t need the Band-Aid over a bad mood, and I don’t need the guilt. Trying to be a social drinker exclusively now. Highly recommend.
author: shamusmccrackin

title: Trust Me, Stick with Reframe and You'll See a Whole New Side to Your Relationship with Alcohol
text:
Discovering the Reframe app has been a transformative experience for me. This isn't just an app; it's a lifeline to a community and a treasure trove of content that speaks directly to the heart of those seeking to change their relationship with alcohol. For so long, I believed that moderation was the key, but Reframe opened my eyes to the reality that for me, cutting back was not enough. The decision to stop completely was monumental, and it wouldn't have been possible without the invaluable insights and unwavering support I found through Reframe.

What sets Reframe apart is its holistic approach to sobriety. The app doesn't just focus on the act of stopping; it delves deep into the 'why' behind our behaviors, equipping us with the knowledge, strategies, and support to make lasting changes. The community aspect of Reframe is unparalleled. There's a genuine sense of belonging, an understanding that you're not navigating this journey alone. The encouragement and confidence I've received from fellow members have been instrumental in my ongoing commitment to sobriety.

Reframe is more than an app; it's a partner in recovery, offering a blend of compassion, science-based methods, and a judgment-free zone that fosters real, sustainable change. I only wish there were a similar app by the same developers focused on quitting vaping. The effectiveness and positive impact of Reframe have me convinced that such an app would be incredibly beneficial for those of us looking to conquer other habits. To anyone on the fence about trying Reframe, I cannot recommend it highly enough. It's not just about stopping; it's about finding a new way to live, and Reframe guides you through every step of that journey.
author: Sarah Key West

title: A Life Changer!
text: Initially I got this app to reduce drinking but now I realized how much better I feel when not drinking that I switched to alcohol free! My lab work is better than it has been my whole adult life and am much more productive as well as peaceful. What I love about this app is that they tell you the science behind the how your relationship with alcohol affects you. They don’t shame you at all and give plenty of positive reinforcement. I don’t feel guilty for not going on in a while (when I was drinking) because everyone is so supportive. The community is always encouraging and authentic. There are meetings via Zoom that you can just listen in on or type in the chat or share if you feel up to it! So far, I have only listened and typed in the chat but when people do share, only support and love is expressed. If you are thinking of cutting back or stopping entirely, I greatly recommend giving it the 7 day free trial and see how it goes. The subscription is so worth it. Paying for that is much less than I would have spent on alcohol in a few months. Hope to see you in the forum!
author: FishieFun

title: The right kind of help
text: I had been trying to cut back my 1-3 glasses of wine per night in order to loose weight for almost a year. I struggled immensely. Then I found Reframe and came to understand what alcohol does to my body and my brain which makes it so hard to quit. With the help of the app I have dramatically cut back my alcohol intake over the last six months. The app gives you the support to really understand what is going on in your body, why you feel the way youfeel and why it is so darn hard to cut back. Now I understand you don't have to hit rock bottom to want to quit or cut back alcohol which is what the American culture tells us. I feel better, sleep better, and have more energy now. When I walk into a social setting I have planned out if I want to drink or not that evening and have the tools to support my choice. I recently went to a 3 day in person work event and drank only 1 day. It has become so much more than just cutting out calories. I feel 1,000 times better physically and mentally than I did six months ago and I’m going to stick with it.
author: udnevyndbrh

title: Life Changing - Literally
text: This app is changing my whole life. I can not think of a more valuable app to me than this one. I have been able to make huge changes in my life that I never thought would be possible. There are forums to post to, you can comment on other people’s posts, zoom meetings that we can join, meditation options, challenges to join, book clubs to join daily tasks to complete so we can figure out why we do the things we do. There is SO MUCH KNOWLEDGE here to learn. It is absolutely amazing and I am so happy that these people who have created this app care so much about other people that they have made me so grateful. I know I am not the only one who feels this way.  It is truly changing my life. I would not be sober without this app. I am telling you that I would have gone back to drinking a long time ago and now that I am so far into my sobriety, I am never going back. I have gained so much and have a completely lovely life in front of me. I am 1000% grateful. Thank you 💗 I hope this helps someone else give it a try. I’m so glad I did. 👍
author: Trishy188

title: Mind blowing
text: I have never been an everyday drinker but lots of weekends and social events a binge drinker. I always had the nudging to let it go , to give up drinking, for the most part everything else in my life is pretty put together. When this app kept popping up on Instagram I decided to look in to it finally. I took the plunge for a month and halfway through the month signed up for the entire year. The coaches, the community, the teachings the bonds I am making with others really has been mind blowing to me. It is basically joining with others to share about our experiences and our journeys and supporting one another while’s learning the science behind alcohol. The meetings have been life saving in so many different aspects of my life. It teaches you how to cope with life on life’s terms. I would highly recommend this app to anyone. Thank you for the changes I have made in my life. I do know it comes down to the individual having to put in the work but with the love and support form this community it makes it so doable. 🙏❤️😘
author: (LittleTiny1) @jodi4kidz

title: Good Info, Inspirational, but sometimes
text: I started Reframe about five weeks ago. It offers real science and social science research as well as medical information. I find the information relevant and applicable. However, I joined as “sober curious” so I’ve not quit alcohol, but cutting back. So, Reframe’s positive feedback to a user still drinking isn't necessarily aligned with drinking, rather it is encouraging the user to keep completing Reframe’s daily tasks. I guess that positive feedback with no judgement is working because I do keep coming back every day. Plus, no reason to lie to myself or the app about still drinking, because there’s no judgement. Meanwhile, it does help you track how much you are drinking, when, where, and WHY! That’s the most important: the WHY. Now that I’ve used Reframe everyday—multiple times a day for certain tools and resources I’m discovering how much content Reframe. My buddies achievement so far, and it’s big for me, is mindfulness and letting go of self-shaming. I think that change, with the daily help from the Reframe app, will get me to where I truly want to be: conscious, controlled minimal drinker. Meaning, I want to allow myself to enjoy a holiday or congratulatory drink on occasion rather than a reactive drinker seeking to numb myself through stress and distress. My new morning routine is using Reframe the first 15-20 mins over a cup of coffee to frame my day with useful physical and mental information along with a self-inventory and some inspiration or encouragement to (re-)focus my attention to self-regulating through mindfulness (pause, assess, journal, meditate, stretch…simple things that grow in effectiveness the more you do them). And, I appreciate the nudges to complete the tasks. I am very grateful for this thoughtful, well designed app.
author: justramsey

title: A great tool
text: My sister invited me to a “dry January” challenge. Sure, I thought…I’ll do it..uncertain if I would be successful because I didn’t have much motivation.  I rarely drink but I do enjoy alcohol during social gatherings and when I go out to eat to compliment my meal. However, this app really opened my mind to the benefits of cutting back or going alcohol free. The month actually flew by. Sure, there were times I wanted to drink, like a friend’s birthday party, but I stuck with it! The app is very educational and I learned so much. The gamification and supportive nature of the app make it motivating. I also love that it tracks sugar calories avoided and $ saved! After a night out in LA my two girlfriends and I added up how much we saved between alcohol and uber rides, and wow! $$$ Even when dry January was over I still kept using the app as sort of a health and education tracker. I am now starting “Dry June” (although I think I need to give it a catchier name) and I know I’ll be successful with this app. It was a worthwhile investment. I think everyone should get it!
author: LovinLifeATT

title: My teeth and weight
text:
I am only on my second week of achieving sobriety and the improvement in the quality of my life is immeasurable. Last night, for the first time, I was able to go down to the dock of our lake house drinking ice water and enjoying the evening while my husband was drinking alcohol. 

The first 5 days were tough~ lots of negative symptoms: insomnia, restless leg syndrome in bed, constipation, dull headache, and overall restlessness. I’m still sleeping in the guest room, but actually slept the sleep of angels last night. I’m losing weight, swimming every day, and now waking up cheerful and full of energy. The best part of this journey is probably unique to me. I am no longer grinding my teeth at night. When I was drinking (more than I should every night since I retired), I would wake up every morning with my teeth and gums aching all day. My dentist warned me that I was critically injuring my enamel. I tried different mouth guards only to find them on the floor in the morning. Thank you Reframe; I’m not sure I could have done this without you.
author: Mainemags

title: Practical and effective
text: I have been using Reframe for two months, and it is the best tool I have used so far to significantly cut back on drinking alcohol. And I’ve tried a lot of things! I have been religious about the daily check-in and tasks, and I like the accountability of logging how much I drink each day. It’s a great feeling to have days in a row where I am able to log zero. The daily tasks are very practical and focused on changing mindset and the desire to drink. The longer I use it, the more connected I feel to myself and my desire to have a clear head and a healthy brain. Sometime the tasks seem a little long and you have to do one in order to unlock the next task on a given day. I think it would be nice if you could skip around a little bit. But the first one every day, the educational reading, is almost always very motivating and educational. I highly recommend this app for those who are trying to find a way to cut back on their drinking (so we don’t eventually have to give it up altogether!)
author: Boom boom clap

title: Iove this App!
text: I have been no saint over the years. The more I read or listen to all the insightful info regarding the affected of alcohol in our body, relationships with others and first most the relationship and love for myself; the easier it is to Just an say No, or to cut back on drinking. . I love the daily tasks on the APp.. They don’t take long, maybe 5-7 mins a day. They aren’t required to be completed  in one sitting. I have completed a couple group  zooms including Tapping and Anxiety associated with drinking . Both were very informative. For some reason I processes things in more of a scientific way. If you are more into full on spiritual growth when it comes to drinking too much; well then this may not be your best bet. I believe in a higher power but I find the scientific facts to be more my personal approach. I say give it a shot and stay accountable each day for just a few minutes. Best wishes in your journey. I hope this review gives you an even better idea of what this app is all about. I love it!!!
author: MoBubs

title: Powerful helper
text: I had tried to cut back on my drinking unsuccessfully for ~5 years. January 2021 I downloaded the full paid version of this app and decided to cut back to 4 drinks per week, coming from a weekend partier/binger that was a drastic cut back. I loved all the information about alcohol and all the resources for handling cravings especially. On January 12th I switched my app setting from cutting back to quit. I haven’t had a drink since. That is 250 days sober! I have found a life I didn’t even knew existed outside of alcohol and I know this app had a ton to do with it. Guiding me through what I might expect at various timelines after quitting (sugar cravings!) lots of real evidence and science about alcohol and the benefits of not drinking really helped me feel good about my decision. I don’t feel like I “can’t drink” I feel like this app helped me realize I don’t “need to” drink and frankly don’t WANT to! It was worth the money. I made it part of my daily routine to do each days lesson. I contribute this app to my success, flat out!
author: Jane0

title: It really works.
text: I was a daily drinker for 20+ years. I have tried to quit before and couldn’t do it. The combination of warnings from my doctor and using the Reframe app finally worked. Reframe worked for me because it logically and simply laid out the harm that I was doing to my brain, my heart, my health, my skin, etc. by drinking so much. That, combined with daily check-ins, educational and motivational topics, plus the Reframe Community.  I can’t say enough about how helpful the Reframe community is. In the beginning, I sought reassurance, but after a month or so, found myself giving reassurance and advice. It was incredibly empowering. I would read and respond to posts for up to an hour each night. I love the anonymity of it!  Those still suffering through the early days of not drinking reinforced my decision not to drink. Those who have been sober for a while inspired me. I’m so glad I found this app!  I now have more energy and more confidence. I’ve lost weight, my skin looks better and my blood pressure is down.
author: regnillo6

title: This app is phenomenal
text:
I have been using this “app” for 2 months now. First this is more than just an app. There are community meetings that members get access to. It’s very hard to change drinking behavior without some personal support. There are various levels available of that available here. 

The founders of this app have very deep experience in alcohol addiction and general wellness practices. I’ve done my share of therapists and personal growth work in the past and yet I am still learning a lot here. The app packs a lot into it. From daily readings that build on each other, to an online forum where you can post and get feedback or give encouragement to fellow members, to various challenges, to exercises and practices to get you through cravings, etc. I have only listed the main stuff. I still haven’t gone through half of it. The available material grows every week. What I am learning and getting support here is helping me in work and in relationships and in many aspects of my life beyond drinking.
author: Tom3G

title: Reframe Works
text:
Ok, another app. Another impulse. This app is  fantastic because it is neuroscience and not a set of rules that require you to be meek and remorseful, and instantly adhere to a religious dogma you may not agree with from the start. For skeptics like me, I have to get my feet wet before I will go in all the way. Reframe gives you  the option of how you want to define your relationship to alcohol use.  Are you cutting back or are you quitting? I really like this. 
No shame. No guilt. By using the tool kit every day, I am going to spend 10 minutes learning about the physical effects of alcohol on the brain. Some chapters are about emotional response, triggers, impulses, and psychology. And there's one on one help or a forum if you need more support. It's been a terrific education, and my health and other habits have even improved. My relationship with alcohol has changed for the better. I am healthier, clearer-minded, and am living my best life. 
I even got my brother to join and he's doing great. Thank you, Reframe.
author: halpiro

title: Very helpful and supportive app
text:
This is my first app review, and I have to say there are a lot of pros vs. cons. The forum posts are helpful (it’s nice to read and respond to others who are in the same or different parts of their journey, whether you are cutting back or going alcohol free). I like the daily tasks; it helps center my day and the meditations are also really helpful. I’ve attended two of the zoom calls and there’s no pressure to turn on your mic or your camera so you can just listen in or chime in if you would like. 

My one main complaint is that for every day since I’ve started, I’ve had technical issues with the daily tasks. I get to the third task, click on it, and it’s always a blank screen. I have to report the bug daily and I’m not able to advance to the next task until the bug is fixed. The thrive tips can also be blank. It’s a very frustrating as part of the user experience. 

Other than that, keep up the great work and know that your app is a lifeline to those who need support and have nowhere to turn.
author: Lil birdie girl

title: This works!
text: I started out with Reframe as a way to cut back on my drinking. It had become too much of a reflex habit every evening after work. I made the decision that I wanted to have a clear mind and live a longer productive life. I found the app to be very informative and practical. Helping me to understand both the psychological and physical effects of alchohol. What started out as cutting back turned into my choice of NOT drinking at all. I was put in many situations from events to family/friends who tried to encourage me to “have 1”, “are you still on the wagon?”.  The app helped me to learn how to deal with peer pressure in a positive way. I’m happy to say that I have not had a drink in 13 months! I feel better, sleep better, have a clear mind and have been armed with the information I need to continue my journey. Thank you Reframe! You truly made a difference! I encourage anyone who’s considering wanting to cut back or cut out alchohol completely to give it a try.
author: JB thankful

title: Low expectations high results
text: I went into the trial thinking it wouldn’t help me quit drinking and I’d probably have to get naltrexone. After 4 days I felt I was not only capable of quitting on my own but willing to do so. I wanted to quit for 1 month but after all that I’ve learned in the first 14 days of the trial, I decided to quit for a full year- to reintroduce myself and my children to who alcohol free Katie/Mom was. The app helps by combining science/evidence with thoughtful therapeutic advice which allow even the weakest person achieve their goal. You don’t have to make excuses for yourself anymore, you can do this and this app will make it easy, it will help you on your hardest days. You’re no longer white knuckling cravings, you’re learning coping mechanisms that’s will help you with any kind of mental difficulty in the future. It freakin feels great to say I’m 31 days; 1 month alcohol free, I’m not scared, sad, anxious, or suffering right now. Give it a try, your future self will thank you.
author: Katiezorz

title: I never write a review but…
text: I decided to write one for this app because it has actually changed my relationship with alcohol very significantly from a dependency to a nice to have. I didn’t really think Bout how much I was drinking until I actually started tracking in the app and it was hard to get my goal right. I had gone on vacation and drank a lot and then read an article that like 70% of young people who drink aren’t necessarily alcoholics but are dependent. I recognized that in myself. As I progressed through the course I realized when I was having a craving and was able to reduce it. I’m over 3 months in and still doing my daily tasks to get to genius level! I now enjoy the buzz of a single drink when I’m drinking and am able to say no to alcohol even when everyone else is drinking. I recognize I still have a ways to go to stay on track but it’s cool to address all the psychology behind dependency and dedicate myself to lifelong habit changes.
author: Nikki GW

title: It works
text:
I am 45 days in and I am amazed at how much I have cut back my drinking. I have had one hangover, but other than that I am feeling great, have lost weight, my skin looks better, my face looks thinner, and best of all I feel amazing on Saturday and Sunday mornings :) This is not an overnight fix, and the first few weeks are very difficult. My “goal” had been to not go over 4 drinks a week. I have had weeks with no drinks, or under my goal and that is HUGE for me. I have been binge drinking (mainly on weekends) for more than 20 years. 

You will also learn through the daily lessons how alcohol affects your brain/mental health. And you start to heal. I have also been struggling with depression off and on during covid and after the end of a long term relationship. Alcohol was getting in the way of my recovery. My relationship ended in Sep of 2021, and today is the best I’ve felt in a really long time. Im starting to have clarity, and importantly, hope again.
author: PSPJT

title: A Life hack for a better life!!
text: Reframe is so much more than an app to cut back or go alcohol free! It definitely does that and it does that well. However, it also provides a varied and extensive toolkit for how to create the best version of yourself and to thrive. Yes, it has helped me become alcohol free which was my goal, however, it has also helped me to systematically change my thinking and build healthier habits which in turn has made my a happier, more content person. I wasn’t expecting that in an app.  When reviewers call it “life changing”, it’s legit. I’ve learned there is a cognitive loop whereby our emotions impact our thoughts which impact our actions. Said another way, what we think influences how we feel which influences how we act. Change one item in the loop and it changes the other two. This is just one example of the amazing things you will learn if you use this app. It will transform your life if you use it. Download it today!
author: jenanba1232

title: Hopeful
text: Took my first real break from alcohol back in August, 2022. Didn’t know how dependent I was to alcohol until about 24 hours in. The withdrawals began & It was intense. Cold sweats, hallucinations, no sleep, super depressed and anxious etc. Did 10 days sober, felt good and decided to try out the whole moderation thing. That one drink would easily turn into a bender, and then a terrible hangover Monday morning that I had to deal with at work. Id quit again, and would keep experiencing a more mild withdrawal each and every time! It’s been on and off & I decided to try out Reframe! This is the most hopeful I’ve been during this sobriety. Nothing but encouraging & knowing that I’m not alone in this. I’m now day 6 sober & this time it’s for good. Even went to a bar last night with some friends that drink, and I just stuck to some lemonade & wasn’t even tempted at all. I feel too good to give up now. So thankful for this app. I finally have hope in my sobriety!
author: Dennishev

title: Super insightful & easy to do!
text: I’m not going to lie; I downloaded this app and waited probably two weeks before I even opened it and created a profile, and it probably took me another week and a half two weeks even to start using it. Definitely a slow go at first, but the more I used it, the more interested I was to use it. You learn so much about how your body and brain function and your own motivations to drink. Thankfully there’s not long journal that you have to do which is super helpful for me; I am not into the whole sit for an hour & pull out your childhood traumas kind of person. I love the Ted talks and all of the video information and little articles that they have that you can read. The mediations are great & inspiring as well. I like to listen to these in the am before / while getting ready for work. 100% recommend; this is a great way to analyze your relationship with alcohol & if you need more help or not. ✌🏼
author: Halehelene

title: Game changer!
text: This app has changed my life, honestly. Paired with a strong support network, this app has been the only thing that has made a difference. I have tried and failed to quit drinking more times than I can count and never got past 10 days. Today I am 24 days sober with forever to go. The neuroscience approach made a massive difference vs more spiritual or 12 step programs. They both have merits but this one has managed to shift the way my brain thinks and blames myself for how Ive gotten. It is a subscription service but it is 100% worth it for all of the features that come with it. I look forward to completing my tasks and and it is an irrevocable part of my morning routine. It is there for me when I have cravings, when I want a meditation, when I need a distraction, and there is even a social component that is really nice to have in my back pocket. I tell everyone I meet about this app. Best investment I’ve ever made into myself.
author: d0pedupd0lly

title: LIFE CHANGER APP!
text:
I love everything about this app, it’s brilliant! I wish I had this app 6 years ago. I’ve been wanting to cut back/give up alcohol for so long. I didn’t even know about this whole online sober community, but i am so glad it exists! 

This app has been life changing for me, I downloaded it on a whim didn’t really know what to expect. I love that it talks about the neuroscience and psychology of alcohol. I’ve learned so much about how alcohol effects your mind and body, the whole science behind it. I HAD NO IDEA, that alcohol is an addictive drug. Society has normalized drinking. I love that this app helps hold you accountable. It has daily journal prompts, facts on alcohol, motivation quotes, recovery stories, coaching, and forums where you can connect with other people who are going thru the same thing! 

I finally don’t feel alone and love that I’ve made so many connections in just the last month! I rave about this app to all my friends and family, even my therapist! It really is life changing and I look forward to this app every morning. I haven’t had a craving to drink for almost 40 days now and don’t plan on going back to it ever again. It was just what I needed to get sober and stay sober. I’ve taken breaks here and there but have always felt so lost and felt so judged or alone. Like I said this APP SAVED ME 🤩💖

Whether you’re sober curious, want to get sober or just want to learn more about alcohol and your relationship with alcohol, this is a great app! 10/10 highly recommend this app!! 🙌🏼
author: annnl10

title: Great stuff but some shortcomings…
text:
This app is full of great information and tools to help you cut back or abstain from alcohol. The glaring thing it’s missing is you cannot connect to other users or create your own groups or anything of the sort. There is a general forum but that is all. So if you want to make your own group of people who want to go alcohol free for 30 days or save another user who is having a similar journey to you, too bad. Someone had to post their phone number in a forum just to be able to connect with other users. I am someone who doesn’t use any social media and this is the one app where I would like to be able to follow other users and have the ability to creat groups. This is a massive omission in an expensive app that is supposed to build support systems for its users.

UPDATE:  they actually implemented a bunch of the things I complain about in this review!  But there are still some glaring omissions in user features.  I also removed a star because of multiple bad interactions with their support team.
author: Jerry Sizzlers

title: Truly effective- one of the most worthwhile apps around
text: This app does exactly what the name says- it reframes your perception of alcohol consumption. It doesn’t use scare tactics or guilt mongering or any of that. It uses real psychology and neuroscience to help you understand your cravings for alcohol and how to be more mindful around them (I am using it to cut back as opposed to quit- you can go either path and both are effective). What started out as a dry Jan free trial companion turned into a year subscription because I really see the value. It goes deep into your life and helps you both understand not only why alcohol has the pull that it does, but also how to better organize your life and mind so that alcohol doesn’t need to be a solution for anything that could be fixed in healthy ways. It’s difficult to articulate the incredible value of this service. They have a great free trial so you truly have nothing to lose by checking it out.
author: Allthegoodnamesaretaken510

title: Can’t recommend enough!
text: I don’t ever leave app reviews…ever lol. I’ll make an exception for this one though because it has immensely improved my life. What sets this sobriety app apart from the rest are the resources available to you and the ability to add drinks to your diary without resetting your start date. The latter specifically really helped me with the shame of a slip ups and allowed me to move forward without feeling like I was starting from the bottom again. You can tell that the creators of this really know how difficult it is to struggle with addiction by the care they put into this app. The community is great in the forum, you’ll have access to online check-ins/workshops, and guided meditations available for you when the cravings hit. The name of the app says it all. Reframe your mind and you’ll find peace. Thanks to the creators for this 🙏🏼🙏🏼 and if you’re struggling yourself, this one is 100% worth the purchase.
author: yaneck2254

title: Honestly wasn’t expecting this
text: I tried Reframe as a trial period. I never thought I needed therapy (I don’t cope well by talking to a stranger). And to be completely honest, I forgot about the trial period ending and was charged for a year. At first I was upset but decided to try out the app. I’m about 20 days in and think this is what I needed. Yes I still drink (my goal was never to quit completely) but the knowledge it gives you, along with the inspiration and actually explaining why we drink and ways to slow it down, is truthfully priceless. Not to mention it’s way cheaper than therapy. I’m not saying this is a substitute, some people need therapy. But for people like me who need a push in the right direction this is such a great app. I’m pretty sure there is support too to talk to people. I haven’t used it but the in app program they have set up is about as good as I could ask for. Well worth it for anyone thinking about it
author: Fred… Again & Again

title: So impressed
text: This app is like a little therapist/cheerleader/teacher/AA meeting in your pocket. After researching naltrexone and other ways to reduce my drinking, I stumbled across this app and I am blown away. This is not an all or nothing situation. You can still drink. Just Set your goals. Complete daily tasks. Gets rewarded. Learn! Learning what happens when we drink has helped me reduce my drink count during the week. If you have 12 drinks a week, your first goal could be 11 drinks per week. If you don’t meet your goal, the app doesn’t make a big deal about it. It just logs it for you. If you DO meet your goal, the app celebrates you like crazy and rewards you with coins you can use for a bunch of amazing resources. I love that this app offers virtual meetings and you DONT HAVE TO TALK OR BE ON CAMERA! And a whole forum of people who are in the exact same boat cheering each other on. This app is saving lives, I’m sure of it. Great job Reframe.
author: LoloFins

title: Only thing I have found that has worked so far
text: I have struggled with addiction my entire adult life. I have tried rehab, AA, NA, therapy all seemed to fail. I did not enjoy them. This takes a more scientific approach by informing you about the science and as well as giving you strategies to help you cutback or quit. If you make a mistake you don’t have to go back to your Day 1 chip. They offer online meetings and forums where you can remain completely anonymous. They also provide a huge number of resources in the  to help throughout your journey. You have to check in daily and complete various tasks which keeps you engaged on your own time. I feel it’s a more positive experience than the others. You are not sitting in a room with people court ordered or forced to be there. You work your recovery as privately as you wish or have a community of people worldwide to interact with who chose to be there.
author: BridgetLauren

title: A New Outlook on Life
text: I joined Reframe for the trial period with every intention of removing my payment information before I was billed. By the end of the 7 day trial period, there was no doubt in my mind that Reframe was not only worth the annual fee, but was already helping me to make positive changes in my life. Its not just the fact that it helps you cut back or quit, but it helps you to look at other aspects of your life and helps you to make improvements there as well. I found, through this app, a Zoom meeting of like-minded people who share occupations similar to mine. We  work together and talk about stressors that are unique to us and how our personalities contribute to our problems. I just passed 70 days alcohol free and I know that I owe so much of that to the mind-shift and support that Reframe has given me! If you’re looking at the reviews, trying to decide if it’s for you… try it. You will NOT be disappointed 💗
author: KMH~

title: Fantastic App to Reduce or Quit Alcohol!
text:
This app has worked really well for me. I am currently on my longest dry streak in probably 20+ years. The lessons you learn help to change your view on drinking and make it that much easier to give it up (or reduce it if that’s your goal). The community is great as well. I have seen zero judgement from anyone - only genuine support and advice.

Do yourself a favor and get this app. It’ll more than pay for itself in the long run (case in point: I have saved about twice the amount of money I spent on getting the app by not buying alcohol anymore in just about 2 months).

This is also by no means only an app for hardcore alcoholics. Even if you’re just a regular person who looking to be a little healthier, this app can help you to reduce your drinking and doesn’t make you feel guilty or bad if you still drink alcohol and just want to work towards drinking a little less.
author: KimChilly

title: Group challenge
text: I just signed up for a 30 day trial. This is definitely new to me and I would like to see the  group challenge to have each individual have an occupation on their profile. This would help individuals in the same field or like-minded individuals relate and be better accountability buddies. being a part of somebody’s journey is important and to know the WHY behind this is even more of a reason why you’re accountability buddy is more valuable to your success because you can relate to each other. There are many reasons why each one of us on this app wants to give up alcohol and for me is improved health, mental clarity, better sleep, weight management, enhance, productivity, financial savings, and my biggest reason is personal growth. we already have one thing in common on this app and it’s alcohol and being sit free from it. I would definitely feel more comfortable finding somebody in the group challenge with the same background as Support.
author: SeyrRue

title: Great tool for rethinking alcohol
text: I have been working on reducing/eliminating alcohol for years. I’m 64 and only knew of AA.
