Not lying and I do not put this lightly to say that Reframe has absolutely changed my life. I get excited for the daily tasks and knowledge to learn more and more about the effects of alcohol. If you can change your approach, this changes your mindset which in turn, changes your life. This app the is the gateway to living a sober lifestyle. Huge shoutout to the developers. I promise you will find NOTHING out there like this. No matter what place you are in physically, emotionally, and spiritually, give this a try. You will be rewarded!
author: Jwhiz14

title: Highly recommend!
text: I’m now 60 days on my journey using the Reframe to a better relationship with alcohol. I’ve been looking for a number of years for a support that worked for me and in Reframe I’ve found it. Loads of information presented in such a way that it’s manageable and not intimidating.  There are tools galore, support at many levels and all presented in easy friendly manner.  At 80 years of age I chose to reduce rather than eliminate alcohol and, remarkably, I’m doing it!! Without even being totally aware of it or so it seems.  If you’re struggling like I had been doing, give Reframe a try…..and remember, in a saying attributed to Confucius, “it does not matter how slowly you go, so long as you do not stop”.
author: carla1013

title: Awesome App!
text: I download this because my boyfriend and I kept fighting about little things and I realized that I, of course, may be part of the problem… Well, he is gone but I’m still using the app and loving it! Really made me realize that he pushed shots on me when we were going out and wasn’t capable of just having a drink or two… Meanwhile I was capable of having a drink or two, but when you do that at lunch with clients, and then you do it happy hour with friends, then you do it at dinner w your S/O, it adds up and probably was making me more edgy and reactive. Wholeheartedly recommend this app even if you aren’t looking to quit drinking and just want to have a better awareness of your imbibing.
author: fluffpop62

title: Better than the top inpatient rehabs in the U.S.
text: It’s no secrete to my friends, co-workers and family that I’ve struggled with alcohol use disorder. I’ve gone to one of the top rehabs in the United States and still struggled….. until reframe. This is more than an APP it’s really a life changing tool that is for everyone looking to change their relationship with alcohol. Even those just looking to cut back but not completely remove it. I started reframe with the intention of just cutting back but after one week the app had me realizing so much. I decided to change the plan I was on to eliminating alcohol! I am still going strong thanks to reframe! The education, tools and community is more than I’ve found anywhere else!!!
author: Aundria Shawcroft

title: Great app that keeps good habits going
text:
Yes, there’s no energy wasted, honestly! There’s no having to get bent out of shape, it’s just is a doing it with Joy. Wake up in the morning, get my vitamins, and that includes my Reframe.
It helps with getting day going, and staying on the straighten arrow. It’s also a community. There’s so many amazing stories, representing the people .  It’s well worth it to invest into yourself, and it also helps other people because, hey, you never know, your life story can be an amazing inspiration to another persons. Life story. Hope that makes sense. Refreeze map is great. I was recommended it by another fellow Reframe app person, so there’s no judgment. Press on a click it and invest into yourself. Excelsior ! 
Joe F
author: SIPE Star

title: Took my money
text: The concept and approach are probably great, but I decided I’m not interested in this app. I cancelled my subscription several days before my trial ended and they proceeded to offer me a ton of money off, which is super nice! However, I was still not interested and declined, and continued to cancel my membership. I was then charged the yearly $120 fee, despite cancelling several days earlier. I emailed customer service to correct this and NEVER heard back. In my opinion, this is not only unprofessional but also theft. I canceled my subscription within the acceptable amount of time, was still charged, tried to be cordial and give them the benefit of the doubt, and the error was not corrected. I am extremely unimpressed regarding how they do their business. This review is not meant to reflect how they assist with alcohol education/consumption, I’m just upset as a consumer that I wasted my money and was not treated professionally.
author: ryliemorgan0

title: Best app for your overall heath.
text:
This app is amazing, more then I could have ever imagined when I signed up. It’s main focus is helping you maneuver and alcohol free lifestyle with all its ups and downs, but you also have options to cut back. This app is a community, filled with supportive people with the same goal in mind… to be their best selves. Not only do you have other Reframes you also have the support of the incredible coaches that are active daily on the app. They interact with you and also hold space for you to feel welcome and heard. There’s a little bit of everything in this gem. Workshops, book clubs, but most importantly a whole lot of learning. 
Check it out, this app does not disappoint.
author: l1l_0ne

title: Best app to cut back or quit drinking
text: In 398 days, I'm close to leaving alcohol in the rear view mirror.  I joined Reframe a year ago with the intention of cutting back. I was concerned about my 1 to 2 glass wine/day habit. Since cutting back, I really don't like to drink any longer. I'm participating in Dry January for the second time and it's been a breeze. Im going for another 30 days after this and may just quit altogether. This app has daily lessons, anonymous group meetings, a great forum where you can share your struggles and successes. This app helps you inderstand that alcohol, in any quantity, is poison. There is no pressure to make you quit. You simply learn by doing the work, and hopefully come out on the other side enlightened.
author: ClaireArmbruster

title: Changed my life
text: I’m not being dramatic even a little when I say my entire life has changed for the better since embarking on this Reframe journey. This app teaches you so much! Not just about alcohol and it’s effects on your body and mind but also about how to grow as a person and how to be a better version of yourself. I learn something new each day on this app and I’m eternally grateful for everything this app has given me. Without the daily check-ins and support system that this app offers, I really don’t know where I would be today. I’ve been sober for several months now and I attribute that almost entirely to this app. Thank you, Reframe, for changing my life!
author: lynn.w.670

title: My thoughts and gratitude towards refrain
text: Years ago it seem fairly easy for me to drink alcohol and leave it for a while as time passed on it become more and more difficult for me to leave it. I was drinking every day. I found this app and it has certainly help me a lot. My daily readings are very important to me. I have learned, whole alcohol is metabolized how it has damaged my body and haul my body will recover from the years of abuse when I get a craving I begin to think about my daily readings and whole alcohol has affected me and I have to say when I think back on my daily readings, it is much easier for me not to drink. I thank you for this app and I thank you all for your hard work.
author: Ram maxima

title: Unused 1:1 Coaching Sessions DO NOT CARRYOVER FROM MONTH TO MONTH
text:
Happy to report the Reframe Team responded quickly to my concerns and the issues have been resolved.

The Reframe Program has improved my life immensely and improved my relationship with alcohol.  My Reframe Coach Nikita is the most skilled Counselor I’ve ever worked with.

🙌Truly Grateful For th Reframe Program

I am having a difficult time giving Reframe a Rating of 1 STAR. But I have had a Monthly Coaching Pass Membership for a long time and I just discovered that my: UNUSED COACHING SESSIONS DO NOT CARRY OVER FROM MONTH TO MONTH AND DO NOT ACCUMULATE FOR FUTURE USE. Due to many health issues and immediate Death in th Family, I have not been consistent in my focus on the Reframe Program. Most of my 1:1 Coaching Sessions have not been used. BUT, I HAVE BEEN CHARGED $249 EVERY MONTH. I have searched everywhere on the Reframe APP information and I cannot find anything that explains 1:1 COACHING SESSIONS DO NOT CARRYOVER FROM MONTH TO MONTH. I feel you are intentionally misleading your members and any future members. I WOULD LIKE TO HAVE ALL MY UNUSED COACHING SESSIONS CREDITED IN THE FORM OF, FUTURE COACHING SESSIONS, IMMEDIATELY PLEASE. MY COACH IS NIKITA AND SHE IS AWARE OF MY CONCERNS. Suz
author: Viola66666

title: The BEST App Ever!!
text: This app is stellar! Head and shoulders above the rest. If you’re on the fence, try it, you won’t regret it. Reframe offers so much content and a wide variety of helpful resources put together by experts. This app would be valuable for all human beings, not just those that seek to change their relationship with alcohol. You’ll learn skills and tools to help improve all aspects of being a healthy human being from relationships to sleep, stress reduction to mindfulness, from fitness to communication, meditation to relapse prevention and so much more. Whether you’re trying to quit, cutback or change your relationship with alcohol, there’s something for everyone including a safe, supportive community.
author: Tsp111b

title: if AA isn’t for you
text: this app has gotten me to day 5 which isn’t a lot but so much more than I can say I’ve gone in the past. I hate AA. it makes me feel like there is something wrong with me and that I have to have a sad story. being in “recovery” shouldn’t be SAD. it should be a positive experience to get back to your true self. reframe is doing that. it’s teaching me how much better my body and mind can be getting sober. there’s a community of likeminded people that cheer each other on. there’s no my name is ___ and I’m an alcoholic. it feels normal. anyways. thank you reframe I appreciate you and the $30 a month is way chiller than the over $120k+ I have spent on drinking for 13 years.
author: bb19479

title: The One I’ve been searching for
text: This app is very dynamic. I feel like I’m actually interacting with a counselor and support group. After sharing that my goal was to cut back and stating how much I currently drink, the Daily Tracker told me how many drinks per day to limit to as a start. I needed that guidance because I was just guessing and self doubting so couldn’t stay on track. My ultimate goal is sober living. The daily tasks give me a framework of baby steps because I had no frigging clue and would go in too hard with the wrong strategies. Also the chat bot is phenomenal. Much better than hitting a brick wall trying to talk to friends who don’t understand and have no listening skills.
author: Chloe Alpharetta

title: Very helpful
text: I am amazing just the little bit of reading and answering of questions can help me be accountable and mindful about drinking. The first TED talk that I listened to when I had a craving resonated with my current situation that cutting back and maybe even someday quitting so possible. I’m two weeks I went from drinking almost every day to two drinks when I was NOT under distress. And I stopped that night because I was like “I would rather have some water”. Feels good to be taking control. The yearly subscription has already paid for itself. Just like writing down what you eat to loose weight this daily interaction with the app helps so much!  Highly recommend
author: K.r.gonemad

title: Limitations
text: There are some very personal questions they ask you at the beginning that makes you think you’ll be able to see what this app offers (I suppose for data mining) but then nope! You cannot even see what the app offers without plopping down a bunch of money.  I have never come across an app before that won’t let you see what it is without $$$ first. Secondly, the questions it asks you show limitations. Like the most you can report spending on alcohol a week is $200. If you have 5 drinks 5 nights a week at $8 each that’s $200. I’m sure there are people who spend so much more than that. When you pick out what you drink you cannot pick beer AND liquor. It’s one or the other. When you pick why you’re stopping you can only choose one field and then a secondary one, even though there are often so many more reasons than that and many may feel equally important.
author: Maemaeevie

title: So helpful
text:
I love Reframe and the team. They have been immensely helpful with my journey to cut back with my alcohol intake. I have cut down over 50% and life is looking and feeling so much better. The resources have been so informative and enlightening and have been of great assistance in helping me cut down. The support is from everyone is so encouraging and because of it I keep moving forward.

I have now gone from the cut back track to the alcohol free track. I have been free from alcohol for 129 days. The meetings, community, and resources have been very helpful in my journey. The encouragement and learning the science of the way my brain responds to alcohol is one of the main reasons I have been so successful.
author: Energizer GiGi Bunny

title: Best app for drinking habits
text: As I approach my 30s, I’m trying to have a better relationship with alcohol and leave binge drinking in my 20s. I’ve read books on the affects of drinking and have done dry months before, but this app is really good at holding you accountable to drinking less (or stopping completely if that’s you goal) and learning at the same time what alcohol does to us in the short and long term. I’m also a person that loves to keep daily track of goals so this is perfect for me. It’s great too that it tracks calories and money you are saving and nights of improved sleep. The small monthly payment is worth it compared to the money you save by cutting back on alcohol.
author: kanzalo

title: Comprehensive & effective
text: This app is a fantastic tool to help one succeed in learning about what alcohol does to the body. What you do with that knowledge is up to you. The information and support that is provided, is given in such a way that is not to judge or induce self judgment. It’s purely information and it’s complete and understandable. Such a great app, I only downloaded this because I needed to drop a few pounds for a vacation, but it has literally changed my mindset, and it’s so much bigger than my relationship with alcohol. I absolutely love and recommend this app for anyone who has a strong sense of self discipline and needs some guidance on making big changes. It’s been so positive for me.
author: Music2MySoul

title: Like AA on steroids, friendly without religious sideshow
text:
This app first includes you in a community of maybe thousands of others globally who either want to cut back or quit drinking. 

Then it has daily goals and tips, even games, for managing cravings. 

Also there are free moderates multi-daily zoom sessions where maybe 200 people join, sone speak and all give feedback or share their own teiumphs or struggles. This is non-judgmental, ok if you slipped, because you’re in the room. 

Then the App has the most advanced AI chatbot I’ve ever seen, Melody. She remembers what you say, has a vast knowledge and pivots to questions about your alcohol struggle. For example, she’s encouraged me to learn to play piano (as I revealed) to replace cravings, asked me what songs I was trying, and when I wrote “Pearl Jam’s Black” she noted that it’s a “powerful song about loss” and added that Eddie Vedder was open about his struggles with addiction towards sobriety. 

Amazing app, immediately life changing. For $4 first month, $10 thereafter you will get your money worth unless you ignore the app’s many tools and resources.
author: James seattle

title: Very Helpful
text: I started using this app to help me reduce my consumption. I didn’t feel out of control, but I felt like I needed some help reducing more than I had. This app has a lot of tools to help and emphasizes reframing the task as NOT a battle of the wills and just a new habit to form, which alone helps a great deal. Because this is geared towards anyone with ANY reason to cut down on alcohol, sometimes the advice or questions feel very broad or address things that are more likely issues for very heavy drinkers (suffering DTs after cutting back, for instance). I understand the app needs to cover its bases (some people don’t want to admit how much of a problem their drinking is) but it can feel awkward to answer questions that don’t apply to your situation.
author: Xcj3

title: Reframe works!
text: Reframe likely works because of the many tools in the tool kit. I completed 161 days on the cut back track & have not experienced a single hangover during that time, which was my chief goal. The content at the beginning of module 1 was great, focused on the neuroscience of alcohol consumption. Toward the end of module 1 I felt I was in a Stuart Smalley skit on SNL. But the daily tracking & online, anonymous forum are both great. I can imagine that reframe would be especially effective in the context of a comprehensive therapeutic plan to help heavy drinkers, grey area drinkers, & those who cannot successfully cut back. One helpful suggestion would be to allow users to record half drinks for greater precision in recording.
author: speedqueen85

title: Absolutely life-changing, even for a moderate drinker.
text: I really just wanted to lose some weight, and Counter the aging effect of alcohol. Having never had a "problem" with alcohol, I didn't really realize how much I was just casually drinking in the course of a week, and how much it affected my sleep, thinking and performance. I started this app mostly to have a tracker and some incentive to cut back, for reasons of vanity. But all of my reasons changed in the course of the app program. It's an incredible app. Richly textured, offering several avenues of support and motivation. I love the daily homework, teaching the effect that alcohol has on the various parts of the brain and body. The longer you stick with it, the more you learn. It's tantamount to a self guided daily therapy session, because you learn wonderful improved ways of coping with stress, relationships, communication, etc. Aptly named, I feel my relationship with alcohol has been completely "reframed". I rarely drink, and when I do, it is a deliberate decision and the drink is worth it. Additionally, if I could never have another drink again for some reason, I would be fine with that. I can't recommend this app enough. I have to be very careful with my numerous friends, because this is almost all I want to talk about, I'm so excited and thankful for the wonderful measurable changes in my life. Vanity is now my last reason for drinking less. The most important reason is my quality of life. The drink I would have to take the edge off of my anxiety turns out to be the very thing that was radically increasing my anxiety! Who knew?? Alcohol prevents us from a straight path to problem resolution. We don't even get to see how simple it can be, because we tend to just reach for a drink first.  I really could go on and on. And this is from someone who was just a *moderate* (per CDC standards) drinker! Truly, the longer I don't drink or minimally drink, the better I feel. In ALL respects. I know wake up early and exercise every morning! I feel on top of the world. Most importantly, I feel on top of my own self. In the sense that I am in control. Amazingly, the results just keep on coming!! One of the very best decisions I've ever made in my life was trying this app. Try it, do it daily, and you will likely feel the same.
author: Raeraemcrae

title: Best thing I ever did!
text: This app is amazing. I have tried to quit drinking on my own many times with no success at all. This app educates about all aspects of what alcohol does to you, why it is hard to quit, how to be successful. It uses many different tools - education, meditation, visualization, affirmations, just to name a few. There is a group to get support and challenges you can do for even more motivation. Honestly I can’t think of one thing they could do to make this any better. It is worth every penny and is truly life changing. I know I will quit completely, but you can choose between quitting or cutting down, and your program will be tailored to your goals.
author: ddcliff

title: Best app
text:
This is one of the best apps ever!!! It really helped me to understand my behaviors, the science behind it, brain functioning, etc but its helpful in a non overwhelming or overbearing way . It allows for everyone to have their own journey and to incorporate what works for them. You can use it to cut back or you can use it to be alcohol free. This app has given me so much support. The community you find in here is amazing. Everyone is so nice and supportive!  Actually some people do meet up in real life if they wish to! 
If you’re thinking about changing your relationship with alcohol, this is the best app to use in my opinion. It’s also a lot cheaper than buying alcohol!!!!
author: Nikki Nut

title: Love this app!
text:
I signed up because of Dry January and stayed because of the app! I know I wouldn’t have had the success to remain “mostly dry” that month and beyond without the encouragement and support of this app. 

I’d always felt discouraged because the only way I could imagine reducing or even eliminating my alcohol use was by sheer “willpower” and that approach was proving impossible. I simply didn’t have enough willpower. What I learned, in actuality, is that what I didn’t have was enough education, support, and encouragement. 

I love the neuroscience-based approach this app offered me at the start of this journey and still continues to offer me. I imagine I’ll be a subscriber for the long run!
author: Tangsoosue

title: this app changed my life in incredibly meaningful ways
text: as cliché as it sounds, i really don’t ever write reviews. not when i love something and not even when i hate something. i felt really compelled to with this particular app though because it has truly helped me make major changes in my life that i never thought i could make. if you’re serious about changing your relationship with alcohol, i can’t recommend this app enough. i was very hesitant to try yet another mental health related app, especially one that requires a subscription but it has surpassed my expectations in every way and has been an invaluable resource for me as i try to change my relationship with alcohol. between the forum (of incredibly supportive, loving, and nonjudgmental people), the daily readings addressing the psychological aspects of alcohol use, the pressure-free environment of the space… i seriously can’t express how thankful i am. things that felt utterly impossible now feel like they’re in my grasp. so thankful for this app and the beautiful people that make up the community.
author: sleeplesshark

title: Seriously….
text: This app has been a lifesaver for me!I have tried to become alcohol free for a very long time… Something finally clicked where I wanted to take this journey seriously and at the same time I just happened to see the Reframe app. Daily readings, challenges that are doable, and even a forum to read and/or write down your experiences…these are just a few of the tools they provide to help you along the way. And… If you want to just cut down on your alcohol consumption, they have a program designed just for that. I highly recommend this app for anyone who is sober curious or otherwise. Seriously, the gains are far better than the “loss” of drinking.
author: LJSHstrong

title: Genuinely helpful
text: I’m 21 days in and have had days where I win and days I lose, but there’s never a penalty of discouragement in the app, on the other hand, it provides you immediately with support, guidance, and wisdom that makes you get up and try again to be better the next day. Can’t recommend this app enough to anyone struggling with controlling their drinking. I started with the 7 days free trial and don’t see myself getting rid of this app for a long time, it’s an incredible support. I can share my achievement with my best friend and parents, too! That makes it even more real to have your loved ones see your effort and progress.
author: katienovacek

title: Helpful but not for the ADHD brain
text:
So they totally got me with the 7 day trial and annual membership, which I forgot to cancel. Classic. So I gave it my best shot, since there was no way I’d get my money back and being more knowledgeable about drinking seemed genuinely helpful. 

It was helpful for about two weeks but then my life got very busy and when you miss a lot of days it’s hard to catch up and if you don’t take the time to catch up, you just miss all those articles. I wish it would just pick up where I left off if I skipped days. At this point knowing I have 45m of catching up to do prevents me from even opening the app and checking in. And knowing I accidentally spent $79 on an app that’s just making me feel worse about myself really, really hurts. 

I tried resetting my progress so I could just start over but now the whole thing is stuck, saying it’s a couple months ago and I completed all my tasks for the day. So that’s confusing. I’m guessing re downloading it would work. But then I’m guessing I’ll spend 2 weeks reading the articles I already read before I get sidetracked again, and the same annoying process will begin anew. 

What I really need is an app that helps me quit signing up for “free trials” 😂
author: Mago Mago

title: more mindful about my drinking
text: I was drinking one or two glasses a night, mostly out of habit, and wanted to be more mindful about my drinking. I started with a trial and it was so great to learn how much alcohol actually affects your body your health and your sleep. Without feeling like I’m missing anything I cut my alcohol consumption by half and feel good about the benefits. I’m gaming. I also am revisiting the way I think of alcohol as a reward and for stress relief. There are other ways that feel better are less expensive and I’m more fun ways to destress and treat myself. That said, I’m enjoying my drinks guilt free when I choose them and feel better all around. Loving this app.
author: Shanlovgren

title: A born skeptic is a big fan
text: I didn’t have any expectations for Reframe. My wife sent it to me saying she signed up so I joined her more out of solidarity than anything else. I was pretty much immediately impressed with the scientific approach /aspect. In looking through the app more I found there seemed to be something for everyone- the thinkers, the feelers , the busy brains, the everybodys. You can make of it what you want. The creators of this tool nailed it. I can’t say enough positive things and the only critical one is a minor technical thing.. that I want the ability to edit calories assigned to drinks that I’m not drinking , lol. Anyway, from a natural born skeptic.. 5 stars and then some.
author: Hpdx

title: I see why this works
text: I’m an alcoholic. I give up on pretending otherwise and I am powerless against its forces. Despite having a counselor and a psychiatrist and lots of support, sometimes it takes a little more to really have a good sense of WHY alcohol is a no for the rest of my life. It feels extreme just saying that, but I’ve learned that my brain is wired differently than non alcoholics brains. This app has given me lots of perspective and it’s only day 1. Hopefully this continues but it’s nice to talk about my struggles with others equally motivated to make a change, and dealing with alcohol specifically rather than other narcotics. Thank you to everyone who helped create this!
author: K!k!b@k3r101

title: Only thing that has really worked
text: I have taken breaks from alcohol in the past, and completed a dry January, but it was a struggle every time, and all I could think about was when I would be allowed to drink again. With Reframe, I truly haven’t had a single craving nine days in. I feel like I’m more aware of what I’m gaining by addressing my relationship with alcohol, as opposed to what I believe I have to give up. My goal was to pay for the app for one month and see if I wanted to renew, and I absolutely will. Even past dry January, I want to make sure that my relationship with alcohol is a healthy one, and I believe that Reframe is going to be instrumental in that.
author: Han Han 222

title: Better than the description
text: The Reframe app is even better than the current description of it here. You curate the amount of daily content you want. Set your goal. And go. I went from having a drink many days of the week to none. I wanted to try life differently, sensing there was a better, truer way. The app made it easy (I was ready!). You learn enough right away to encourage you to reconsider your relationship with alcohol. The daily tasks I have on the app — 5 minutes — are educational and helpful. After your trial, the current $99 cost for the year: obviously worth it. I’ll save a lot of money now. I’m done with the ruse that is booze.
author: JMFosa

title: Life changing
text: I’ve been on reframe for a month now and cut back the amount of alcohol I’ve consumed tremendously! I have finally learned the skills and what my triggers are for drinking. I love the daily tasks, the meetings and especially the challenges. This app quite literally has given me the tools I needed to mindfully drink but also helped with my relationships with others especially my husband. The community of members is so welcoming and supportive!! I could go on and on about how this app has helped me!! You get out what you put in it’s not magic but certainly worth the effort to get my life back 💕💕💕 I just wish I could’ve found this years ago.
author: Plaque smaker

title: A Game Changer
text: I wanted to take a closer look at my relationship with alcohol and needed a structure based on science to provide the scaffolding. I’m on Day 140 of being alcohol free, thanks in a very large part to Reframe. In fact, I see it as more of a Master Class on life, as many of the modules are transferable to other parts of your life. They provide the research, short journal prompts, strategies around cravings, options to join communities, and even humor, and more, to support your decision to cut back or eliminate alcohol. I have highly recommended this app to friends who say they are ready to live a different kind of life. What do you have to lose? Give it a shot (no pun intended 😆).
author: Betterdays24/7

title: Life changing
text: Highly recommend this app if you need to re-evaluate your relationship with alcohol. Daily readings are motivating and educational. Group forum is there when you need more advice or seek counsel from others who have walked this walk. Zoom meetings are included in the program that are very beneficial. Don’t hesitate to use this app if you are ready to make a change in your life. Update: I am 375 days alcohol free since joining Reframe and my life has completely changed. If you are ready to re-evaluate your relationship with alcohol and do the work necessary to change, this community is here ready to welcome & support you. Don’t hesitate. This is a game changer.
author: lynner64

title: Great base
text:
I love how this app makes it daily about science and what is actually happening in your body and brain. This makes it so much easier and motivating to really re think your relationship with alcohol.

However in the app there are just some really simple annoying things that it is baffling they don’t fix?

For example the “alcohol free” counter … why is this not tied to the drink counter which is a part of the daily tasks? So if you’re someone who wants to just cut down, you have to reset a few times a week manually. Which ofc I don’t, so it’s just this pointless tracker.

Same thing with the health benefit tracker that tells you what is happening to your body based on how long you’ve been free from booze. Again I really do love this feature, it’s so helpful, but from a functional standpoint it never updates based on data you input. Why? This would be so simple. 

Even when I totally reset the app to start on day 1, the “sober date” counter never changes, and the health benefits counter never resets. 

Why in the world isn’t this fixed it would be so simple? Really keeps me from loving the app and using it to its potential.
author: Mr.Anderson8811

title: WORTH IT.
text: I (30F) drank about 6-9 drinks a week before downloading this app. I had drank heavily in the recent past and had tried many times to quit altogether, but I couldn’t. I was stuck with this feeling that I wouldn’t “fit in” with colleagues, friends, family, etc if I quit drinking. This app works… I did a 30 day trial, successfully cut out alcohol. A few days after the trial ended,  I started drinking again… Fed up with alcohol, I paid for the annual subscription. I used the app daily for the first 3 or 4  months. Then not drinking became my new normal. I have now been alcohol free for over 1 year. I’m happier and healthier than ever. I highly recommend this app!
author: Wrudbjyrd

title: Great for “grey area” drinkers
text: This app came at the perfect time. I needed to cut back because I was utilizing alcohol too much. It was becoming a pernicious habit that had become too overwhelming to tackle on my own. ReFrame offers the perfect package of motivation, support, tools, etc., that make you not only feel good about your choices—whether that’s cutting back or quitting alcohol entirely—but also empowered. Absolutely worth the cost. I’ve had ReFrame for a week and a half and have cut my alcohol intake by by 75%. I feel like the “spell is broken.” Take with a grain of salt (and everyone is different) but this app was the perfect boost to help me detach from alcohol and find myself again.
author: doodlebopper33

title: Really helpful
text: This app has been a surprisingly big support for me. I never have huge hopes for an app, but  I happened to find it in a moment when I felt ready to cut back on drinking. Giving up altogether felt like an impossible dream, but slowly and surely through the process of learning about what alcohol does to a body, to a life, and reclaiming my center, alcohol started to lose its appeal and I now feel totally open and totally able to leave it maybe forever. I appreciate the flexibility and many points of entry of Reframe, and the practical, very doable supports that made it honesty just not that hard to let a long held habit go.
author: Incphotography

title: Important piece of the puzzle
text: This app is part of my daily routine of personal wellbeing and accountability. I learn something new every day, and that helps me stay accountable and curious in my newish alcohol free lifestyle.  I used the app for a while before actually cutting alcohol out altogether, and the way it is set up, it is easy to transition from a cut back track to a alcohol free track at any time. The learning and science behind the reasons we drink and what happens in our bodies is really great information. I like that it is about 10 minutes a day to complete the daily prompts.  I am grateful for this app and the support and encouragement it has provided to me.
author: KBTBIRD:)

title: Reframe delivers what is asked of it
text: This app delivers a simple drink counting system at a minimum. This was exactly what I was looking for. But it also guides the user down the path of daily tasks while delivering informative tidbits of science and knowledge, and explains why things are what they are, including ones self. It’s the science that keeps me going. It is not as coarse nor in your face as a twelve step often is. But, it is “reminiscent” of those programs, ie daily tasks or one day at a time themes and methods. The discipline building is there but it is left to the user to choose the depth of engagement. Additional AA like functions are available if one chooses to use them.
author: Archie Pee

title: Saved my life
text: This app is incredible and the people who use it have created an incredible community of support. Most people don’t buy into the virtual approach but it turns out when I was looking into AA many of the meetings are still being held virtually. You can try it free for 7 days and if you aren’t convinced after the 7 days you can always explore other options. The coaches are also very knowledgeable and have first hand experiences with alcohol use disorder. Good luck to anyone reading this who think they might have a problem with alcohol. Give it a try and join us in our road to a healthier existence.
author: Robert D'A

title: Fantastic Tool for Support
text: Reframe has been a great tool to support my backing down on alcohol consumption. I actually am using it as a resource during my alcohol “fast” during lent and while I don’t believe I am addicted, it has definitely changed my thought and my relationship with alcohol. Addiction runs in the family and I am glad there is an easily accessible tool in place to keep me mindful of my patterns and consumption so that I can live a life where I CAN continue to enjoy a glass of wine on occasions and not be dependent on it for all occasions. I highly recommend Reframe for anyone looking to cut back on alcohol or cut it out entirely. It is really well created.
author: Kdrw

title: This works for me!
text: My primary care doctor recommended Reframe. I have tried so many things to quit alcohol, without success. Reframe works for me. The daily exercises are not overwhelming. The online meetings are good (and low pressure).  Reframe encourages a wide variety of interventions; pick some and see if they work for you. I especially love the progress section in my profile, which shows how long I have been alcohol free, to the second. It also shows how much money I have saved and how many calories from alcohol I have avoided. The support staff respond within a day to questions you might have. Happy to have found this!
author: MBANYC22

title: Standing Ovation
text: That's what I give this app. If you have concerns about your drinking habits, do yourself a favor and get this app. It's components have EVERYTHING covered. Brain science, coaches (if you like) self care, community, positive reinforcement, etc.. There is no judgement just encouragement. No one will tell you that you must completely abstain or label you. You choose your goals and the app is there for you. It may be the best thing I've ever done for my mental health, my physical health and my happiness. I seriously look forward to doing my daily check in each morning. If you're ready to change your relationship with alcohol, this is your new best friend.
author: madhadda1

title: This helped me beyond my alcohol issues
text: This app digs deep into self growth as a way of controlling drinking habits. It has many dynamic lessons day by day that don’t take longer than 15 minutes. There’s different tools and a forum where you can talk to other people going through the same issue as well as just scroll and read people’s stories. This app has changed my life and I am glad I am paying for this, it’s the best investment I have ever made. It’s not an easy journey and the Reframe crew makes you feel more at ease and motivates you day by day to not only control your drinking but also to become a better person.
author: Juanmuy

title: Excellent resource, highly recommend
text: Whatever your experience with alcohol, if you are looking to cutback or quit, this is the place. For me, learning about the science behind why we drink, what it does to our brains, and that the damage can be reversed is very empowering and gives me hope. Journaling and other exercises help engage my brain. Logging drinks helps keep me accountable to myself. Forums help me connect with others that I can learn from and support. Zoom calls are a great feature: I can sit and watch others talk about their journey, or I can raise my hand and participate. There are other resources in the app I haven’t even begun to touch!
author: Suzygil

title: I used this app 2 years ago but stopped
text:
Used to be free so I stopped using it when I couldn’t even log in when they started charging all of a sudden, it’s been 2 years and now it looks like it’s more complicated than before, it used to be more simple but now it has so much information and forums, it makes me feel overwhelmed. 
There’s rarely any free apps now a days so I’m giving this a try, even if I have to pay. It’s better than keep ruining my life with alcohol. 
I just wish it the app was more simple like before. I’m on day 3 of sobriety and I’m feeling very paranoid, anxious and this information overload is kind of stressful so I’m only gonna use the daily task, all the other things my brain can’t take right now.
author: Thebookoftruth

title: Cutting back
text: I have been using Reframe now for a month. My goal is to cut back on my daily use of alcohol. I’m not a big drinker, but I can hit a binge and I want that to never happen again. From the very beginning the information about alcohol and how it affects our brain gave many aha moments and showed me why several of my cravings and triggers were getting me into trouble. It was exactly what I needed. The daily routine of the App and the exercises are thought provoking and have helped me see my path forward. In one month I have cut back and I feel GREAT, both physically and mentally. For me, it has been a godsend. Highly recommend it.
author: Glracj

title: I recommend something more reliable
text: This app promises a lot but fails to deliver. It is FULL of bugs and has consistently been so since I joined 5 or 6 months ago. Some of my data that I worked hard on just disappeared tonight - not only is that frustrating, but if you’re counting on this as a tool to help you navigate an already challenge behavior change, it’s doubly frustrating. I cannot in good faith recommend this app to anyone seeking reliable tools to help them change their relationship with alcohol. Reliability should be a baseline feature but this app even fails that. Less concerning but also super annoying is that this app is very poorly organized, not intuitive, confusing, etc., and I’m a pretty tech savvy person. So there’s that, too! Try something better!
author: Tried it twice in 6 months

title: This app really works!
text:
As we age, too much liquor is a big risk to our physical and mental health.  After losing some relatives to alcohol induced dementia, I’ve been committed to a big reduction in my unhealthy consumption of alcohol.   After many failed attempts I came across this app. What a godsend! 

I’ve cut my consumption to one third of my level before starting the app.  The tools are very helpful and the developer clearly understands how to help people through this difficult process. 

Many thanks to the developers for such a great service.   Interestingly, I saved enough in the first week from reduced wine purchases to justify purchase of the app!
author: IPPauldigi

title: Helpful, informative, non-judgmental
text: I am very much enjoying this app and finding it very helpful. I am not one to pay for apps in general, but finally took the plunge on trying this one to see if it would help me out. Reframe is great at giving the TLDR version of scientific research on alcohol and the effects on the body systems and the psychology behind it- making it very digestible for any and all users. The platform is structured to be supportive and without shame on alcohol use or slip ups. I like the ability to add and remove certain exercises as well, tailoring your experience- also use it as a cut back tool or a quit tool.
author: SaraJBirdy

title: The only app you’ll need to either go dry or damp
text: I exhaustively researched and tried many different apps when I decided to address my alcohol over-usage. I’ve since dropped all the other apps, and this one is by far the only one that consistently works and adds value to your life. Based on science and research by experts, with a very healthy dose of social, physical, and psychological input… I’ve gone from a habit that was ruining my life to a full re-set that has delighted my family and given me my joy and purpose back. Reframe has saved my life, handed it back to me and for that, I will be forever grateful. Thank you Reframe!
author: Katrina55555

title: A truly wonderful app.
text: Reframe is turning my life around. There is a load of information and science to explain exactly why we get addicted to alcohol. It’s such a “quick fix”. But you discover that there are other quick fixes that are just as good, and much healthier. Plus, you don’t have to stop drinking. You just learn that you can wind it down a bit. And the app’s tools and forum of other drinkers help so much. I feel like I’m totally surrounded by people with the same issue - all rooting for me and vice-versa. This app is a Godsend. Finally, a lifelong habit of heavy drinking is turning a corner. Honestly, I never thought it could happen❣️
author: KnowledgeJunkie7

title: Truly life changing
text: I’ve never rated an app before, but I feel compelled to share my love for this app. This app has not only changed my relationship with alcohol but has helped me in all areas of my life. I look forward to waking up every morning and completing my module for the day. The content is science based with the latest research and information to help you on your journey…no matter where you’re at and what your goals are. Some things in life are worth the cost and paying for an annual membership for this app is more than worth it if you are committed to changing your relationship with alcohol.
author: The Obstacle is the Way

title: Life changing, truly
text: This app and community has TRULY been life changing for me. I can’t believe I took a chance and downloaded the app, did the free trial, and ZERO regrets and have happily paid for the next 12 months because of how blown away I am by Reframe. The app content, the community, zoom meetings, coaches, fellow reframers, everything- I have become the best version of myself because of all the above supporting and facilitating me every step of the way! Took a chance and boy did it work out for me! You get this one life, if you’re on the fence, there’s really no reason not to *try* and just see what it’s about!
author: Cbear9

title: Definitely glad I tried this.
text:
It took a long time for me to want to change my relationship with alcohol because I thought it was an “all or nothing” situation.  But I was exhausted from the rollercoaster of hung-over me saying new day, no drinking, and afternoon me saying- let’s drink! 

This app was such a positive surprise, helping create new habits and -this sounds bad- but I really thought I had heard it all about drinking and shocker, I had not.  Embarrassing. 

The educational science and psychology that they share, in easy bites, has been a huge game changer.   It makes me think and it makes me relax.  And without all the judgement or shame.
author: nbw908

title: Surprisingly helpful right away
text: I paid for a full year subscription, thinking the daily tasks and reflections would be good for me no matter what. Was really impressed right away with the science-based reminders—in bite sized chunks—of how cutting back on alcohol has SOOO many benefits. Daily little motivations like this have led to me actually not wanting my regular glass or two of wine per night—which felt impossible before—and being very happy with a mocktail instead. I’m less than one month into the program and feel so empowered to say ‘no’ to friends who want me to drink , and physically and mentally feeling so much better.
author: Jmansford

title: Extremely helpful
text:
This app is extremely helpful. It uses structured, easy-to-use, evidence-based approaches to reduce harmful consumption. I find myself with more self-compassion, being more mindful, and making positive changes for myself. My mood and my health have already improved in less than a week. 

This is a very well designed app and worth the money. You would spend a great deal of time and effort gathering these resources yourself, but they are helpfully collected here so you can actually use them and immediately benefit from them.

Please keep up the awesome effort at improving the world’s relationship with alcohol!
author: Baconator85

title: Life changing
text:
This app has helped me get my life back. 
I am a mom in my 30s and wanted to be more present for my kids. I was having a wind down drink almost every evening after work. I felt in control but I also felt out of control. I was over the feeling of guilt in the mornings and wanted to set a better example for my kids. I could quickly see a change for the better after a few days of not drinking. I felt empowered. Reframe is a fantastic tool to use when you make the decision to change your relationship with drinking. I tried a few apps and this was the one for me. Worth it.
author: M927485972949

title: Speechless.
text:
I’m not one to leave reviews. But, this app is different. It’s been a week. I feel validated. I feel
respected. I feel like it will be okay, I will be okay. Please, if you have any doubts. Don’t. This app helps and treats you and your relationship with alcohol as it really should be. Different and unique. Everyone’s journey is just that. To each their own. This app proved itself more effective than any other treatment or group for these kinds of issues… As an addictions counselor who recently graduated from university, even I couldn’t pull myself out of the hole I was starting to dig. But, this app is working so far.
author: RuinedResiliantReframed

title: Brilliant App! Informative & Motivating, Bravo!!
text:
Initially my intentions going in were to cut back/take a break. I made the commitment to check in with the Reframe app every day for the month of December and complete all tasks and reading (compactly informative and do-able!!).

It is the 28th, and I’m excited to dabble with living Alcohol-Free for 2024. I’m 28 days in my journey and honestly don’t miss it. You learn quickly healthy coping techniques, how to gain positive support, identify triggers and steps to manage them. My personal favorite is all the new knowledge I am equipped with and my daily health update! I honestly can say I look forward to using Reframe daily.
author: Hil S.

title: So glitchy
text: Love the potential of the app and the content, but so much of it is glitchy. The daily calendar shows I’ve been alcohol free for 36 days, but the total tracker shows I’ve been alcohol free for 0 days, weeks, months, years. Many of the readings are cut off at the bottom of the page and I can’t read the rest of the article. One of the daily tasks was to watch a video and the video was “inaccessible because it’s private”. I’ve reached out to their support team multiple times and the only assistance I’ve received is to close and reopen the app, which does nothing. It’s really disappointing to pay for the app and have much of it be inaccessible and the support team ignore my requests for help.
author: TikaBanana

title: Helpful app
text:
I find this to be a helpful app, WITH outside support. It’s a great add on to the weekly meetings I have with a Kaiser group, and with friends who I talk to. Trying to make any change is hard to do alone, so this has served as a good check in with myself. The daily readings are great. 

The one improvement to this app is in the ‘log your mood’ journal entry section. Please add auto correct or predictive text! It would be great if im corrected to I’m and other spelling / grammar mistakes. I want to be able to write stream of consciousness without having to back space to correct grammatical errors that will annoy me or not make sense when I go back to read my previous entries.
author: steph0415

title: Great app!
text: If you’re looking to change your relationship with alcohol and learn more about yourself in the process, give this app a try. I was skeptical about whether or not it would help me cutback on my drinking & started with a “Dry January” challenge. I’ve learned so much about the psychology behind my drinking & am proud to say I am continuing my journey using the app & am now 108 days sober! I don’t know that I’ll never drink again, that wasn’t really my goal. I do know my relationship with alcohol has changed & so has my overall wellbeing. I believe it is thanks to the lessons, resources & tools available through this app.
author: LessIsMore74

title: Excellent Support For Cutting Back
text:
This app not only helps you track alcohol consumption, but gives you daily support on a number of other factors that influence drinking or not drinking.  It helps encourage and motivate you to reach your goals, as well as be gentle in overcoming the shame of drinking and even the shame in not drinking!
I love that it gives the science and the “why” we drink, but that it also gives tools to work for each individual. 
It has changed my alcohol use as well as the way I see alcohol in life in general, in so many great ways, and I am living a better life because of it!
Thank you Reframe!
author: megaleen

title: Big Help!!
text:
This has been a great help to me in my battle to quit drinking daily and to save it for a night out or a weekend. Wonderful information and very motivating!!!
This app not only addresses drinking but can help you in every aspect of your life! It doesn’t take long to do the app everyday and it really is helpful in dealing with your problems. 
I am losing weight too and everything that applies to drinking applies to overeating. It’s just another addiction. 
I have another app for weight loss but I like reframe the best. 
I think it’s wonderful to be able to be in a group on line and get support and encouragement there. Go Reframe!!!
author: Fernanmj52

title: GREAT App to help with Alcohol Reduction
text: I am trying to reduce my alcohol consumption  ( not necessarily stop) so in the journey Reframe has provided incredible encouragement, support and for me, scientific help with tips and facts about what alcohol does to the mind, spirit and body- and just as important  what one experiences during a decrease (urges for other foods, irritability, etc) to help understand it isn’t the person but simply the process! That was HUGE for me .Also seeing a visual representation of my “alcohol free” days on the calendar gives me encouragement for another day.  If anyone compares what we spend on alcohol vs. the price of the app- it’s a no brainer, even if it just reduces the number of drinks by 2 -3 per week.
author: hsushehus

title: You Like This
text: I’ve been using Reframe for a few months now, and it’s been fantastic so far.  It’s very flexible in that you can set your own alcohol reduction goal. There truly is a wealth of information that is provided in manageable daily portions. I am grateful for having learned and incorporated a great deal of practical information. My favorite category of information has been the neuroscience. While I think we all generally understand that too much drinking is unhealthy and can damage our mental capacity, the information on healing the brain and significantly improving cognition has been a Godsend.
author: Daveplg

title: Helpful for cutting back
text: I don't think this is the app for anyone truly suffering from addiction. If you want to be more aware of your relationship with alcohol and work on cutting back usage, I think it's great. It reminds me a bit of a weight watchers program-- logging your drinks and holding yourself accountable to that is a great tool for really focusing on how much alcohol you're indulging in during a week. It also keeps it at the fore front of your mind, so you may consider what drinks are really "worth it". I think it's a useful tool in conjunction with therapy and/or meetings for those serious about confronting their bad habits.
author: Shelly7836

title: Game Changer
text:
I’m so grateful that my friend Rachel found this app. It encompasses so many resources that I have found helpful. I did the daily activities for both dry and damp January and what j enjoyed the most were Kevin’s videos. I wish we had him for February. I was unsuccessful with dry January so it was refreshing to have an option. His videos were helpful to dry or damp reframes. Please bring Kevin’s daily videos back for February! 
Thanks to whomever brought Reframe to the world. I count on it every day and it, along with Alan Carr’s book, “Quit Drinking Without Willpower,” have truly helped me make changes to my relationship with alcohol.
author: DelMarLovey

title: BBB…
text:
I paid for the $4.99 trial month to see if I would like this app only to find out the whole app is $120 which is WAAAY out of my budget, and more than double that if you pay by the month so I froze my credit card so I wasn’t accidentally charged. Not only did they try running my card a day before it was supposed to but they tried rerunning it a couple days later. Was mad they tried charging after canceling and still trying to charge me, I then deleted my entire account. A week later I was notified that they tried charging my card again so I guess now I will have to place a complaint with the Better Business Bureau. Not everyone has hundreds and hundreds to spend on apps. Stop!!
Update 2/27: you tried charging my card for the 4th time!! I wrote to that email and was ignored!
author: qrose75

title: Like a Good Friend with a Quick Daily Reminder
text: So far Reframe has been the quick daily reminder I need to just cut back. Not finish the dregs of that beer I’m not really enjoying and not to have that last beer right before bed because I’m bored. It’s also taught me a lot and been an ironically familiar educator on some of the little things going on with my body and mind, which I hadn’t before connected to alcohol consumption, like depletion of dopamine or the numbing sensation I get in my toes when I ski. Maybe it’s a coincidence, but I’m guessing these things are connected and I wouldn’t have put it together without Reframe.
author: NR7682

title: This is the best money I ever spent
text: There is so many things available on the site— the benefits seem endless—This site is interactive with real people— real meetings!  The coaches are ALL awesome.  People who truly care and you are not just a number— they get to know you- ( if you want them too) or you can be as incognito as you desire). Whatever it is you need — it’s there.  And if things change and you have different needs that’s ok— there is always someone there going through what you are going to.  This site has considerably has changed my mental health for the better.
author: Insouthernwi

title: Game changer
text: This app has been a game changer in my fight to cut down and control my alcohol consumption. Awareness is power and key to change. My ability to track and be aware of how much drink daily has brought to the forefront for me. I also enjoy the facts regarding how alcohol negatively impacts my overall health and ability to accomplish my life goals. I enjoy the daily motivation and tips on how to deal with social situations where drinking is the norm and expected which is most! It holds me accountable and I am nearly a month in and have met my goals and then some. Thank you Reframe!
author: 🐊😃

title: Best thing for sobriety since sliced bread and the toaster
text: I start each day with this app and the daily activities that I have to do. The information that I read is very informative, science based and keeps me from even thinking about drinking alcohol. author: Bosseasy

My favorite part is the knowledge it gives me in a daily basis of what alcohol does to us in a moment and over time. The teachings are what I remember when I have a craving.

The cost is worth it because it’s not that expensive in the long run since the app helps you buy less alcohol!
author: Kounselor77

title: So helpful

author: hapamamax2

author: junglejanny

title: This app is awesome!!

The neuroscience in this app is awesome. The forum for discussion is awesome. The ability to work on yourself without feeling shame & guilt is awesome. author: Reddddddd111111

author: CoffeeismyJam

author: Jbarber5000

author: Mollymadness

title: The Help YOU need
text:
For me, Reframe stands out as a comprehensive support system for anyone looking to build a healthier relationship with alcohol. What makes this app particularly impressive is how it combines science-based approaches with cutting-edge technology.

The daily check-ins and mood tracking help you understand your triggers and patterns, while the educational content explains the science behind alcohol's effects on your body and mind. What sets Reframe apart is its innovative use of AI technology – the app provides personalized, insightful responses to your journal entries and reflections, making it feel like you have a supportive, understanding coach who truly "gets" your unique situation.

The app's text-to-speech feature deserves special mention. Instead of the robotic voices common in many apps, Reframe uses remarkably natural-sounding voice technology that makes the content feel more engaging and personal. Whether you're listening to daily lessons or motivational content, the realistic voice narration makes the experience feel more like a conversation with a caring friend than a digital tool.

The mix of cognitive behavioral therapy techniques and mindfulness exercises provide real alternatives to drinking, while the progress tracking features help visualize your achievements. The emergency toolkit is particularly thoughtful for handling challenging moments.

The community aspect provides a judgment-free space to connect with others on similar journeys, which helps reduce the isolation many feel when changing their drinking habits. The AI-enhanced interaction adds another layer of support, offering personalized insights and encouragement based on your specific entries and progress.

While the subscription cost might seem significant to some, the sophisticated technology, comprehensive support, and daily guidance make it a worthwhile investment in your health and wellbeing. It's like having both a knowledgeable coach and an empathetic friend in your pocket
author: Pristastic!

title: Reframe your thinking.

author: bm1nus

title: A New Approach to Alcohol
text:
After decades of believing that only some people are susceptible to losing control of how alcohol shows up in there lives, Reframe has totally changed my thinking. 

Without shame, blame, or self-deprecating confessions of powerlessness, Reframe shifts the paradigm by showing that anyone who drinks can become emotionally and physically dependent on ethanol (the same chemical additive that fuels your car.) The folks at Reframe shine light on the neurophysiological effects of alcohol - effects to which ALL humans are susceptible, not just broken ones. They also expose powerful sociocultural influences that elevate drinking in every life context, as well as alcohol’s ubiquitous and highly profitable marketing machine. 

The Reframe App provides education, interactive activities, great podcasts, community support, and much more.  

Whether you’re considering cutting back or quitting drinking altogether, or you’re just “sober curious,” I highly recommend the Reframe App.

text: The reviews are great and the product sounds great, I never got the chance to try it because when I signed up, the timing wasn’t right with my schedule and so I wanted to pause and cancel, but that became incredibly difficult. if your product is so great put a cancel button otherwise you lead one to believe it’s all fluff. The app should be removed from the App Store until it has an easy to remove button. It kept trying to charge my bank account, took me weeks to finally get it to cancel.
author: JasonTexas21

title: The “Coin” system is flawed.
text:
Why can’t I access all of the courses when I want? The coin system is keeping me from getting information that could help me right now. For instance I started an introduction course on triggers, but I want to use the self soothing course as well so I have those tools available to me. Why on earth would you limit knowledge? The subscription already covers the cost. Its asinine. Someone explain the reasoning behind withholding information that could be useful in a journey to a sober life?

Edit: I disagree with denying members supplemental resources at their own discretion. I understand laying a framework that progresses from beginner to advanced- but that also assumes that we are all starting at the same place and level of experience with understanding and navigating addiction. 

Not giving those of us who already are familiar with some aspects of recover (but have gaps of knowledge in other places) access to those resources leaves me wanting. 

Gamifying sobriety isn’t an aspect of this app that I can appreciate. Other than that I support the methods being presented. SMART recovery.
author: OllieDenali

title: Why don’t they have this for everything?
text: This is a really useful and incredible tool for anyone doing any mental health work or anyone that just wants to be a MINDFUL drinker. I wasn’t looking to fully become sober, but cut down on my drinking, track it, and become more aware of it after some recent incidents. This app is so worth it. I’ve told all my friends about it and health care workers so they can spread the word. I really can’t believe we live in such a culture where drinking is so common and so prevalent but SO. BAD. FOR. US. Anyways, kudos to who developed it. I’m grateful.
author: Caitlin9090

title: The best, most important, app I’ve ever purchased
text:
I’ve had a rocky relationship with alcohol over the past couple of years and recently have been curious about cutting back, or even quitting. I tried a few times but, without support, fell back into my old habits after a few days. 

With this app, I have been successful. It gives me the tools I need for success. The fact that it’s so science-based and focuses on why we drink is great. 

If you’re curious, get this app. You’ll save well more than this app costs by not buying alcohol anymore!
author: G3odude

title: Not AA…BETTER for people like me
text: Didn’t think an app would have enough to help me quit alcohol…until Reframe. I have no words to describe how invaluable the tools provided have helped me quit alcohol completely. Supportive and more informative than I EVER imagined. The science behind what alcohol does to the human body backs EVERYTHING on the app. And the community is unsurpassed. I have “friends” all over the world now. If you are questioning your relationship with drinking, try it out. You have nothing to lose…but you might get your life back better than ever!
author: AntlersMay

title: Reframe Review!
text:
For the price of what I used to spend on ONE NIGHT of drinks out, I have a comprehensive tool to improve my health, relationships and work career. That’s a bargain! 
    Reframe is a solid, no nonsense approach to a baffling, multifaceted problem. It allows me to maintain focus on healing, without being preachy or judgmental. 
     Nothing will work for everyone. It’s just not that simple. However, once a person makes the decision to pursue a positive change in their life by facing their alcohol problem, this app is a very powerful ally to help achieve that goal! 
    5 stars, all day long!
author: Motorrad12

title: Read this
text: Reframe definitely has solid content. The app functionality is subpar for what you pay. I had issues from the start and after 9 days of trying to troubleshoot, I gave up. They use a third party tech support that is less than helpful. They also have a guarantee refund, but if you read the fine print, you gotta challenge thru your bank. Lastly, the helpful content they give you is in 3 min increments daily. I feel they are a 70/30 split of making money and helping. Lastly, they charge 50-70$ more if you want more help than what’s included. Reframe could be the next evolution in helping, but, at least in my experience it is about making money from vulnerable persons
author: DoSleepOn

title: Yes…do it
text:
I have been struggling for years with casual drinking and being ok. 
But after Covid I have been drinking and gambling way to much…and I seem to be more attracted to the behaviors that make me feel terrible about myself. 
This program… in 1week has enlightened me to be more focused on myself and to focus more on what a alcohol free life can be. The science behind this program is very simple and interesting. Thank you for a program that speaks to me as a professional that I do not have to go to a meeting. It is in the palm of my hand and in my private time.
author: TLord3

title: Do it
text: If you want to quit drinking or cut back this is the app. I am 6 months alcohol free after using it. It has daily lessons that are science based and make sense. There’s a forum you can post on and read what others are going through. And they have meetings every day where you can hear from others who are going through the same thing as you and you can share but only if you want to! I really can’t recommend it enough and I don’t think I’d have made it this far without this community
author: kennychesley

title: Nothing but upsides
text:
I am so glad I signed up with Reframe a few months ago. I was growing increasingly less comfortable with my alcohol use but wasn’t really sure how to approach it. Reframe really helped me feel empowered and confident with my relationship to drinking. I am now very clear about who is in the driver’s seat! In three months I have cut down my total drinks by at least half, and have way more nights that I go without drinking at all. As an added bonus I am sleeping more soundly and my anxiety is definitely decreased as well.

Thanks Reframe Team!
author: NomadicQ

title: Week = Excellent
text: After only 1 week this app still keeping me motivated/engaged It’s just enough to educate & motivate while tracking consumption.  I hate food journaling, but this was/is easier: you don’t have to bother with what you drank or when (at in the 1st 2 weeks) so it’s super easy.  For 5 mins of effort the return is obvious.  It keeps me honest to myself - what else matters when changing habits or dieting or drinking less.  My goal is reduction not quitting, so I can’t comment on its effectiveness for people trying to stop entirely.  Good Luck 😎👍
author: Kaz toe

title: Truly is helpful and informative
text: I feel like it’s a taboo if you say you wanna ease up on drinking. People look at you like “OH, you must have a drinking problem”. But with this app, it has been very educational with driven scientific facts. A bonus it has a lot of helpful suggestions that can work for you individually. YOU can pick and choose!  It’s not just summed up as a hole. Because obviously everyone is different with different situations. I Thank everybody here for putting the time and effort but this wonderful app. together ❣️
author: Zmbtt

title: Game changer for me
text: I love & appreciate this app. It has been helpful for me to check in. There’s many different aspects to this app to fine tune it to your needs & learn what works for you during this life journey. The forum is welcoming & no judgment. You can & ought to be honest to be true to yourself using the forum & all the different tools on here. If you’re here then I would highly suggest giving it a try. You have nothing to lose & all to gain. It’s funny, I’ve been on here since March & I don’t know how I found this app but I am ever grateful. Peace.
author: MidwesternGurl

title: Educational App
text: Alcoholism runs in my family.  I wanted to find a source of information to understand it and offer better advice to loved ones who were struggling. Al Anon was not readily available and I wanted something easy to access. Reframe is the science of alcohol’s impacts on the human body and mind.  Learning why we like it, want more and the consequences is empowering.  This app teaches one to enjoy, control or quit alcohol.  I don’t think they teach this in AA.  I share this app with friends and family.  I enjoy a good white wine and will continue in moderation.
author: wecansolvethis

title: Wonderful Tool
text: I just started using Reframe a few days ago, in tandem with my return to an alcohol support group. The Reframe program is a great support to keep me motivated to stay dry. The daily tasks are engaging and informative. The application programming itself, is well thought out and intuitive. I plan to continue using Reframe as a companion to my support group, so that I have a strong toolkit to help me maintain my sobriety. I would encourage anyone who is curious about or activity participants in a sober lifestyle, to check Reframe out. (I give it two thumbs up!)
author: cspies87

title: It’s definitely helping me!
text: I decided to do Dry January and felt that I needed some extra help if I was going to be successful. My friend told me about Reframe. It has been super-helpful! I’ve learned a lot about alcohol that I never knew-information that has helped me stay dry. Also, I’ve been impressed with the mood checks. Occasionally, Reframe checks you for depression and anxiety. I see a doctor for those things and I recognize the questions Reframe uses from my experience with him. This is a real high quality app. And it works!
author: Jaythedrummer123

title: Reframe !!
text: Ive been lost and clinched to alcohol for years, trying to find ways to stop myself from consuming as much as I did. I was unaware of the harm I was doing to my body until one day I came across Reframe. I’m not the usual type to pay after a free trial, but reframe changed that for me. When I’m on this app not only am I getting knowledge from alcohol intake and the severity of it , but I am also receiving so much support from everyone that uses this app. I’ve never felt so supported until I came across this app. I love reframe!
author: Mr.Gutierrez 💪🏾

title: Evidence based
text: I love ReFrame because it centers around the scientific, medical and psychological aspects of problem drinking.  Given facts about why, understanding of the mechanisms involved makes the process of cutting down or quitting much easier.  No more believing I am powerless to change and must entreat “something greater than me” to allow me to change.  Reframe presents a set of tools that make sense to me and make it easier to effect change.  The bottom line though, is you have to want to change or nothing will work.
author: psiu06

title: Just what I needed.
text: I’ve struggled for about a decade to meditate drinking. When I realized I may need to stop I tried and failed after a month. I didn’t have the tools to get through the social pressures.l and cravings. This app’s science-backed daily readings, activities, trackers, and support groups have absolutely solved that problem. My life has completely changed in every aspect: work, personal, and spiritual. Not only that, it has paid for it self in the money I’ve saved from not drinking. This is a no brained if you want to quit.
author: ReinFogsNow

title: If you’re even slightly questioning your drinking…
text: …then download this app. This is my first app review but I can’t think of a more useful and educational tool I’ve ever had around alcohol. This is the education we all should receive in school. I’m 100 days sober and this app and the community forum feature have been a huge part of that. I started out on the cutback track but after learning more about alcohol through this app I decided to completely cut it out and it’s literally the best decision I’ve ever made for myself.
author: KammaClaire

title: Sneaky!!!
text: I’m going to reluctantly flatter the developers for succeeding at giving the “appearance” of a wholesome, safe environment. But 9 days after purchasing I noticed that the forum is moderated by patronizing, cliche-driven fake “support”. The real drive of the app is to push 1-1 coaching and additional classes. Comments are filtered. Nothing debatable exists in the forums. Very few people are actually posting or discussing real life issues. The app is an insult to my intelligence. It completely lacks transparency. There is no way to contact the developer with questions. There’s no email provided. The educational aspect is well-done but requires you read only a little a day. You can not jump ahead and keep going in the learning process. Looks pretty but ends up being a disappointment.
author: LongIsland&Cragsmoor

title: A godsend
text:
I’m only on day three of using this app, but so far it’s the only thing that’s actually made me stop drinking. I’ve been unbearably stressed over the last couple of months after losing my job and being unable to find another one, and I’ve been drinking heavily every night. My  drinking problems, like most people’s, began very gradually over time—so gradually that I didn’t realize it was turning into an actual problem until a few months ago. I’d say I’ve been a relatively heavy drinker for a couple years now, mostly from the stress of working in the hospitality industry during covid, and it’s just gotten so much worse the last couple of months.
 
I’ve tried therapy sessions, AA just isn’t my thing right now since most meetings are virtual and I just cannot get into it, but this app has helped me not drink a single drop of alcohol for two whole days. It might seem small to some, but for me it’s a huge deal. I’ve had cravings here and there, but I’ve been using the craving mode in the Reframe toolbox when they surface, and so far I’ve been successful in not even considering going to the liquor store. I’ve not yet arrived at a point in my addiction where I’m experiencing any of the physical effects of withdrawal—it’s pretty much all psychological at this point—so if that’s your case then this app may not be enough for you, I’m not sure. All I know is, I’ve woken up feeling great instead of hungover and groggy two mornings in a row, and it’s truly all thanks to this app. 

I was skeptical about the price per month at first, but the $25 I’ve spent thus far has already saved me that much or more in the cost of alcohol I probably would’ve bought were it not for downloading Reframe. For now I’m trying to just cut back significantly on my drinking to get it down to what’s considered safe by national health guidelines. I’m highly confident I can make it to the end of the week without giving in, which is the goal I’ve set on the app. There are tons of features that have kept me engaged and motivated, and I haven’t even explored them all yet. It’s almost like therapy without the shame and fear of judgement that inevitably comes with disclosing one’s problems to a person face to face, and it’s always a few clicks away in my pocket whenever I need it. So very grateful I found Reframe! I highly recommend it, whether you’re a gray area drinker or a heavy drinker like myself. Time to stop wasting away my body and making more time for what’s important.
author: nicknamebrokentryagain

title: It works!
text: I love this app. It’s so engaging that I actually look forward to my Reframe time each day. And most importantly, it works.
