There are support options for abstaining completely or just cutting back. I’m on my 15th consecutive day without alcohol coming off of a long run of pretty regular use. I don’t intend to stay dry forever, but I have confidence that I will be able to enjoy alcohol in moderation with the tools, techniques and mindset I’m learning from this app. Take back your power and live to your full potential with Reframe!
author: Weezy_16

title: Theory & Praxis
text: This app is incredible. It uses evidence based practices and includes personal experiences to help build a model for alcohol use disorders that actually works. I learn something new daily and there are a myriad other tools that aid in my ability to cease alcohol consumption completely. At Reframe they don’t advocate or enforce abstinence only and (for some reason) this has helped me completely abstain! From meditations, breathing exercises, therapy, games, to classes this app is the only one I need on my road to healing from alcohol use spectrum disorder. I am so grateful.
author: Alelí82

title: Amazing app
text: This app provides motivation to stay sober on multiple levels. I love the daily readings and tasks that give me an education on alcohol and how I relate to it. Even after going through AA, an outpatient program, and individual therapy, I am still finding new information and new understanding on why certain CBT tasks are beneficial. The readings and tasks are locked until you complete days so it’s always a new surprise to see what to focus on. I also like that the coping strategies are all in one place and that there is the ability to connect to a community.
author: soberhippy

title: Accountability
text: After years of beating myself up and poor decisions, I decided to try the Reframe app. My goal was to cut back, which I’ve tried to do on my own many times without much success. The guidance the app gives you along with articles and a variety of support communities based on who you are has opened my eyes to how I can change my relationship with alcohol. I feel that the Reframe app and the daily tasks hold me accountable for the decisions I make on a daily basis. Daily note to self: Let’s do this!
author: Ma Pts

title: Reframe your whole!!
text:
The app is not just about cutting back on alcohol. It’s about giving you a new perspective on the decisions that you make day today and how you navigate life. Help you look at past patterns of behavior that have a negative impact hence the name of the app Reframe.  I think it’s great.

Each day there are small tasks that keep you motivated and focusing on the baby steps that you’re working towards making real change in your life. 

The material covers all aspects and some topics are revisited to reinforce learning because you may not be focusing on that negative information on that day.

There’s a great discussion supporting one another. There’s challenges to keep you motivated and just good sessions about life.

I also like that some of the readings have dictation, which is beneficial because sometimes reading gets exhausted and I just wanna hear the material drinking coffee.
author: Mara937

title: Probably the best investment in myself I’ve made
text: Reframe has wholly changed me. My relationship to alcohol is forever different. I knew I wanted to adopt a fully healthy lifestyle and cut back on anything that could affect my mental clarity and when I found Reframe I didn’t know what to expect. I wanted to cut way back on drinking and have found I may not do it much at all. I no longer need it to unwind after a long and tough day. I work through those feelings mindfully and focus more on emotional regulation through DBT and other modalities of mindfulness.
author: ATODMagazine

title: False 60-day money back guarantee
text:
They expect you to use the app every day for 60 days to get your money back. They didn’t state this explicitly at the time. Don’t try it if you think you could miss a day in your busy schedule while trying to change habits. In the end, I was getting the help I needed from other places, and the app wasn’t something I needed as much. I thought if I didn’t find it useful in 60 days I’d just stop using the app, but they’re not giving me a refund now.

This refund is a complete scam. I was charged $30/month and now they’re saying it is the app stores fault when they explicitly told me it is because I didn’t use it for 60 days straight. Please stop lying to us even in your app review response. Thank you.
author: Dale Kronbauer

title: Reframe is worth every penny!
text: If you want to cut back on or completely eliminate alcohol, this app is a great start. It’s really easy to use and extremely informative. I didn’t want to eliminate completely - just cut back - but this app keeps me on track. There are a lot of tips to help with cravings, a goal tracker, and outside assistance with other users in the forum. I have had the app for less than two weeks, and it will pay for itself within another week. I am beginning to see and feel positive results!
author: dgfgjvdg

title: Exactly what I needed
text: This app helps guide you.  It doesn’t tell you. Everyone’s relationship with alcohol is different.  It has helped me reflect on my decisions to use alcohol as a crutch and how to move past my triggers.  I have stopped drinking for periods of time, but find myself right back where I started.  Drinking too much and not feeling well.  When I started this app to “decrease my drinking”. I found that what they were saying was exactly what I was thinking.  I always felt alone with my struggles with Alcohol, now I don’t
author: BNorrisNH

title: Very Helpful
text: If you are in a spot in life, like I had been, where obsessing about having that next wine, or beer, or rum & coke is the most important thing in life right now, the app could be the trigger needed to bring you compassion for yourself, kindness & forgiveness for yourself because you now understand that you are not a bad person - it’s biological science that has hijacked your brain.  And the good news is, you can get out of the loop, like I have.  I strongly recommend you give this a chance.  It worked for me.
author: Badkitty63

title: Finally Free~
text: Reframe is a dynamic low pressure app for those seeking to change their relationship with alcohol. I am impressed with all the avenues for support including the sober curious. You can hang solo, listen to group meetings or podcasts, self monitor, connect with coaches, and share with others on similar journeys towards better health. The app is a fabulous tool for anyone who just takes the chance to try something different. I haven’t had any alcohol for 6 weeks  and much of my success so far is this amazing resource. 😎
author: Adelais10

title: Love this app and continue to use it daily
text: I've been using reframe for multiple years.  I initially signed on looking for recuction, and finally decided to leave alcohol behind a long time ago.  I still learn something every single day I use the app, and of course it's gone well beyond anything to do with alcohol which is the underpinning of it's success: it's about personal growth that happens to result in less dependence on substances.  It's worth doing, and then continuing to do after any desired outcome with alcohol is achieved.
author: dgerrity

title: Disappointing
text: I had trouble initially logging in when I first downloaded the app and had to remake my profile several times. Once I downloaded it, I tried to log my drinks and it won’t save my information. When I tried to set the weekly baseline it also would not save. I tried restarting my phone and nothing changed. This has been over several weeks I tried to get it to work and I’m a patient person, but it’s not saving my information and it’s very disappointing that I paid for an app to help me reach my goals and it is just a source of frustration. I had my fiancé who works in tech check it and said I have everything set correctly and it should work. Very disappointed, do not recommend.
author: Anna Kay Art

title: Daily wine at night….creeping up on me
text: That glass of wine in the evening to relax and reward myself for the day developed into two and then sometimes three. It began to worry me. I didn’t want to become more dependent or addicted and didn’t want the health risks either. I didn’t think I needed to never drink again so wanted support to sort this out and cut back, way back. Reframe does that. Learning more through daily readings and setting goals has been exactly what I needed! Feeling better already after just 2 weeks.
author: Heidibeasle

title: Helping me reach my goals
text: I have found this app instrumental in helping me start my cut back journey. I still have work to do but I could not have taken the first step (reaching for the wine bottle without even thinking) if it wasn’t for the readings and the trackers in this app.  I highly recommend using this app if you are serious about starting your journey. You will be able to see your progress. You will be holding yourself account for your choices. You will be able to celebrate your wins.
author: Chuckle-dog

title: Factual and non-shaming!
text:
I’ve always known that my relationship with alcohol was a risky one. Sometimes I could control my consumption, other times would lead to blacking out and making mistakes. I’ve tried to reduce my use many times, but finally was confronted with it not being the route for me. 

Since using reframe I’ve been alcohol free (coming from 4 drinks a day)! This app has encouraged me and empowered me in ways I never would have believed! It’s all fact base, never using shame or higher power language, and gives space for you to tackle this journey in whatever way you see fit (cutting back, being alcohol free, etc.). 

The forum feature offers community when you feel stuck and the reflection features give space to better understanding alcohols role in your life. 

100% the best thing I did when my therapist advised me to go to AA. Instead I’ve done reframe!
author: MSchleif

title: Useful but too expensive
text:
I like this app. The reading content is useful and informative and gives me something to chew on as far as to my “why” and the little games in the “craving” section are a good distraction technique. But this is just too expensive for a recovery app. It’s almost elitist. 
Also, the forums seem very edited. Every response is written the same tone of voice with no spelling errors or individual personality, which makes the overall  feel  of forum “interactivity” manufactured (IMO.)  I did not try the coaching though. I just wish this was less expensive.
author: BnMc01

title: Reframe
text: Excellent program to help me cut back my drinking. The neuroscience behind alcohol and the brain is explained clearly. I have learned valuable, useful information that has been instrumental in my journey. The feedback and support I have found through the app is beyond anything I expected. Response to technical questions are answered quickly and input from the client community is taken seriously which is very helpful. Give this app a try as I did, you will not regret it. Literally, it has changed my life.
author: ronizoom

title: Great idea but too inefficient for me
text: Like many people I have a busy lifestyle with a lot of responsibilities between work, family, etc.  This app requires too much constant attention and felt like another chore on the days I did use it. Because of this chore feeling there were many days I ignored the app over the last 10 months I’ve been subscribed. After a period of days or weeks not paying attention to the app, I logged back in and the app had just made the assumption that I had not had a drink for all those days. It falsely claims over the last several months I have saved thousands of dollars and had had over 300 days under my drink limit - Ha
author: everynickmaneichooseistaken

title: Awesome for any one trying to cut back or quit alcohol
text: This is so much better than AA! Can also supplement AA. So much information and so so much support in this app! It teaches you all the neuroscience of why and how we do what we do along with all the latest data on how to slow down or stop. Love that their are so many daily meetings and a option for one on one! There are tons of articles, meditation, places for writing personal thoughts and experiences. They left no stone unturned. Well worth the investment for your health. Great community.
author: coolezister

title: Life changing
text: This app tackles every angle possible basically to get you to comprehend the choices you are making everyday with alcohol and how they affect you mentally, physically, and behavior- wise. It uses science and easy to read, comprehensive information that is quickly absorbed and understood. The support of the community on the app is outstanding, there’s times I needed them and they were there! Quitting alcohol has never been easier and I’ve never felt more confident in my ability and choice to be alcohol free.
author: Redddddd3333

title: Excellent tool for quitting
text: Reframe is just the nudge I needed to start making better choices for my health. The daily tasks and tracking metrics are just the right amount of accountability for me, and I’ve found the investment in my time + the monthly fee is WELL compensated in improvements to my physical and mental health. The chat forum is a wonderful place to turn for anonymous community support and feedback on struggles and wins. Health insurance companies would save tons of money by offering a Reframe subscription to anyone who wants it, in my opinion.
author: Bagofshitballs

title: Loving this app!
text: I am loving this app! I feel like I am becoming happier and healthier in so many areas of my life.  This app provides suggestions, coaching, videos, exercises and a wealth of information on what and how to thrive after cutting back or living alcohol free. When I need advice, motivation, knowledge or compassion I turn to this app. I have heard the saying that removing alcohol is the easy part. This app is great for helping people deal with what comes after. I am using it to help me organize and construct my life into what I would like it to be.
author: LeighAnn777

title: Very helpful tool
text: I was an AA member 12 years ago and was sober for 4 years. Sobriety changed my lofe but then I stopped attending meetings and started gradually drinking again. I've considered going back to meetings over the years but have felt some trepidation. I found reframe and it's helped me understand cognitively how drinking harms me (AA helped me have a loved experience of sobriety and helped me find a community of like minded sober friends. Aa is invaluable). I feel that reframe fills in the gaps in my learn and resolve to stop drinking, it has helped, too! Def recommended this app!
author: Megan Elise C

title: Thank god for this app
text: On my ninth day of sobriety after tackling my drinking habits and the problems from over, drinking often on for years with no lasting success, this app gives me knowledge and motivation to stay on course and understand my difficulties, and give me great reasons to stop drinking. If I do drink again in the future, it would be a completely different relationship and never will be a daily drinker again in my life. Thank you to all the good people who worked to create this transformative tool.
author: Jevon77

title: Powerful Recovery App
text:
Reframe gets it right in so many ways.  From availability of meetings , tools, ability to create groups, daily tasks. Challenges, etc, this is an excellent space to work on relationship with alcohol.  
I did use a coach, she was superb in every way.
I would urge reframe to solicit feedback from members frequently, and, to make sure chat moderators are focusing on alcohol usage within all topics, and, refraining from presenting diagnoses of any kind as chat topics. 
I feel very grateful for this App, it has helped me make progress that I had determined wasn’t even possible
author: EpisodeofGrace

title: It works
text: This app is amazing. I’m 30 days sober and I am 100% sure it’s because of this app. I do engage (at least) daily, complete all daily tasks and visit the forum. I work in healthcare but have learned so much from this app. I now know that I was a grey zone drinker. High functioning, I was never going to hit “rock bottom”, but I could not seem to quit. The pull was too strong. 30 days later, I am happier and healthier then ever. I’m more productive, sleep better and present with my children. Sober life is the best! ❤️ thank you reframe
author: Ransmom

title: Great tool - for any level of cutting back
text:
I have found this app to be easy to use, educational, motivating, and habit-forming in the most positive, beneficial way. 

From my perspective, the content could be helpful and engaging for any degree of cutting back, from a slight reduction in consumption to full abstinence. 

The daily tasks and toolkit are just do well thought out and offer great positive reinforcement. I tend to stray from it after a while, but found it valuable enough to pay for a subscription for two years now.
author: BigBigBigBigBoss

title: A new start ❤️
text:
I was berating myself constantly for not being able to moderate my drinking. I really love the flexibility that this app has given me, and the information on the science behind the effects of alcohol. 
  It also encourages me to treat myself compassionately while untangling the negative effects that alcohol has had on my life.  
  I am currently about 80 days alcohol free, and have successfully chosen to have a few drinks here and there. This seems like it would have been impossible previously. Thank you, Reframe!
author: Swimpinkhank

title: Very impressed
text: I have to say this app has blown me away. Not only has it actually helped me cut back on alcohol but they have made it so user friendly and actually enjoyable to use. I am so so happy I decided to give this a try, it’s exactly what I needed as someone feeling the desire to re-evaluate my relationship with alcohol. The app is psychology based and provides education, journal entries, classes, workshops, a community forum, meditation, and really so much more. I am excited to continue with my reframe journey and share with others!
author: sammm54321

title: My favorite app, ever!
text:
For those of us who respond to a more open, individualized approach to cutting back on or quitting alcohol, this app is fantastic.  It holds you accountable to yourself and is informative, encouraging and very user friendly.  
I was skeptical at first, but I really enjoy this app and it’s been indispensable on my journey back to better health.  I’ve also had a few questions along the way, and they’re extremely responsive and personable.  Just a very positive experience that puts me in a great “frame” of mind.
author: kcm0005

title: Powerful and different
text: Perfect sobriety (or cutback) guide for someone factor science based. Great for me because I’m not religious and AA isn’t really a suitable option for me. The forum and community is truly the most beneficial aspect of this app. We keep one another accountable, offer recommendations or advice, and support one another. Before, when I quit, it was from a place of anger or resentment that I couldn’t be “normal”. This app focuses on how normal you are, and shifts thinking to the positive components of cutting back or abstinence. Would recommend 100x over.
author: Yoyoyoyoyoyfdh

title: Reframe is a Great App
text: With the Reframe App I have cutback my drinking with the hope of going alcohol free for the first time in 15+ years of daily drinking. I have tried to quit many times on my own but the science behind reframe really made the connection for me. The cravings are less and feel like I am on a positive trajectory for the first time in many years. I’ve only used the app for a week and chose to actually purchase it based on the progress I made in that one week. I will keep using it daily. Thanks Reframe!!
author: Warrant Princess

title: CHANGED. MY. LIFE.
text: This app is great for anyone re-thinking their relationship with alcohol. It gives you real facts about the effects of alcohol on your body and brain, as well as strategies you can use immediately in your daily life. There’s access to a community of people including tons of daily meeting options led by credentialed moderators. This is NOT a 12-step program, and can easily be integrated into any lifestyle or identification along the alcohol use spectrum. It has literally changed my life since day one.
author: Bluestarz921

title: Review
text:
I love the Forum aspect of this program helps me to know I am not alone and there are many others out there that are going through the same thing.
The daily checklist is awesome works well with accountability and the information information is extremely helpful and useful 
I love the ability to be anonymous if I choose too.  
The tracker for days on program sleep $ saved is all great.  
Has helped me to view this in a different way so that I don’t have to feel ashamed.
author: Smit$y

title: Best app!
text: I've been doing this up for a couple of months now. It is truly an amazing! It has helped me significantly, and I love all the tools that are at my disposal. I look forward to doing my daily tasks and reading through the forum. There are meditations, podcasts, support groups, ideas and helpful insights, motivations. Whoever put this together did a fabulous job. There is something in this app for everyone whatever and wherever they may be in their journey. If I could get more than five stars I would!
author: KHG2

title: Exactly what I needed to regain control
text:
I’m so thankful I stumbled across Reframe!! After Covid, my alcohol consumption took on a life of its own. I knew it was a problem, but every day would be the same……I would drink, and oftentimes more than I should. 

With Reframe, the truth is exposed-that alcohol is a neurotoxin, and it’s not entirely my fault for what I was doing. That truth and Reframe’s education about the body, mind, brain chemicals etc. gave me the knowledge I needed to start making small positive changes.  I started by reducing first, and that felt so good that I’m now working on 30 days alcohol free! 

I am still learning new things for my overall health. It’s like a wise friend walking along with me on my journey. I feel much more in control of my drinking!

This has all come about by investing in the Reframe app. Being in control and living a healthier lifestyle is worth it!! 

THANKS REFRAME!!
author: CocoSoCal

title: Has potential, needs some work
text:
Perhaps if I were 20 years younger, my review would be a little higher, as I feel like this app is very much geared to a younger audience. 

Initially, I found the daily tasks helpful as they focused on the science of why one drinks in excess. As the modules moved more to emotional effects of drinking, it seemed like the advice was very much geared to the 20-30-something crowd. The recovery stories in the daily tasks are all young which is great if you are young, but not relatable as a person who is middle aged and beyond. Also, some of the advice columns offered what seemed to be very pat answers to complex issues - that needs some work.

The forum was great - lots of very supportive people going through the same challenges. I also liked the trackers for the money and calories I was saving by not drinking. 

Clearly, this is an app designed by younger people for younger people - and as I said, a younger person battling alcohol dependence will probably find this a useful sobriety tool.
author: DeirdreChristine

title: The why behind bad habits
text: I really enjoy the perspective brought by the Reframe app. You don’t need to label your relationship with alcohol. You can also be human and have a deviation from your plan without losing all of your progress. Rather, Reframe helps you be more compassionate to yourself and understand the ‘whys’ driving our patterns - beyond bad or good. I was seeking support in changing how I socialize and how I balance stress. If you are curious about what your life would be like without alcohol, Reframe is a fantastic place to help!
author: owen743

title: Backed by research and science
text: I love that the app has a cutback track and an alcohol free track for anyone looking to change how alcohol is showing up in their life.  There are daily tasks, toolkit, discover tab, meetings, a posting forum, as well as coaches. I haven’t been able to cutback very well on my own, but by committing about 15/minutes a day on the app, I’ve cut my alcohol by 50%, lost weight, reduced stressed, sleeping better, and saved more than the annual membership costs. Highly recommend and  best wishes on your journey.
author: Estrogenrocks

title: 1 Year Sober - Life Changing and Life Saving App
text: I love this app so very much!! I’m not sure if I can add anything more than the other reviews, but this app (and working the ACoA 12 step program) saved my life. I can’t recommend it enough. Initially I got the free trial of the app in November 2021 because of the Instagram ads and figured why not, after a few months of working through the app and some rough holidays I then promised myself I’d do dry January 2022, and now its January 2023 and I’m celebrating a YEAR sober and counting. Thank you for this app!!
author: HuxleyW

title: A fun, authentic way to learn, be inspired + check in with myself daily!
text: I LOVE reframe! I didn’t join as an epic drinker, but I wanted to learn about how alcohol affects my body + brain. I did the free month, then immediately signed up for the year. I find this such a fun, inspiring, educational way to stay focused on living my best life! I think of Reframe as my mini life coach. I dive deeper myself into some topics + fly through others, but the diversity of topics from health, relationships, mindfulness, self love, psychological concepts - are sooo great to learn about!! Thank you!
author: GemPuddy

title: Happy customer!
text: I’ve never been one to commit to a program; however, I have found myself checking in with this app daily. If it weren’t for reframe, the daily tasks, and the wonderful support offered by others, I wouldn’t be 26 days alcohol free today. This is the longest I’ve gone without drinking in years! I’m soo proud of myself and I wouldn’t have been able to do it without this app. I just paid for the 1 year membership and I’m so happy that I found reframe. Thank you!
author: enrgaged customer

title: Works for me!
text: Reframe continually surprises me with the quality of the information it gives me about the effects of alcohol on the various organs of the body (including the brain). I believe it’s getting me to rethink (okay, “reframe”) how I think about alcohol so I see the whole picture. I’ve been to AA, SMART, read books, but, for me, Reframe has the tools (meetings, tasks to make me think, seminars, reminders), encouragement, availability and seriousness that work for me. These folks have put together literally, a life-changing app.
author: LilLotte1050

title: Lack of app support
text:
The community and the learnings have been life saving without question. 
I will be critical of recent changes to the app where the flow of the daily work is being interrupted by disruptive requests for app feedback every single day. Imagine you’re reading a book and as soon as you turn the page, someone comes by and closes the book, gets in you face and won’t give you the book back until you tell them how the last page was.  Every single day. Support has responded “we’re trying to fix it”. This has been going on for months to no avail.
author: HIghlander GM

title: Worth every penny
text:
I rarely write reviews but if someone is looking for resources to help change their relationship with alcohol do try this app. It’s helped me stay alcohol free for 50 days. 

You can learn so much about alcohol misuse/dependence through a scientific lens that helps shed the mysticism and shame attached. There are mini actionable suggestions each day that really build up to make a long term difference.

There’s also a sympathetic community moderated by experts and coaches that helps you feel less alone and helpless. I find the meetings to be really helpful, I listen in anonymously (haven’t felt up to share yet but want to one day) and find what people share to be inspiring and empowering. It’s helped me become less judgmental toward myself.

A giant thank you to the developers, you’re making a product that’s truly making a positive difference.
author: Carolin1985

title: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
text: With so many apps out there I took a chance on Reframe and was not disappointed.  As of today I’m 30 days alcohol free and counting. I’m so impressed with the tools the app provides.  The daily tasks, community forums, zoom meetings,tools for meditation, cravings, and science knowledge behind the affects of alcohol.  No judgment within the Reframe community whether your journey is to cut back or go alcohol free.  I’m so happy to find Reframe for my journey to a better healthier lifestyle.  Download this app if you’re serious about changing your lifestyle!
author: Deep & Dope

title: Informative & helpful
text:
I first purchased Reframe when I wanted to reduce my consumption; like any tool, we get out of it what we put into it.  The first few weeks I was merely tracking my drinks, not really digging into the daily reading.  After a break, I found I wanted to come back to the application and seriously make better progress.  The more I check in with Reframe daily, the better my results. 

There is information presented in many forms , scientific, holistic, and includes useful meditations.
author: Cassidy lol

title: Love this app!
text: I’ve been using it for 3 days and wow I feel so different. I’ve been able to manage my urges to drink and even to over eat. I love the zoom meetings. They showed me how im not alone on this journey. I love all the Ted talks that are available that help you understand how addiction works. I like that all they do or have you do rather, seems to be science based. I look forward to opening the app first thing in the morning and completing my daily tasks and doing some meditation. 100% recommend
author: Lisseth389

title: Help! Dates do not appear.
text:
Dates no longer appear as markers, rather the days you are on your journey.  This makes it very difficult to go back and track when I have not logged for a while. Normally I could go back and fill in and somehow, after not logging in for several weeks, I selected an option to start logging in at orient date and it has now cut out like 21 days. Please help me set back to the way it was. 
Other than that this app has greatly helped my cut back journey. Love all the tools and learning info is very helpful.
author: YSRose

title: doesnt acknowledge slipups
text: This is a good early phase app, but is not effective at acknowledging when drinking goals arent met. I documented that I drank, but it didn't translate to the zero drink streak (or change the boilerplate language of each days' lessons), so that it continues to count non-drinking days. I could not figure out how to change the settings, or start over with a new non-drinking streak. There is a lot to like, but maybe I'm not savvy enough. I reset something and now it has put me back to the date I first started using the app. I may end up deleting the app if I can't render it useable again. If this description sounds confusing then I have captured my frustration perfectly.
author: gil54667

title: Super Helpful
text:
I’ve found this app super helpful in helping me to be more mindful about my drinking habits. Just stopping to think about it each day is a great way to reframe how you typically drink. 

I’ve also learned quite a bit in the month that I’ve used it. I only want to cut back my drinking and this app has been great for that…even when I go over my weekly goal I still appreciate how the app works for me. It doesn’t shame me but rather inspires me to want to do better. 
Thank you!
author: Jolbra

title: Dude!
text:
Dude, reframe is the only reason I am where I’m at. Literally the most useful thing I’ve ever done in my life. I was really losing hope that I could be the person I wanted to be. Reframe changed everything for me. I tried so much that didn’t stick!  Therapy, counseling, support groups, even medication! Nothing made me really understand what was going on in my life. Reframe taught me so much, and helped me learn so much. I’m still not sure if I believe how much greater of a person I’ve become. 

Thanks Mel!! You da best!!!
author: Dunkin'Duncan

title: Ok app, customer service is A.I.
text:
I wanted to completely restart my progress, but the settings to do so do not work.  It restarted me on day one for the lessons, but I still had drinks logged on my calendar, a 3-day streak badge, money saved, etc.

When I tried emailing them I received a timely response telling me to use the settings that I already had tried (and I said that in my email). I tried again, still didn’t work, so I emailed them again and the response I got was exactly word for word the response I had got before. Sorry but if I’m paying $120 a year for your app I expect to be able to communicate with a real person.

Deleted and refunded.
author: j6a6

title: Worth every cent
text: I initially downloaded Reframe to help me cut back on drinking. After the free trial, I decided to purchased a year subscription. I finished the tasks around 310 days out of 365 and erratically tracked my drinking. After the year was up, I read This Naked Mind by Annie Grace, which is often recommended in the Reframe forum. I decided to cut out alcohol all together 60 days ago and haven’t looked back. This app is the perfect way to start unlearning all the lies about alcohol and will inspire you to go further. Highly recommend!
author: hxi ne zo

title: Super Helpful!
text: This app has been more helpful than I anticipated.  I signed up for the free trial and decided to purchase the subscription.  It has so many tools to help me on my cutback journey.  What I’ve paid for this app is more than the amount of $ I’ve saved not buying alcohol.  The community using this app is super supportive.  There are optional, free, closed Zoom meetings you can attend throughout the day/evening too.  What you put into this app are the results you will get from it too.  Highly recommend!
author: GoldenGamer_silly

title: High Fives All Around
text: I started Reframe over a month ago and I have used it every single day since. I am now over 30 days alcohol free. This app has a lot of good information about the science of alcohol and what it does to the body/brain. The app also includes meditations, challenges and a wonderful forum full of amazing people that are eager to listen and help as much as they can. There is so much more included with this app so if you are sober curious or just plain ready to stop drinking - check it out!
author: Butterbean45

title: So helpful
text: For years I’ve wanted to cut way back on my drinking. Reframe has been an incredibly useful tool in helping me do that. I started using it in the fall, stopped during the winter holiday season when my drinking picked up, and then began using it again at the end of January. The information is presented in an easy to digest manner. And, it’s interesting and motivational too! I’m so happy that I decided to purchase this app. I would say it is an essential part of my commitment to a major lifestyle change.
author: VV Maya

title: Great app!
text: I signed up for this app because I wanted to decrease my intake of alcohol but didn’t realize the impact it did and continues to have. The education you get about what it does to your body, the tools like meditation and breathing, and the accountability logs have really changed my mindset. The forum is probably my favorite part though. You really feel heard, understood and encouraged. It’s a game changer for me. I think this app would benefit everyone but especially those who want to cut back or quit alcohol all together.
author: no more martinis

title: I Didn’t Want to Spend the Money
text: But—I’m so glad I did. In a few months, I put in the work learning about the effects of alcohol in the body and brain and went from daily drinking to wanting to cut back to being sober curious to realizing I can be my best self alcohol free. Today is Day 33 on my alcohol free journey, a number I’ve never achieved on my own. I’ve lost my cravings along with 9 lbs. I’ve gained peace, hope, and an inspirational community. If you’re reconsidering your relationship with alcohol, just do it.
author: Crystal B. B.

title: A Literal Lifesaver
text: Science, mindfulness, and support- the recovery trifecta, in my opinion! This app is far more than an app and more like a lifeline and a breath of grounded, fresh air compared to 12-step programs. The coaches, moderators, and participants are encouraging and lean into neuroscience and the most current research available on addiction, recovery, and overall wellbeing. Say goodbye to all or nothing sobriety counters, insistence on powerlessness, group think, and dependence on meetings. Say hello to a holistic and balanced pathway to freedom from alcohol addiction (or support in moderation, if that’s for you).
author: WooWooDogMom

title: Charged me even though I canceled my membership
text:
I was charged for the 1 year membership AFTER I had already canceled my membership before it was the renewal date. 

I had done the one month promotion. And cancelled my membership because the one year was coming up. Then I was offered another 1 month promotion so I took that. But then 2 weeks later the company tried to charge me $125 for the full year! Even though I had only signed up for a one month promotion. The company is saying that they don’t see that on file. But I know what I paid for I have the receipts. Luckily I have blocked the 125 from coming out of my account but this company is trying to scam you out of your money. By offering fake promotions
author: A yuh

title: Love Reframe
text: This is s great app. Whether you want to quit alcohol altogether or just cut back, Reframe empowers you with the tools to accomplish your goal!  By using  daily short but informative neuroscience articles, the information provided helps you rethink your entire attitude toward drinking. The tools help with cravings, mindfulness, community, and science in lots of areas that affect you, like nutrition, sleep, hydration and more. The price is really reasonable for what you get, and you can go monthly or do a free trial. What do you have to lose????
author: Mtntchr

title: Reframe app
text: I am on day 110 sober, I’ve struggled with alcoholism since my teenage years and don’t know if I would have made it to where I am now without the reframe app.  Reframe uses science based information and techniques that really put everything into perspective and help make lasting changes, not only for my sobriety but for my physical and mental health.  I highly recommend to anyone who struggles with alcohol addiction, or would like to change their relationship with alcohol in a healthy way! Five stars for sure!
author: Saved me 🖤

title: Amazing App with an incredible community!
text: I can’t recommend Reframe enough. It is worth every penny of the $9.99/month. You’ll save more than that even if you only cut down alcohol use by 2-3 drinks/month! Definitely take part in the forum and the meetings. You’ll discover an amazing family of people who understand exactly what you are going through support you during your successes…and your failures. It is a safe, non-judgmental place where you don’t need to hide anything.
author: Doc DAM

title: Game Changer!
text: This app, the coaches and community have been an absolute game changer!  The daily tasks, checkin meetings and forum are always helpful, supportive, educational and inspirational. I love this app and community! I also find the tracker of days, dollars and calories a helpful tangible tool. For the first time in more than 20 years, I feel freedom and not in the grips of alcohol. I toggled back & forth between the cutback and quit tracks a couple of times before committing almost 7 months ago to going 100% alcohol free. Best decision ever!
author: CB724

title: Excellent concept
text: I really struggled with admitting my relationship with alcohol was coming in between myself and my happiness. I felt ashamed, like how did this happen to me? But my coach and the daily exercises have helped me understand the “why” and I am now learning the “how”. I just started this journey and I don’t know where my relationship with alcohol will end up but I know I’ve been able to cut down dramatically and when I do drink I realize more and more, I’m better off without it.
author: Malutang

title: Charging people to help them quit??
text:
I was very excited to try this app and program. I signed up, filled out the questions, then it told me I would only get a free week trial, and would be $14 per month after that! Are you insane? What the heck is wrong with you? You say you’re trying to help people?? Like 90% of apps are free these days, with upgrades you can pay a little for. I could understand maybe a small one time fee with ads, but $14 a month??! 

Talk about taking advantage of people. My gym membership costs less than that and actually provides things to keep me healthy. This could only be an added thing to help. It’s almost entirely up to the individual. What a huge turn off. Especially when one of the things your app claims is that “quitting will save you money... oh but also give us your money too.” 

I hadn’t had a drink in a week on my own, and this frustrated me enough that now I don’t really care... hope you feel good about yourself. Completely made me lose my motivation. Not a good look at all...
This is actually really disgusting.
author: The Rugg Brothers

title: It helps
text: Since I dated the Reframe app. It has helped me change my relationship with alcohol. I never was a heavy drinker but when the pandemic hit I fell into a bad habit of having one or two in the middle of the day then it grew into many drinks.  Reframe has given me tools and an understanding of how alcohol affects people and I knew I wanted to get control of my drinking once again.  The different approaches help me build new habits and the forums helps me not feel alone.  I’m glad I found it and am working on me.
author: kumbucket

title: Life Changing App!
text: Whether you want to reduce or eliminate drinking, this app is so helpful! You track your progress, check in daily and receive new information that really helps you understand alcohol and motivates you to make whatever changes you want, all in a zero judgement, positive way. You get so much support and so many resources to choose from including optional zoom meetings with other members, meditations, and life courses. Best thing I’ve done for myself in a long time.
author: dacheese

title: Reframing my relationship with alcohol
text: I started my journey with Reframe on April 1st and in the 60+ days of daily tasks and logging my drinks I have learned so much about myself and my relationship with alcohol in the process. I appreciate the health and wellness topics, the science, and the tone of the articles. It’s a great app and highly recommended. I feel supported and I appreciate that it is not dogmatic. Everyone’s journey is different and the app meets you where you are. I have made positive changes and am just getting started.
author: Dancehall Days

title: 7 days and still satisfy
text: I knew some of the information on the heath issue my drinking habit could bring me. It’s really good to see all the data in one place and being able to review them in such interactive way. It’s engaging and I feel hope about finally having found a good tool. I tried other apps before but stopped after the first day. It has been a week already on Reframe. Congrats on the team building this platform. I’m Really impressed.
author: Mousou2003

title: Costs money
text:
As bold as it is for me to expect an app to be free when people have put time and effort into it… an ad based version for free would be nice. As an alcoholic trying to quit or lower my drinking, you wont get me to pay an app to help… 

I kinda thought/hoped that it might be funded by a non profit or some group just trying to help people. But alas… profit is playing a role here. So I guess I am back to square one. Not their fault, $10 a month isn’t crazy, but someone with a problem will spend that on tonights drinks before they spend it on an app to stop. Shame because it looked well made, but I would only pay for it after it kept me dry for a month or more.
author: gomicao

title: Great tool to help you meet your goals
text: I’ve used the reframe app to help support me during dry January. It’s been a tremendous tool and I look forward to completing my checklist every day and reading about tools to help keep me on the right track. I feel like I can keep going for a while, knowing I have resources, tools and forums. I haven’t commented on the chats, but the posts are inspiring. So many people are out there going through this with me. I feel like I found a community.
author: NoSallys

title: Amazing
text: I was hooked before the 7 day trial was up. I bought a year and it is the best investment in myself I’ve made in a long time, if ever. It is so informative. The people are all wonderful, there’s tons of resources and you learn something new everyday. With anything else, you have to be ready and in the right mindset to change. But if you’re serious about getting sober, this app is for you. I’m currently 34 days sober and have never felt better in my life. So thankful for this app.
author: GracefullyAl

title: Game Changing
text: This app has/is helping my change my relationship with alcohol.  I was unsure if I was the type of drinker who need to seek professional help or if I could figure it out on my own.  Well I’m not alone there are LOTS of people just like me that needed to examine their relationship with alcohol and drinking patterns. It really does break it all down for you in daily tasks that are not time consuming.  As it may not be for everyone I know that it has helped me. 10 out of 10
author: BooJenn3116

title: You deserve to try this app
text: I was sure where I was on the spectrum of needing outside assistance. This ap gives you a daily injection of science, access to multiple meet ups with anonymous options so you can just listen, text functions to share your thoughts and feelings, a range of tools to try. Supportive environment. Range of diverse participants all want the same end goal of a heartier life. Can be glitchy at times but overall more than you could dream it to be.
author: melmelboo

title: This works!
text: I’ve tried and failed on my own to cut back on alcohol. This app’s day by day coaching has shown me the neuroscience of why it’s so difficult to do. Learning about the damage I’m doing to my brain and body organs has changed my mind at last. The app reminds me daily of the ways my body is healing now that I’m doing it less damage. The daily, weekly, and monthly insights on my progress motivate me to continue and improve. Plus, I can see and feel the results!
author: jpdixon

title: Curious about your relationship with alcohol?
text: Midlife unraveling dismantled a lot and the new habits that emerged were helpful until one was not anymore - the 1 glass of red wine daily at my cozy hangout became 2 and suddenly I felt a little trapped. I don’t crave alcohol but I do enjoy the white noise of a cozy bar because I’m single and I work at home all day and need a change of venue. This app is helping me be more intentional and digging deeper and reflecting more about what could replace the old and how it’s holding me back.  💗
author: Deborah Lukovich

title: Rethinking My Drinking
text: This app has been invaluable to me. At present, it is the ONLY device that has helped me change my mindset about my consumption. It has educated me on the reasons for why I have been unable to this point been unable to refrain, cut back or stop my desire for alcohol. All of my whys are being answered and I find myself more and more able to turn from the temptation of giving in to it as my vice. Thank you so very much for developing this method of rehab. I’m very grateful.
author: LynchGross

title: Helped me cut back!
text: I didn’t realize that my nightly glass(es) of wine was actually a habit, until I tried to cut back. Reframe helped me learn so much about my relationship to alcohol, and gave me real, actionable tools to address cravings and come up with a “why” for drinking less. I was able to change my relationship to alcohol in about two months. This change won’t happen so quickly for everyone, but as a moderate drinker, I found the changes to be surprisingly fast and lasting.
author: Drinking Less Feeling Great!

title: Best way to cut back on alcohol
text:
Reframe has been instrumental in my goal of cutting back on the wine.  It started with Dry January and this tool and I love it so much that I am going to keep it for at least this year.
I have read numerous books on why alcohol is bad….BUT this tool breaks it down into little pieces to help you really have the info set in.  It helped me realize how bad excess alcohol was for my body….and WHY i was drinking so much to begin with. I cannot say enough about this app.  It is totally worth it!!!!!
author: AmyRP13

title: Supportive with info based on science
text:
I’ve been using this app to help me cut back on drinking during the week but it’s worked so well for me that I haven’t needed or wanted a drink in 2 weeks. 
It’s given me a new goal of cutting alcohol out for a year. 
Some of my favorite things the app offers:
- accurate info on how alcohol affects our brains, bodies, etc (I find this more fascinating than reasons why I shouldn’t drink)
- no judgement 
- realistic advice on ways to choose health over happy hour
- realistic goals to strive for 
- distraction games and a 20 min timer if I do feel a craving
- daily accrued counts on what you’ve gained by not drinking (savings, etc)

I’ve been using it every day for 2 weeks and plan on using it through 2022. I’ve spent 30 years drinking most months/years so I figure I owe it to myself to give it up for one :)
author: yoginijen25

title: Worth Every Penny
text: I had tried quitting alcohol for 10+ years, unsuccessfully. One day I woke up and had had enough. I decided to find an app for accountability, and found the Reframe app. I downloaded it and have used it every day since- that was 856 days ago. I love paying the annual fee because it’s a good app (good user experience, functionality), made well, and most importantly has 100% helped me quit alcohol with its daily readings, quotes, journaling, community, and tools.
author: meggos18

title: Great help!
text: I have been trying to cut down or stop drinking.  The  reframe app has so many ideas and choices and angles on how to get where I want to be.  Very interactive.  The daily task are informative on how and why my mind and body react to alcohol. The daily zoom meetings are very helpful.  Different categories for your journey or just to hear how others are dealing with life.  I don’t feel alone. Also the AI Melody is really helpful. It’s like having a therapist in your back pocket! Try it!
author: Jannie girl

title: Just what I need!
text: I heard about the Reframe app on Valerie Bertinelli’s Instagram page. I downloaded the app for the 7 day free trial. I’m so glad I did! I have developed the habit of wine every night, and I know it’s not good for my body. Reframe explains scientific research in easy to understand terms so that we can change our thinking, and reduce or stop our alcohol consumption. I enjoy the short daily readings and tasks that inform and keep me focused. I am now a subscriber, and changing my relationship with alcohol.
author: Mrs. Conrado

title: Truly helpful
text: My relationship with alcohol co to use to shift and improve 6 months into this app. I recently was away for 7 weeks because of a family situation. Still every night I would get a text asking me to record my drink count for the day! It was not annoying- ( maybe guilt messages from Duolingo that make me mad could take a hint) it was a gentle reminder of all the good work I’ve done and it made me miss the CBT help the app includes. I’m happy to be back!
author: Pamphilly

title: Great Community & Privacy
text: Not everyone who wants to explore an alcohol free lifestyle wants to go the traditional route of AA nor do they think serious treatment interventions are necessary.  This was the case for me.  When I first found reframe, all I new was that I didn’t like how much and how often I was drinking.  I had tried to cut-back, but was not successful and my drinking became worse.  Reframe has provided me with the tools, information, anonymity and community I needed to make and keep my alcohol free goals.  Thank you💪🏼🌷💪🏼
author: Sheyla I

title: I didn’t expect this app to be so helpful.
text: I was initially using app for tracking and some information I wasn’t interested in much else but then I started to toy around and things started to click. Then i attended a zoom meeting and it all opened up for me. I felt my long life of isolation pass me by in the wind, even tho I have never spoken on any of the zoom meetings and I’m anonymous I still feel apart of it I still feel connected. I love this app it’s saving my life!!!!!  T
author: TinaLs98765

title: Life changing
text: If you have been curious about your relationship with alcohol, if you want to make change, this is it. This is the best resource on cutting back or quitting alcohol out there, period. The way this app is organized and how it presents knowledge, is exceptional. The amount of content and support available for the price outshines any other similar resource out there. If you are looking to change or understand alcohol better, download Reframe, they have figured it out.
author: kitbit614

title: True in-depth step by step change
text: This app has more tools than others I have tried. The Daily tasks and guidance are scientifically explained and easy to understand and help you through your path of moderating or abstaining from alcohol. As a huge bonus there is a live forum and online meetings that give you the convenience of the ability to attend from your phone or be completely anonymous. If you are sober curious I highly recommend this app. It is fantastic!
author: ElkHC

title: It works for me
text:
I’m not someone who often says this but I’d give it one hundred stars if I could.

This is the first tool I have come across that has kept me from slipping up. It is the first thing I check in the morning and I cannot sing its praises enough.

If you want to quit drinking but are struggling with consistency, please download this app. It will change your life, and if it doesn’t then they offer a money back guarantee for up to two weeks I believe.
author: J.Art.S

title: Awful option, not worth your money
text: There isn’t enough meetings. I personally pay for this app as an alternative to AA and there’s not nearly as many meetings. The meetings on this app are just run by volunteers instead of professionals, that was deceiving for me as a new customer. This app advertises itself as a better alternative and it’s not even close. The more I sit on this the more upset I get. This app is not worth the money and you have tricked customers. I wouldn’t have signed up for a year if I hadn’t been mislead in my first free week. I’ve been checking for weeks and a Friday night on this app has no meetings available, this is when addicts need meetings most. This is a glorified journaling app.
author: Leahbats

title: Loved One Suppory
text: Empty, Empty, Empty!!!! if you want family support, don't waste your time on this application. Your family member who is addicted or using will get hours and hours and hours of support and they advertise one hour week for loved ones, but that loved ones our is just about letting a loved one complain about you the person who is addicted. They provide nothing of support to you as the family member of someone who is addicted or abusing alcohol. They provide nothing the meeting that they portray as supposedly to Help! loved ones is just about your loved ones complaining about you the person who is addicted. Don't let your family member waste their time or you waste your time
author: Chyler K

title: Reframe App
text: So holistic - physical, mental, emotional, spiritual! Very motivating with real data and personal progress details. Support with other humans when you need it via Zoom or the online platform with text (can be completely private, or choose to be more open). Amazing and inspiring articles, motivational speakers, book recommendations, quotes, meditation guides, and more! Always at your fingertips whenever you need support, encouragement, or wisdom! I couldn’t be more impressed and thankful for this app!
author: bdjeuwiabekek

title: This App Works!!
text: I stumbled upon this app on Facebook about a year ago, and I decided to give it a try.  I found it to be very useful in changing my relationship with alcohol. Information is presented in a straightforward manner, and there is no pressure or demands to stop drinking. Knowing I had a choice helped me to stay on frack. The forum groups are also extremely helpful and supportive. I haven't found any negativity from any users. I am now 8 months alcohol free, and Reframe helped me get there
author: LizzieB27

title: Please email the user with the subscription charge
text: This app is very helpful with accountability and to help educate medical reasons why decreasing intake is important. However, I didn’t realize this was a subscription and I would be charged $60 after the first week. While I received several helpful emails from Reframe, the email for the app charge went to my husband who has our Apple account and not to me. I would appreciate a refund please and thank you❤️
author: RhettMS

title: Life changing
text: I’ve never reviewed an app before now.  I feel so strongly about Reframe that I want everyone to know.  Whether you are sober curious, cutting back or quitting, Reframe absolutely helps.  It’s the only effective app I’ve found to help me on my cutback and possibly quitting journey.  From the daily tasks, the challenges and the forum.  That’s just to name a few.  I started with the month trial and realized after one week that I would be sticking with it for a long time.  I’m so thankful!!!
author: Mpb68@tn

title: Reframe is the best name & app out there!
text: Reframe your relationship w/ alcohol is the perfect name. It puts you in charge of you!  Reframe is a verb – pure action and you are in the driver’s seat. This app does a beautiful job of giving grace at every step and teaching and guiding those that use it. We often give up our control to alcohol and now you’re taking control back. Whether you were giving it up permanently or cutting back, you will no longer be at the mercy  of  alcohol.
author: BiigMaama

title: Thieves
text: I downloaded this app (5/25) and signed up for the seven day free trial. I think the app is amazing but not when they scam people for $10. I set up the notification to remind me to cancel before the trial ended. I canceled within days of signing up (5/29) to avoid any future charges. Today I received a receipt confirmation of a $9.99 charge. I have proof of cancellation yet they still charged me. This is unacceptable and should be frowned upon. This is fraud and an obstruction of service. Their cancellation policy says they don’t do refund but Apple does. Signed into Apple refunds and this charge isn’t even there as it said my download was free. I will be reporting this app to the FTC, BBB, consumer protection and the state attorney general office.
author: v day bih

title: Highly recommend
text: This app goes into depth about all the way alcohol impacts and what it does to both our physical and mental health. I never knew the true dangers of picking up a drink until I learned more about its effects. This app gives you the tool to help you understand the world we live in and why not drinking can help us handle the many challenges of life. I would give this a try because why not learn a little more about the things you drink.
author: Mic4673

title: You won’t regret this app
text: This will not be another app on your phone you pay monthly or yearly for and then never open but once or twice a year. And you also will not receive ads or constant notifications about upgrading your plan or paying money. No matter what your drinking habits are, this app will help you daily in all aspects of your life. It is constantly adapting and changing, and I couldn’t be more proud to be part of this.
author: LemaAlphaEcho

title: Mindfulness and accountability
text: This app has been a very valuable tool in holding myself accountable, and teaching me to be mindful in my decision making. It’s not a cure all, but a useful tool. I’ve really enjoyed the accessibility of the app, and the readings. Like anything, I believe you get out of it what you put in. I’m not to where I want to be yet, but this app is helping me in my journey to where I want to be and I would recommend it to anyone thinking about cutting back or quitting drinking.
author: MartyMcFly86

title: Helping me with sobriety
text: I was 3 weeks into my decision to be sober before downloading this app, and I am over 4 weeks sober now. I wish I had found it sooner, but I am thankful for the support it provides and would recommend this to anyone looking to get control over alcohol. There’s support from a community, daily zoom meetings at different times, and daily tasks to help you understand the impacts of alcohol on your body and mind. I am grateful to have found reframe!
author: jkasunic

title: Staying strong
text: Never thought I would even stop drinking. I think back at how long I’ve been drinking and I honestly can not think of a day when I didn’t drink. At 53 yo, I felt like I needed to make a change and didn’t really want to go through AA, nothing against that program. Anyway once I started reading about the psychological ways reframe helps I was intrigued. So for today I’m 7 days into reframe and feel more confident then ever of never picking up another drink.
author: Missy. B

title: Finally -A tool that makes a difference
text: I wanted to cut back, and counting drinks alone wasn’t enough to help me change habits. Using the wide variety of resources in this app, I cut my drinking by 70% over the course of a month, from 2-3 drinks daily to 6 drinks a week (Th-Sat only): which was my goal. My sleep and heart rate have improved already. If you are motivated to cut back or quit, this is a great option. Such a supportive community allowing for a wide variety of goals regarding alcohol use.
author: Maryseattle

title: Cutting back
text: I really like this app. Super easy to use. Love the forum where you can share and chat with others. The knowledge the app provides is super helpful. Also the tasks are great to help you stay focused but doesn’t require crazy amount of effort to participate. Highly recommend if you are considering cutting back on alcohol or going sober all together. The community has so many people all with very different intentions and journeys. You are bound to relate to someone. 5 stars 👏🏻
author: smc467

title: Life changing
text: My drinking was out of control. Somehow it had become a habit and 1 led to 3 or 4 or more every night. I was browsing on my phone and this ad came up. I’m really glad I clicked on it. Now I’m alcohol free for 54 days and while I could have a drink anytime I want to, the thing is, I don’t want to now that I’m empowered by the knowledge and techniques provided by this program. Not only that but there is a great community to talk to and share struggles. Try it, I was a skeptic, but I’m a believer now!
author: JoeUnplugged

title: Game Changer
text: I have been wanting to cut back for years, but without accountability, it wasn’t working for me. I thought this app would be that accountability partner. It is so much more. This is a full on skill-building and education resource. It’s completely changing how I view wine consumption. I set my drink limit thinking it would be difficult to achieve. With all of the tools available in this app, I have yet to actually purchase wine. Best investment in my 51 years of life.
author: DLML22

title: Self-care at its best!
text: I’ve been trying to cut back on my drinking since we ended COVID quarantine. Nothing has worked. I’ve tried other programs, like Noom. Reframe is the first one that didn’t make me feel bad about myself - didn’t use should language….in fact, Reframe tells us all of the mental, emotional, and physical reasons why this is difficult and supports us to be patient with ourselves. It literally enables you to identify and then reframe your relationship with alcohol
author: maggierunshappy

title: Truly Life Changing App
text: This app has been the most effective and instrumental app in my life, and I am a 39 year old male with a family. I’ve always been a social and alone drinker, perhaps drinking 3-4 alcoholic beverages a day to unwind. But with the guidance of this app, and masterfully presented scientific and psychotherapy research applied, I have not had more than maybe 10 drinks all together in the last 6 months or so. Truly remarkable presentation of the daily support and calls to action!
author: FreddyRod1269

title: Download Reframe NOW!
text: I am so happy I found Reframe and gave it a try. I was very doubtful at first but It’s been the best support group! I’ve struggled with alcohol addiction my entire adult life and this is unlike any other “help” I’ve found. Daily tasks help me hold myself accountable and understand why alcohol effects me the way it does. Throughout the day I find helpful information and support through the tasks, Zoom calls and chat forum. So much more than an app, it’s a community.
author: kKirkW

title: Highly recommend!
text: I am using it to cut back and it has really helped. I love when I get to log 0 drinks at the end of the day. It’s very satisfying and oddly rewarding and helps me fall asleep feeling accomplished. And for times when I start to slip back into old habits, I’ll go to the app and start going through the daily tasks and immediately feel I’ve been reset, back on track. Anyway, I don’t leave reviews or use very many Apps, so this is a first!
author: Heaterup77

title: Amazing app
text: What an incredible resource for anyone trying to decrease or completely quit their drinking. I couldn’t recommend it more. It’s seriously amazing. So much information. Easy bite size chunks. Really motivating. Love the zoom meetings. First time checking out a meeting. Feeling stronger and more empowered every day! Thanks so much for developing it and sharing it with the world. I wish it was a free resource so more people could take advantage. I will say though that it’s worth every Penny.
author: SpiffyTiffy11

title: Only thing that helped me
text: I had tried years to quit drinking. The struggle of fighting my cravings became unbearable yet hating drinking at the same time life was awful. So glad the ad for Reframe popped up on my FB feed. It is so worth the few bucks a month. It made quitting so easy! No more cravings, no more struggles. I love the daily tasks and the courses, I’ve learned so much. I am 165 days sober thanks to Reframe and I am confident I will stay that way. If you’re struggling I highly recommend this app.
author: Heezybeezy

title: Life changing
text: There are a lot of apps. This one is the real deal for three reasons: 1. It’s evidence based and grounded in Good, up-to-date physical and behavioral science. It’s loaded with tools and activities to keep you focused while you learn and adapt. 3. The community is outstanding and you can connect with others through forums, messages, and live daily meetings. Wonderful people! WELL worth the investment if you’re ready to start a path of change.
author: Mnmoon1969

title: Thank you
text: Thank you to this app it helped me in so many ways take my life back. This sounds like such a fake review but it’s true lol it’s more than a app it’s a community that embraces you. I’ve made friends and gained support i didn’t know i needed . There is also so many things on the app you can do things you didn’t know could even be in a app that helps you with drinking. I’m so thankful to the creators and to anyone else who is using the app .
author: chickb12

title: Autocorrect when typing
text:
Love this app so far and have really enjoyed the community and what the app offers in terms of accountability and learning.

That being said - when asked a prompt or when writing on the forums, none of the typical features you would have on a phone (autocorrect, spellcheck, automatic suggestive words) are available. It takes me twice as long to type something when I am on the app vs any other site or app on iPhone. It makes me not want to use the forum or the journal feature. Hoping they get this resolved soon!
author: mesykes25

title: Best App for being sober
text: I think this app has helped me so much with getting myself sober from the daily tasks to the Zoom meetings to the tools to the courses. There is always something to help you in your sober journey. The Zoom meetings are the best because you really feel apart of the community with your fellow Reframers. I tried this app with the trial and would recommend this app to anyone wanting to be Sober!!! Thank you Reframe for this. There is nothing else like this on the market.
author: Nessiedear

title: Fantastic resource for reframing your experience with alcohol - either quitting or cutting back
text: So much amazing and useful content it’s hard to know where to start.  The daily checkin and tasks are educational as well as motivational - there’s groups to join, but 2 of my favorites are the 20 minute crave mode and the actual zoom meetings to hear other people’s journeys and help keep you on track with a community who have the same goals.  Well worth it.
author: JustNQTD

title: Deceptive Renewal Tactics
text:
I previously used, and stopped the Reframe app. Over the last month I received numerous promotional offers, so I decided to give it another try. I was offered a free 7 day trial and a $5 monthly trial at which point I could cancel at anytime. After selecting the $5 option, I was immediately charged $80. After filing a complaint I was told I had already received that offer and therefore would be charged $80. I understand that I have previously received an offer, but I was offered the same promo AGAIN. I was also sent numerous discount emails to entice me to retry. This is a horrible customer acquisition technique for individuals seeking help. Just be honest about your cost. 

Scott
author: Lucy Snorebush

title: Stop feeling sorry for yourself and DOWNLOAD IT
text:
I’m a real person who has struggled with alcohol for over 15 years. 

Legit didn’t think anything could get me alcohol free. I’ve tried all the things. My first day on this app I joined a zoom meeting. And it changed my life forever. I’m over 200 days in and can confidently say that alcohol is the furthest thing from my mind. ALSO I’ve met so many people from this app who have became my best friends. Hopefully I see ya in a meeting soon!!! ❤️
author: RachaelAF

title: Great app
text: This is a great app for cutting back or quitting alcohol. The information it shares during your progress really helps to stay motivated. At the end of the day the app is just a tool that can be helpful, you still have to put in the work. This app will save the money you spend purchasing it in the first week (if you cut back from heaven drinking) I really don’t appreciate apps asking to leave a 5 star rating but this one really deserves a solid 5 stars.
author: bxndjiebdudb

title: Reframe is a lifeline!
text: I started using this app in January 2022. It is absolutely brilliant.  I’ve struggled for years to get and stay sober. Not drinking is the easy part. Staying stopped is the hard part. Reframe has helped me stay stopped for 100 days now. It’s a manageable program that incorporates multiple tools to address many root causes for excess alcohol consumption. It is way more than just an app - it’s a viable recovery program that I can use every day to support me in my recovery journey.
author: Its4mekak

title: Just what the Dr didn’t order but should
text: So impressed with the daily readings and the forum.  I love understanding the neuroscience behind alcohol.  Understanding for me is where I get my power and wow is there excellent content.   I am so glad there is a support group outside of AA that doesn’t feel shameful or doesn’t require a label.  This is a great place to come to make adjustments and heal to be the best you can be with your relationship with alcohol.  God knows we all need a reset after the covid drinking party!
author: sbritt74

title: Blew My Mind!
text: I realized my relationship with alcohol was not the greatest, and it was time to enlist some help. After an exhaustive internet search I found Reframe.  This app has changed my life ❤️.  I decided to begin on the abstinence track, and am loving the knowledge this app has thrown my way daily, the tremendous support I’ve received, and the clarity and self control I’ve discovered.  Worth every penny - thank you Reframe Creators - you gave me back the girl I hadn’t seen in a while 🥰
author: lhigdon

title: Great support tool
text:
While the focus is on alcohol, I have found this tool to be one of the most comprehensive, positive and supportive tools available.  In fact, I could see this platform very effective with other challenges requiring behavior change.  

The tool has helped me become more aware of my relationship with alcohol, how it impacts me, especially on mood.

Thank you to all who have and continue to be part of such a supportive platform.  It’s helping me a lot.
author: unknowm500"

title: Deceptively “scientific”
text:
I think that people use this app as a crutch to say they’re “working on themselves” but sadly the app doesn’t deliver what it promises 

Reframe will help you reflect on your alcohol consumption, provide you with some mindfulness/meditation work to cope through triggers, and a forum to talk to people, that’s about it. 
The “science” that they refer to is the daily reading of about 5 minutes where among 5 random citations from websites there will be a peer reviewed scientific article. 
If you’d like to think a bit more about your alcohol consumption this app is great. If you want to change your relationship to alcohol, I wouldn’t invest the time and money into this app.
author: SinghAP

title: Super helpful; meets you right where you are
text: I found the app very user friendly and easy to use. The daily information/readings are “just enough” to hold my attention while giving me something new to think about. If you’ve ever done Weight Watchers (or similar) you know that when you actually write things down, you see just how much you consume. It’s eye opening! The app helps me make mindful choices and manage shame. Love it!
author: CutBackGal

title: Completely worth the subscription; and you’ll feel that before the free trial is up
text:
It feels like this app was my other leg in walking to being alcohol free. After decades of using alcohol to medicate myself (4 drinks/day, every day for the last year has been my peak). I cannot believe that I’m now dealing with life without alcohol. 

This app, in my opinion, is an interactive guide with an enormous toolbox. It’s guide and most tools are based on science, not religion (meaning it’s not like AA in this area). You learn the how and why of addiction and alcohol so that you understand what’s happening in your brain, emotions, and body. This was key in creating actual change in thought processes that lead to my drinking.

This app is empowering. I can take what I’ve learned here and translate it into changing virtually any habit I don’t like. 

Best app I’ve ever purchased. No question.
author: Imosbcster

title: So glad I found reframe
text: The meetings are the heart of this app. Having so many others tell their stories helps so much. The coaches are all so good at listening and giving feedback. It’s a multifaceted approach that allows anyone to benefit from one or all parts that are offered. I’ve been searching for an alternative to AA for years. I finally found it with reframe! A very up to date easily accessible option. Thank you for all you do!
author: Burgh66

title: Unbelievable App
text:
This app was incredible. The crossbow clean the psychological effects of drinking and the scientific effects of drinking just really made you look at drinking from another side. So valuable to me . It was eye opening to to understand why u drink , and while you drink to excess.  And why your quick toe go back for more . It was truely instrumental in me cutting back drinking and getting to my ole self again !! Went 78 days without , now slowly drinking again. 
Thanks reframe!
author: The cool kid😻

title: Loving this app❤️
text: I love love this app. It has helped me in so many ways. Not only with alcohol but with my mental also. I look forward to checking in everyday and learning new things. I’ve done a couple of challenges and I love it. I love the daily meetings ( wish they had more). This was the best investment I have made for myself.  I told myself if I can spend money on alcohol and have no positive affect from drinking.  Why not spend some of that money on my well-being.
author: mirazamilenda

title: Amazing!!
text: This app is wonderful!! I have tried several different ones in the past to help me with my drinking, and this is the only one I’ve stuck with faithfully!! There’s so many features that are different than other apps I’ve tried - from the guided meditations, to the craving tools etc. I’m happy to say that this app has helped me in so many ways, and today I’m sober for the longest streak I’ve had in almost a decade!! Thank you Reframe creators!! You rock!!!
author: MrsGuyette

title: Most amazing app ever!
text: This app has helped me in so many ways. The lessons are practical and based in science and are NOT at all like any other program I’ve ever tried and I have tried so many. It is not geared toward giving up something but it is geared toward GAINING many things. I am better able to understand my own thinking and behavior and I get to decide what I want to change about myself and my own life. It’s a very powerful tool and a blessing to me.
author: get fit for a purpose

title: Great support that’s with you all the time
text: Since we carry around our phones with us ALL THE TIME, Reframe has been incredibly helpful because it’s always with me. I like the bit-sized lessons everyday, but also the toolbox to help break a craving. If I feel one coming on, I pull out my phone and play one of the games they have on there. 5 minutes later I’m so absorbed in the game I forgot I was having a craving and am able to move on with my day.
author: DangerDane

title: Often the slow steady pace wins the race
text:
Anyone who has enjoyed alcohol at some time has tried to control it. Reframe simply helps you find the pace that works for you.
