Remember when you were a kid and you simply wanted to understand “Why? Why? Why?”  Reframe gives you all the whys about alcohol you want to know. 

Reframe doesn’t leave you at the end of Dry January. This program walks beside you for the long haul. Day after day encouraging, learning from failure and understanding how behaviors can change. 

Reframe is not simply about alcohol. Reframe is about the broad sweep of healthy thinking and good mental health. It teaches resiliency, self care, goal setting and about happiness. 

This is the best holistic multifaceted self help system out there.  As a Mental Health Therapist myself I highly recommend this program.
author: Sheila & Stanley

title: Reframe a new horizon
text:
I was recommended this app by my Dr. Therapist , I took her advice and did the trial I was really amazed the whole approach mind you now I have met Bill W and done God only knows how many steps . This approach thru the daily readings and understanding yourself not one size fits all plus no pressure not a race if you stumble here and there they teach to be ok kind and reasonable with your self . 
      The only thing to add is a sincere thank you to the team at reframe 30 + days with no pressure
author: Plbr Nyc

title: It's still up to you
text: It's a good ap to record your drinks, making you feel a bit bad when you drink. It gives insight into the medical reasons of how it effects your mind and body as well. However, I thought i was getting support from a real person, and it was not a real person. I'm sticking with it, because I've cut back a little, but hope to cut back more. Nearly everryone I know drinks, and I really enjoy the weekend cocktails, and wine during the week. I'm still working on it.
author: mamahartz

title: Fantastic
text: This app is excellent. I have had a lot of trouble cutting back on drinking for many years. This inspires me to keep my “dry streak” going and I actually want to be completely sober after using this a few weeks. There are daily tasks it asks you to do that only take a few minutes, and you earn coins for doing them. Even with a busy schedule I have no problem completing the tasks. Highly recommend!
author: Cara Bobarra

title: I love this app!
text: When I started my alcohol free journey 658 days ago I never imagined what a powerful tool it would be.  It was a perfect fit for me.  I love that I have so many supports that I can use or not, depending on how confident or shaky I’m feeling in my sobriety.  The forum is amazing - like a friend waiting whenever I have something on my mind.  The users are so supportive and it feels awesome knowing so many people are walking similar paths to me.  Reframe, you have hit the nail on the head!!!!!
author: Just F.I.N.E

title: Life changing
text: Reframe has been life changing for me. At first it helped me decrease my drinking by using the cut back track and now it’s helping me stay completely alcohol free with the quit track!  I’ve used it over over a year now and feel better than I have in my entire 48 years.  It’s simple, easy to use, and backed by science.  I highly recommend this app to anyone looking to change their relationship with alcohol for the better!
author: WildWellnessChick

title: I never thought it was possible …
text: I never thought it was possible to learn so much from an app right on my phone that has helped me to reduce/understand/observe/question/confront/accept my alcohol use in such an understanding and smart way. I was %110 skeptical before. Like a full blown denier. Now I use this thing every day. I am not exaggerating. Listen I DID NOT EVER think I could reduce let alone quit alcohol. And I did it. You. Can. Too. What are you waiting for ?
author: LaurenRo820

title: Great community
text: Without reframe, my journey of being alcohol free wouldn’t have happened. It is educational and provides support to those seeking this journey in a number of ways.  There is daily reading, forms, book clubs, journal prompts, a large variety of zoom meetings, and other spin offs of these. It’s perfect for me as I didn’t want to join AA for a number of reasons and wanted to have a less intimidating means of bent in a community of people going through the rethinking of alcohol.
author: Reymaestro

title: Love the daily readings and community conversations
text: For me, Reframe isn’t just about changing my alcohol intake habits, it’s about personal growth and learning to live intentionally every day. The extras (challenges, guided meditations, virtual support meetings, educational courses) get me through those times when I need a little more focus. The community forum is hugely supportive and where I go to gain perspective through others sharing their difficult and heartwarming journeys.
author: Freevieve

title: All my monies for this???
text: There are few good things about this app: tracking daily alcohol consumption, as well as money saved and sugar calories avoided, and the daily readings. But…the reading’s aren’t always knowledgeable. There are writing errors and redundant graphics. It’s not UX friendly (eg, there are daily quotes but you can’t save them, the app doesn’t allow for going back a page in the daily reading). It’s not as personalizable as it could be, like getting into the specifics of alcohol types. TLDR: As someone who’s cutting back, I did this app religiously for 4 months and trust me it’s not worth $14/month. That figure is insane for what you get.
author: bratney666

title: Lacking
text: I have never reviewed an app before and generally don’t review much online for data mining and marketing reasons. But I feel it’s important to share that this app is non-intuitive in design and doesn’t match up with its marketing premise, not because of its messaging and information on reduction or cessation of alcohol consumption, but because of what appears to be poor user experience standards in design. Also, foundational awareness of industrial and cognitive engineering standards seems nearly non existent. A nice try but user experience with neuroscience in mind was not a goal of the development of this potentially helpful app. Hoping you’ll have better iterations in the years ahead.

title: Reframe helped me save my life
text:
2024 UPDATE: 2 years of using this program and I’m stronger than ever. I highly recommend doing the cutback journey first if you’re struggling with cutting alcohol out completely. Take your time and figure out what is best for you. I celebrate 1 year alcohol free in two weeks. I recently went on a Celebrity cruise and my suite came with a complimentary premium drink package. There wasn’t a single second of that cruise that I wanted to drink alcohol. I can’t even remember my last craving. I feel joy again. I’ve lost nearly 50 pounds. My crippling stomach pain is gone. I now know why I medicated with alcohol to begin with and now I’m strong enough to do it all on my own.

If you’re contemplating giving it a try, please do. A couple of years ago I was chugging vodka at 6 or 7 am almost every single morning. Now it doesn’t even cross my mind. If I did it, you can too. You just have to show up. There is no going back, only moving forward. Get up and try again, and again, and again. Whatever it takes, however long it takes. “It is not your fault, but it is your responsibility.” My life was worth saving and yours is too. Thank you to the people of Reframe for helping me save mine.

PREVIOUS REVIEW OF THE CUTBACK JOURNEY: I struggled at first to show up daily, but when I finally caught up I promised myself that I would commit. Every single day. That’s when it clicked. I don’t want to write a novel, but I could rave about this program for hours on end. The knowledge I’ve gained, the changes I’ve made to my brain and to my body, the way I’m completely in charge of my alcohol intake, it’s all so priceless. It took a lot of consistency and work but my relationship with alcohol is completely different. I went from drinking every single day, having severe stomach pain, health issues, and waking up never feeling rested to not even wanting to drink, no more stomach pain, and I sleep like a baby. My mind hasn’t been this clear in many years. I won’t lie, feeling my depression fully has been the hardest part, but this program didn’t just give me confidence with alcohol. It’s also shown me that I can handle anything as long as I take the time to care for myself. I love how I can apply a lot of the things I’ve learned to various aspects of my life. I can’t believe I’m tearing up right now, but I think that goes to show just how much of an impact this program has had on me. Reframe- you’ve changed my life. I was headed down a very dark road and you helped me save myself. I couldn’t be more grateful.

title: Useless and cynical
text: Very low quality app. To the point that I wonder if all the five star reviews are genuine. It's not a useful app: it's more like a normal generic 'streaks' app with an 'alcohol' wrapper to make it feel alcohol-specific. You'd be better off getting a normal, cheaper 'streaks' app to tick off your alcohol-free days if that's what you want. There's nothing 'neurosciency' about it: You get a daily email with some irrelevant, generic 'health' info like 'get more sleep' and 'go to the gym' and platitudes like 'you got this!' The emails are in dark blue against a black background too so they're unreadable, suggesting an indifferent app developer at best. Shallow, one-dimensional, unthought through. Cutting alcohol is a serious mission, and these guys should have been much more serious with this app. As it is it's just a cynical method of extracting subscription money from people who are genuinely looking for a solution. And let's talk about the cost. There are serious, well-researched, well-tested books you can buy that are practically guaranteed to help you cut out or cut down alcohol - books that cost maybe £15 or £20 at most. This app costs several multiples of that. The pricing is out of control, a number plucked from the air. Don't waste your time.

title: Finally something that works!
text:
I’ve been asked to leave a review for the app Reframe, first of all I’d just like to thank the Reframe team for giving me my life back that I lost to alcohol. 
So, I’ve tried to stop drinking many time, I’ve never struggled to stop, I’ve never managed to say stopped. Until now. 
This app is like no other, my intention was to slowly cut back and follow the reframe app instructions on doing this, what actually happened was I quit instantly without realising it. I finished off a bottle of my favourite tipple then opened up the app, not had a drink since that night. Yes it’s only been 4 weeks as of now but my whole life has changed, I no longer want a drink, and I’ve had all the reasons to have one, like it’s Friday, like I’m going on holiday, that it was my birthday, then my Dads anniversary when he passed away, on top of that my wife drinks daily, believe me any of these situations would have normally led me to saying well I can because of this. 
But this app deals in a different way, it keeps you busy, it reminds you just how good it feels not to give in, every day there’s something new, something to keep you guessing what’s next, and this alone keeps your mind in the right direction. I now look forward to getting home and opening the app rather than a bottle. But best of all my wife has seen the changes in me and is now at the beginning of her reframe  journey to sobriety and saying goodbye to her demons that have crept into our marriage. 
Reframe I thank you!
Kindest regards 
David.

text:
I love this app! Initially, the I downloaded it with the intention to reduce my dependence on alcohol as a relaxation tool and cultivate some wind down habits that would not lead me to have hangovers or disrupt my sleep. I have found that the tools and strategies have now helped me to reduce other unhelpful behaviours which I had not considered to be a problem before such as over-working and over-eating as a distraction from things that are bothering me. 

Every day I get a boost from this app in one way or another and it really has lead me to Reframe the way I make choices about what to do with my time and energy. I have really committed to doing the content everyday for over 90 days now and I can see how, little by little, I’ve shed layers of conditioning that were keeping me from being my authentic self. 

Thank you to everyone at the Reframe team. This is such a helpful app and one which has potential to help people with any substance/behaviour that numbs you to what is present in each moment.

title: This app works.
text: Ever since I was about 17 years old I’ve felt uneasy about alcohol. On the one hand I really enjoy it but I’ve had so many shameful moments under its influence that I don’t feel happy with the person it makes me into. I have justified it many times as it’s so common. I’m now a mother of two, with a very successful career and marriage and I just don’t see the benefits of this drug in the way I once did. I want to be the best version of myself and a good role model for my children. I could see how alcohol was becoming more and more prevalent in my life and way of de stressing but I just couldn’t stop until I downloaded this app. It’s only been 2 weeks but for the first time I’ve been in 5 social situations where I would normally drink and I had no desire to. It seems to work deeply on my psyche to uncouple the act of drinking with fun which in my head was an unconscious bias all the time which was leading me to always say yes to it. Now I’ve realised I’m actually just as fun and confident as I’ve always been minus the annoying forgetfulness and childish over the top behaviour. I don’t think I will ever be the same and thank you so so much to the creators of this app. You’re changing lives.

text: I have been “sober curious” for years and like many, tried eliminating alcohol on my own with varied success. A dry January here, a sober October there and various strings of days. I have scientific information and healthy coping strategies at my fingertips, special challenges and courses I can take, regular Zoom meetings with fantastic mods and coaches and a community of like minded people who don’t judge and offer unfailing support to one another. The cost is minimal and well worth it for all that you get with this app (a mere fraction of how much I used to spend on wine in a month!) title: Incredibly helpful and addictive (ironically)
text:
Reframe really helps me to stay on track with my decision to quit alcohol at the moment. It is filled with loads of informative articles and insights about why we drink, what is craving, why are there cravings in the first place and how to deal with those in a healthy way, finding new healthy coping mechanisms to reframe your brain, setting a plan in case or relapsing, and also prompt us to write daily review based on questions they ask.

title: Reduce my Drinking 1 week in.
text:
For years I have known that I’ve been consuming too much alcohol. It was largely controlled to evenings and weekends. However, as I’ve aged so hangovers have worsened. Also, as I age, I want to live! I cannot lengthen the number of days, but I have control on the quality of those days. I am also weary of having a ‘drug’ control my life and my behaviour. 
I have tried managing my habit by cutting down, or cutting out. I was always alone. Reframe helps me as I’m part of a community. It engages with me at an intellectual, mental and spiritual level. 
So far, one week in, it has been easier than in the past. I do not want to cut out alcohol, I just want to be free of its control, free of headaches and indigestion, and free to enjoy an occasional glass of wine or pint of beer.

The best thing about using the app on a daily basis is the accountability factor. Not wanting to over exceed days or quantities of alcohol intake in the drinks section in regards to my target. And that’s been helping me stay on track.

As an aside, I would love to see a reframe app for people trying to lose weight and change their relationship with food. I’ve been trying to help a good friend build a better relationship with food and getting him to read up on the subject and make changes without starving himself, but it occurred to me how useful it would be if I could get him onto an app like this, that isn’t about calorie counting, but about making new pathways in our brains in response to food.

HOWEVER, the lack of health warnings is a serious cause for concern!

You should NEVER attempt to quit alcohol/drugs cold turkey. This could result in seizures, which can be fatal, especially in people who are habitual/heavy drinkers/ users. This should only be attempted with medication, under the close observation of a medical professional or addiction health care service.

The lack of information and advice around this shows a blatant disregard for your duty of care towards users. You are quite literally putting your users lives at risk.

text:
When you skip a day or two, it assumes you just magically stopped drinking and offers congratulations. Why not ask why there was no information for those days? If the last lesson I took was day 30, and I don’t use the app for a week, I still need the lessons provided on Day 31, 32, and 33 right? Offer people a way to deal with their shame of failure. If I stopped using the app completely for a week, it’s not likely that I just started doing phenomenally well. Give us a realistic way to pick up and start again. I sometimes wonder if the people developing this app understand stand addiction at all.

If you want to learn more, you can sign up for one of the numerous stand-alone modules which focus on topics like sleep quality, improving gut health, and setting healthy boundaries. There are also group support meetings centred around various themes, and a forum where users can share stories, comments, and feedback. I highly recommend this app to anyone who is already, or ready to embark, on a journey towards improving the quality of their life by reducing or eliminating alcohol.

title: Success and freedom!
text: I cannot begin to express how grateful and amazed I am by the Reframe app. This platform has single-handedly transformed my relationship with alcohol, and I can confidently say it has changed my life for the better. With its comprehensive blend of science, support, podcast, and interactive AI tool, Reframe has been the catalyst for my incredible journey from a heavy problem and binge drinker to a more balanced, mindful, and healthy lifestyle. One of the most remarkable aspects of Reframe is the scientific foundation upon which it is built. The app delves deep into the neuroscience of addiction, providing users with valuable insights into the brain's workings when it comes to alcohol consumption. This knowledge is empowering, as it allows you to understand the root causes of your drinking habits and enables you to take control of your actions. The support network within Reframe is second to none. The sense of community that it fosters is truly heartwarming. Connecting with like-minded individuals who have experienced similar struggles has been incredibly therapeutic. Sharing our journeys, triumphs, and setbacks has provided me with a level of understanding and encouragement that I could not have found elsewhere. The Reframe podcast is a gem in itself. It features captivating interviews with experts in the fields of addiction, neuroscience, psychology, and more. Listening to these thought-provoking discussions has not only broadened my understanding of alcohol addiction but has also given me the strength and motivation to continue my journey toward sobriety. One of the app's standout features is its interactive AI support tool. This virtual assistant acts as a personal coach, guiding you through the process of reframing your relationship with alcohol. The AI's non-judgmental approach and its ability to adapt to your progress truly sets it apart from other apps. It feels like having a supportive friend right in your pocket, available whenever you need it. But perhaps the most impressive and life-altering outcome for me has been the significant reduction in my alcohol consumption. Before using Reframe, I was trapped in a cycle of heavy drinking and destructive binge sessions, which often left me with crippling hangovers and regret. However, thanks to Reframe's guidance and encouragement, I now average just 2-3 drinks per week. The transformation is nothing short of astounding, and I haven't experienced a single hangover since I started using the app. I highly recommend Reframe to anyone seeking to reclaim control over their relationship with alcohol. This app goes above and beyond the traditional approaches to tackling addiction, providing a unique and effective blend of science, support, and cutting-edge technology. My life has been forever changed by this remarkable tool, and I can confidently say that Reframe has given me a new lease on life. Thank you, Reframe team, for creating an app that truly makes a difference!

I have stopped drinking alcohol in the past when required to for retreats, and although I knew I was drinking too much, I really hadn’t a clear idea of the impact on both my body and emotions. I don’t want to stop completely, but definitely want to cut back, and be in charge of when and how much I drink. Given the two streams that Reframe offers, I can do this with full support and all the scientific research. It has arrived at the perfect time for me, and I couldn’t be more appreciative. The online version as opposed to groups like AA, gives the option to be as public or private as one wishes on this journey. The ease and convenience of this format is a no brainer for me to make the changes I wish to make. Gratefully on this path.

title: Really Helpful, Excellent Approach to Drinking Less
text: I am about as skeptical as they come, and would have never thought I’d even consider using one of these APPS. I tried this one out of desperation last year and it worked really well for me personally, as a very obsessive and organized person. The ritual of using the app everyday and seeing progress grow was the perfect thing at the time and led me to 6 weeks of NO drinking. Did I fall off of the path? Yes. Almost a year later, there’s a reason I started using it again - not because it will necessarily “cure” a heavy dependency, but because it helps when you want to re-think your relationship with substance and need an encouraging place to track the journey. The daily anecdotes on the neuroscience element of alcohol were not only concise and thoughtfully presented, but they were not pushy or shaming. A truly wonderful thing, for the right circumstances. As for all of the reviews about the free-trial, and it being a scam - just do your reading before you start. That’s on the subscriber, not the developer.

title: You’ll see results immediately 👌😊🙏🏼
text:
Finally I’m seeing results in my efforts to cut back my drinking. The app focuses on science based information so that you can create, modify and achieve your drinking goals. 

You have 5 daily tasks in order to achieve your daily completion 🔥:
 
1-reading an article *always an article 
2-daily affirmation quote *always an affirmation
3-an exercise like 3 mins of mindful breathing (meditation)
4-answering a question “journaling” (this is a private moment to be honest with yourself in a safe way and setting new intentions) 
5-“survival tip” another article based on the daily theme
6-log your drinks

*note: this is an example of the structure that they create for you. It may vary slightly.
*it doesn’t take long to complete your tasks. And you can start your day with completing the first 2 and then coming back to the app to complete your day or edit it (even if you’ve missed a couple of entries, you can come back to compete it and achieve your 🔥 which I love.

There are different tools, a “tool kit”, forum and discovery section full of supportive resources. Ie podcast etc. 

I consider myself very knowledgeable about self care because it’s my field of work, and I have yet to find a drinking app that’s so well thought out and executed. You can apply these tools to other aspects of your life. It’s supports you on your journey towards “being the best version of yourself”.

Every member has different goals and it seems so far like a very supportive community and group of people!! 
LOVE it so far!
🙏🏼👍🏼👌❤️

title: Thank you Reframe.
text:
I cannot recommend Reframe highly enough. What makes this app different is that it approaches alcohol habits through science, neuroscience, and education — not shame or guilt. The evidence-based approach genuinely helped me and the way I think/thought about drinking.

I was recently diagnosed with an autoimmune disease, and was told that drinking alcohol was not an option given the medication I would be taking and the dire effects it would have on my health. At first this news terrified me even more than the diagnosis of a potentially fatal disease if left untreated. Wow!! So, I turned to my emails from Reframe for help. 

Reframe explains what alcohol actually does to the brain and body in a clear, compassionate, and motivating way.  I especially appreciated that Reframe focuses on progress, awareness, and healthier habits instead of perfection and this was just the tool I needed to move forward and get past the fact that drinking alcohol could no longer be a part of my everyday life. 

If you too are  wanting to cut back, or stop completely like I have and are looking to build a healthier relationship with alcohol, I truly think Reframe is for you.  Their science-based approach and supportive guidance made a real difference for me, and the emails alone were worth it. Everything I read allowed me to be able to put a tick in the box with why and how I was feeling. Why I was feeling so good mentally and physically. It all started to make sense. 

I feel like a “new”  me. The old me before I made alcohol my “go too”. 

 I will continue to read their work, their research and stories. I will be forever grateful to them. 

Thank you reframe team  you are amazing  🤩

title: Love the direction of my life
text: I have been struggling with a lot of aspects of my life. I have been trying to quit with just willpower alone but, for me, I would be great for a week or so and then something would happen or nothing would happen and I would revert to my old ways. This was the same initially with Reframe. In 2026 I had a commitment to change my life and get healthy - instead of a complete overhaul I focused solely on three area - meeting an average step goal each month, recording my found and being alcohol free. For being alcohol free my commitment was to start each day by completing the daily activities and end the day by logging my drinks. The modules build on each other to provide a sound understanding of all aspects around alcohol and drinking. In addition I joined the monthly challenges which reinforce what I am learning and gets you in contact with a community of like minded people who deal with the similar challenges as you. You get the opportunity to either watch and listen or get involved. The main takeaway is not willpower or motivation, it is consistency. Consistency in showing up for yourself each day. At present I have been alcohol free for 92 days, lost 9 kgs in that time and increased my average steps from around 7,000 to 11,200 steps per day.
author: Gazzam 64

title: Life changing app that pays for itself in the first month
text:
This app far exceeded my expectations. I thought it might help me cut down a bit on alcohol to complement my general fitness and weight management goals. It achieved this and more. 

At the most basic level, Reframe will save you money. How would you feel about having an extra $200 a week in your pocket?

The app provides helpful check ins and enjoyable readings and activities that generally involve 5-10 minutes morning and evening. The material is carefully structured and includes videos from Reframe’s own team of coaches who have all been on their own recovery journeys.

But wait, there’s more. Lots more.

There is a community forum for extra support, there are monthly challenges, there are additional self-paced learning modules (for improving sleep, finding your life purpose, etc), journaling functionality with optional AI prompting and analysis, and individual progress is tracked and rewarded with encouraging comments and “recoins”.

Options within the app are also provided for real-time video coaching sessions, either with a group or 1:1. These are led by people who have a deep understanding of what alcohol does to our minds and bodies and why we are so drawn to it. The sessions are very reasonably priced and easy to book. The ONLY negative thing I have to say about the app is that all the coaches are in the US, so finding a suitable session time is difficult if you live in Australia.

title: Highly recommended. Educational, practical and motivational
text:
I’ve used it off and on for a couple of years, but this year I committed to making it a daily habit, and it’s been a game changer for me. The beauty of it is that it only takes about 5 minutes each day.

Each morning, I start with a little education on various topics, including alcohol awareness, how the brain functions, goal setting, and motivation, among others. For me, learning about alcohol has been especially vital—it empowers me to make more informed choices about drinking.

The app also encourages easy personal reflections with short check-ins on my stress levels, mood, and mental health. This helps me stay aware of how I’m feeling and understand my triggers better, allowing me to navigate through lower moods and stressful times with greater acceptance.

One of my favorite features is the drink logging. I’m currently just shy of 5 months without a drink, and I feel so much healthier both physically and mentally. While I wouldn’t say my success is solely due to the app, I consider it one of the important strategies that has supported me on this journey, and I’m truly grateful for it.

I also enjoy using some of the meditations regularly to kick off my workday and boost my self-esteem. They are a great addition to my routine.

There are aspects of the app I haven’t explored yet, but I love that there’s something for everyone who is looking to cut back or quit drinking altogether.

Five months ago, I made a firm decision not to drink again. I realized that willpower alone wouldn’t get me there; I needed to recalibrate my thinking and reframe my mindset to the point where I simply didn’t want to drink.

This app has been an essential tool in that process. I now have a significantly better understanding of how alcohol works and its effects. I’ve gained more tools to manage stress and build a fulfilling life.

As a result, the choice to drink or not rarely comes into question for me anymore. I’ve truly reframed my thinking—I just don’t drink. The Reframe app has played a significant role in that transformation.

title: Needs an added level of sophistication
text: This app is a good start, however the messages are generic, rather than being tailored based on the data the user inputs. For example, I set my goal at 15 drinks a week based on 5 drinks, 3 days a week. The first night, I had a major blow out and had 10 drinks. I woke up the next morning feeling ashamed of myself, only to be congratulated by the app because I had stayed under my target of 15. I also get messages about how my body is beginning to improve because I haven’t been drinking, when I fact I have, I’ve just remained under my limit. I would like to see improvements in this area, such as a notification that comes up to warn you of the risk of having 10 drinks in a night. Diet apps do this if you eat under the recommended calories. My other issue is that all the events and check in are in GMT, rather than AEST so doesn’t work for people on this side of the world. Other than that, the readings are good and I like being accountable logging my drinks.

title: Skye
text: This app Reframe is really helping me to cut back drinking which I’m really pleased with. My drinking had increased badly and was so worrying. It caused many more problems than it solved for sure! I highly recommend Reframe and I’m going to stick with it definitely. I don’t normally leave reviews. This one is important to me though as I did not know what to do about my drinking until now. I have tried to quit completely and also to cut back drinking on my own and failed many times. Being alone in my efforts didn’t work. It only added more disappointments, negativity and discouragement which is good for nothing. I’m glad I finally made the wiser decision to try this ~One Week Free Trial~ and I haven’t looked back. Using Reframe has been educating me on all the different affects of alcohol which has been really interesting and helpful. This gives me more clarity each day and is teaching me self compassion to stop that cruel voice in my head that makes it all seem so hopeless. This app has been made very well and am so impressed! I’m learning how to pick myself back up and move forward with encouragement, gaining a can do attitude. This app has actually helped my entire thought process to be far better. Things that seemed impossible for me are starting to look possible and even good. This app offers many different ways of helping and this review is only the tip of the iceberg of what it offers you. Alcohol and depression has been taking a lot from me but I am ready for that to stop and to start enjoying a healthy life. The past doesn’t have to be your future but when something has become deeply engrained in you I think you need to learn how to retrain your brain to be able to go the best way forward. I really love that people around me are benefiting from my healthy changes as well. I am looking forward to seeing more wonderful results with a Big Thanks to Reframe 😊

text: I loved the 7 day free trial and it helped me cut back on drinking significantly. Sadly I couldn’t afford to pay after this so I was booted out of my account. This app would be so much better with a free version, even if I missed out on most of the benefits it would be really nice to at least be kept accountable.
author: Estelle Miller

title: Just billed $194 - the app is useless
text: Useless - just taking vulnerable peoples money
author: coffin nail queen

title: Works
text: Great companion to support your alcohol decoupling journey. Do it. It’s better on the other side.
author: bapplo

title: I recommend 100%
text: This App has supported me with not drinking alcohol for 3 months and counting. The clarity and reduction in anxiety that I now feel are worth the small fee, alone. The App provides lessons, graphs and tick-boxes, group-support via messaging, Zoom meetings (where the camera is optional), and you can have 1-to-1 coaching if you wish.
author: Maarie257

title: Changing attitudes toward alcohol
text: I’m just a week in to cutting back from my relationship with alcohol. Have done 7 days AF & have bought some zero alcohol gin & wine to enjoy when I want a drink. Enjoy the podcasts & the daily tasks which really help when the cravings come.
author: Caromags

title: Awesome app!
text: Such amazing information- really makes you think about the effects on alcohol.
author: Fiedsol

title: Reframe works.
text: I wanted to cut down on my drinking and didn’t really think an app would make any difference. After 48 days of Reframe I can say, without doubt, I am more knowledgeable and more in control of my drinking than ever before. I’m learning so much all the time and can make meaningful, conscious choices each and every day. So grateful.
author: TaniaRaumati

title: Best app if you want to change
text: Reframe is by far the best app if you’re thinking about changing your relationship with alcohol. No matter if it’s cutting back or quitting. There is support on every step of your journey. You’ll learn so much about yourself. You’ll grow in every aspect of your life.
author: Sahabarina

title: Great app
text: Practical, positive and motivating
author: Elfy 9452

title: Reframe truly makes a difference
text: This isn’t just an app, it’s a community! You know straight away that people care about your journey. Plus there’s a whole library of information and tips to help you stay on track. Highly recommend this if you want to make that change!
author: otumbo
